## 1. La mission (résumé ; le texte exact est au début de la PARTIE 5)

Reconstruire environ 30 rapports LUXIS hors de LUXIS. Ce sont les rapports Oracle REPADMIN du package
PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES (BCR, TA, CRM, RA, FA) et des packages IRP (General Ledger, First NAV Page, Multi CCY,
conso états financiers). Les sources sont MFGA_INFOCENTRE (schéma DWH) et MFGI (MFGI.GTA, MFGI.AMS…),
lues via Dremio en **lecture seule** (SELECT / WITH uniquement).

### Exigences de sortie

- **Sortie identique à LUXIS** : mêmes colonnes, même ordre, mêmes valeurs, mêmes formats, même nom de
  fichier. Validation à 100 % cellule par cellule sur 3 références LUXIS par rapport. Aucune tolérance
  d'arrondi, de nom ou d'ordre.
- **Depooling dans tous les rapports**, détecté depuis `MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL` +
  `AMS_LOT`. Interdit : TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK et la « Table Fonds » de LUXIS.
  - Un seul rapport, identique à LUXIS. Les lignes feeder antérieures au depooling gardent le numéro et
    le nom du feeder. Les lignes du pool partent du lot de transfert.
  - Pas de double compte : les lignes du pool antérieures au lot de transfert sont exclues.
  - Un ancien feeder demandé après son depooling est refusé, avec un message qui nomme le pool.

### Architecture imposée (`reporting_v2/`)

- `reports/<report_key>/` : chaque rapport est autonome. Aucun code commun (pas de core/common). La seule
  dépendance externe est `dremio_sql.py`, trouvé via la variable LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT ou en remontant les
  dossiers parents.
- `data_model/` : SQL bronze / silver / gold, plus `data_model.html`.
- `exchange/` : échanges avec le PC du bureau.
- `audit/AUDIT.md`.
- `tools/check_independence.py`.

### CLI de chaque rapport

- Commandes : `run` (options ou menu interactif), `compare`, `show-sql`, `probe`, `funds`, `depooling`.
- Options : `--env ctlq|intg` (ctlq par défaut), `--names mfga|luxis`, types de période, sortie XLSX/CSV.
- Produit à chaque exécution : `summary.json`, le SQL exécuté, une page HTML statique.
- Un README par rapport.

### Pièges Dremio à respecter

Pas de ROWNUM. LENGTH au lieu de `TRIM<>''`. Mots réservés entre guillemets. Toute troncature silencieuse
doit être refusée.

### Ordre de travail

1. Étape 0 : demander les fichiers et préparer le tour 1 de requêtes, puis s'arrêter. **Fait.**
2. Audit.
3. Tours de requêtes.
4. Modèle de données.
5. Rapports : 5 sous-agents en parallèle au maximum (Opus 5.5). Commencer par `bcr_mouvements` et
   `bcr_coupons_dividendes`, qui sont déjà validés.
6. Tours de tests.
7. Synthèse finale.

Après l'étape 0, avancer sans s'arrêter, sauf pour les échanges Dremio.

### Contraintes de l'utilisateur (mot pour mot)

- « N'utilise pas git. » L'utilisateur a ensuite demandé lui-même la publication sur GitHub, faite par
  l'API `gh`, sans git local.
- `dremio_sql.py` : « À utiliser tel quel, ne jamais le modifier ».
- Hors périmètre : « tout ce qui concerne eFront, et les variantes _v1 / _Old des procédures ».
- « Toute la documentation, les noms de fichiers, le code, la CLI et les messages sont en anglais. Je te
  parle en français. »
- « au maximum 5 sous-agents en parallèle (Opus 5.5) ».
- Limiter les allers-retours : chaque voyage au bureau coûte cher.
- Le volume de requêtes (retour de l'utilisateur) : 207 requêtes, c'est trop peu. Il veut « énormément,
  énormément » de requêtes, générées automatiquement à partir du catalogue.

## 3. Ce que l'utilisateur fait au bureau (instructions données le 29/10)

### A. Dézipper le dépôt et lancer l'exploration

Dans le dossier dézippé (celui qui contient `exchange\`) :

    set LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT=C:\...\dremio_sql.py
    python C:\...\dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq
    python C:\...\dremio_sql.py login --env intg
    python exchange\explorer\explore.py run --phase A,B
    python exchange\explorer\explore.py export --files C:\Users\padadmin\Documents\BA\a_envoyer --max-mb 60
    python exchange\explorer\explore.py run --phase C,D
    python exchange\explorer\explore.py export --files C:\Users\padadmin\Documents\BA\a_envoyer --max-mb 60

- Si la session Dremio expire : refaire les deux `login`, puis relancer la même commande. Ce qui est fait
  est gardé dans `explore.db`.
- `explore.py status` montre l'avancement. `--max-minutes N` arrête proprement.
- Durées estimées (jamais mesurées sur le vrai Dremio) :
  - A : de quelques minutes à 30 min ;
  - B : 15 à 45 min ;
  - C : plusieurs heures, la plus longue ;
  - D : 1 à 3 h.
- Sortie : `<dossier dézippé>\from_office.txt`, ou un autre chemin avec `--out`. Le fichier n'est créé
  qu'au moment de l'`export`. Chaque export remplace le précédent par une version plus complète.

### B. Le dossier `a_envoyer\`, à préparer par l'utilisateur et à joindre via `--files`

- **`1_liste\reports_list.txt`** — une ligne par rapport :
  `report_key | libellé du menu LUXIS | procédure | variante`. Indispensable.
- **`2_references\<report_key>\`** — indispensable :
  - 3 sorties LUXIS brutes par rapport, ni ouvertes ni réenregistrées dans Excel (XLSX et CSV si LUXIS
    propose les deux) ;
  - au moins une sur un fonds dépoolé pendant la période, et une sur un fonds à NAV backdatée
    (par exemple 280499) ;
  - un `refs.txt`, avec un bloc par fichier : `file`, `procedure`, `user_id`, `generated_at`, `env`,
    `funds`, `date_selector`, `date_from`, `date_to`, `period_type`, `other` (toutes les options de
    l'écran, y compris celles par défaut) ;
  - les références déjà présentes dans `Desktop\Oscar\reporting\` : Bcr_Movments.xlsx,
    Bcr_Coupons_Dividends.xlsx, Ta_*.xlsx, 242013-GeneralLedger-…xls, NetAssetValues, Nav-MultiCurrency,
    Bcr_Exchange_Rates, conso.
- **`3_oracle\`** — le dossier `lxs-apps-oracle\ORACLE\REPADMIN` entier. À défaut, des exports DDL :
  - la spec `.pks` de PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES ;
  - les 65 fonctions GET_* et CHAINE_NETTOIE ;
  - les packages PKG_IRP_PUBLICATION, PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE, PKG_CONSO_ETATS_FINANCIERS, PKG_TURNOVER_WD et
    PKG_MESI_PROCESS_TRANSACTION ;
  - les vues lues par les rapports ;
  - les chargeurs des tables LUXIS ;
  - le DDL des tables WRK_QUERIES_* et LUXREP_*.
  
  Indispensable.
- **`4_windev\`** — le projet WinDev LuxRep : `.wdp`, `.wdw`, `.wdg`, `.wdc`, `.wde`, les gabarits XLSX et
  l'export texte du code. Indispensable : c'est lui qui fixe les noms de fichiers, les en-têtes, l'ordre
  et les formats.
- **`5_projets\`** — luxrep_reports, frd-poc-general-ledger, frd-poc-first-nav-page,

## 4. Fichiers produits (tous en PARTIE 2)

C'est la liste détaillée de tout ce qui est demandé (253 lignes). Elle donne le pourquoi de chaque

### `exchange/round_01_requests.txt`

207 requêtes ciblées, toutes validées par la garde `read_only_problem`. Elles sont générées par
`exchange/gen/gen_round01.py`. Groupes :

| Groupe | Contenu |
|---|---|
| A | catalogue |
| C | colonnes |
| W | les 26 tables WRK_* et la sélection LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS |
| F | référentiel fonds |
| N | drapeaux NAV vs AMS_LOT |

| R | 23 tables de configuration |
| X | taux de change |
| M | multi-CCY, conso, fraîcheur (M023 = ctlq, M024 = intg) |

### `exchange/run_round.py`

- Lit les blocs `-- @id/@purpose/@env/@max_rows/@timeout`.
- Exécute avec un ThreadPoolExecutor et écrit `round_NN_results.txt`. Les valeurs sont séparées par `|`,
  avec les échappements `\|`, `\\` et `\n`, et `<null>` pour NULL.
- Garde un cache de reprise `.cache.jsonl`, s'arrête sur un HTTP 401, et propose `--check`, `--only`,
  `--env`, `--workers` et `--timeout`.

### `exchange/pack_files.py`

- Rassemble des fichiers ou dossiers dans un seul `.txt`.
- Les fichiers texte sont copiés tels quels (`===== FICHIER : … =====`).
- Les fichiers binaires et les CSV sont encodés en base64, avec leur sha256.
- Un `.xlsx` est en plus vidé cellule par cellule : type, numFmt, style, valeur, largeurs, fusions.
- Bibliothèque standard uniquement.

### `exchange/capsule/`

- `office_runtime.py`, `make_capsule.py`, `inbox.py`, `manifest_01.json` ;
- `outbox/to_office_01.txt` (142 Ko), testé de bout en bout.

### `exchange/gen/`

- `gen_round01.py` ;
- `luxis_proc_table_map.txt` : les tables, fonctions et WRK lues par chaque procédure LUXIS.

### `exchange/explorer/explore.py` — l'explorateur, pièce principale de l'échange actuel

Commandes :

| Commande | Rôle |
|---|---|
| `run` | exécute les phases |
| `status` | avancement |
| `pages` | pages écran, prévues pour les photos ; désormais secondaire |
| `source --root` | pages du code PL/SQL LUXIS nécessaire |
| `export` | crée le fichier unique `from_office.txt` |
| `sql <id>` | affiche une requête stockée |

Stockage : SQLite `explore.db`, table `q` (id, phase, purpose, env, sql, status, columns, rows, total,
error, elapsed, ts, meta). Une requête OK avec un SQL inchangé n'est pas relancée.

Phases :

- **A** — INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES" des racines MFGA_INFOCENTRE, MFGI, LUXIS, BUSINESS, FRI, STAGGING
  et MFGA, plus INTG. Puis les COLUMNS de chaque schéma, avec précision et échelle.
- **B** — les 207 requêtes du tour 01.
- **C** — le profil de chaque table utile :
  - C1 : COUNT sur ctlq ; C1I : COUNT sur intg ;
  - au-delà de 3 M de lignes, une tranche (C_FUND + fenêtre de N_LOT, ou D_NAV de juin 2026) ;
  - C2 : COUNT, MIN, MAX et APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT par paquets de 30 colonnes. En cas d'échec, C2B
    réessaie sans le distinct, puis C2C colonne par colonne ;
  - C4 : liste des valeurs des colonnes de 60 valeurs distinctes ou moins ;
  - C5 : échantillons de 5 lignes ;
  - C6 : présence des fonds de référence.
- **D** — couples LUXIS ↔ MFGA/MFGI :
  - candidats par règle de nom (DWH_AMS_X ↔ AMS_X, SEC_ → SECURITIES_, DWT_GTA_X ↔ MFGI X) ou par Jaccard
    des colonnes ≥ 0,25, avec 4 candidats au plus par table ;
  - empreintes COUNT, COUNT DISTINCT, MIN et MAX par colonne, sur la même tranche des deux côtés ;
  - verdict par colonne : same, diff ou renamed.

Export (`export_rows`) :

- Pour les tables sensibles (regex SENSITIVE_TABLE : REGISTER, CLIENT, CONTRACT, OP_TA, POS_TA, MESI_,
  PENDING, …), les requêtes non agrégées ne sortent aucune ligne : « client-level rows not exported ».
- Les colonnes personnelles (regex PERSONAL_COL) sont remplacées par `#`, y compris leur MIN et leur MAX
  (correspondance mn_i/mx_i → colonne retrouvée depuis le SQL).
- Dans une table sensible, les textes longs (plus de 12 caractères) ou de type nom sont remplacés par `#`.
- Format : une ligne `Q {json}` par requête (id, env, status, purpose, total, error, meta, sql, columns,
  note, rows), puis une section `# ==== FILES ====` produite par `pack_files.py`.

Constantes :

- REF_FUNDS : 280287, 280299, 812645, 280499, 242013, 280421, 280273, 280274, 280268, 280605, 241582,
  282303, 280334, 523379, 784810, 472863, 352745, 305093, 258815, 745635, 745642, 231433, 200815 ;
- LOT_WINDOW : 8554978..8607153 ;
- DATE_WINDOW : 2026-06-01..2026-07-01.

Tests : le tout a été testé contre le faux Dremio (PARTIE 3) : toutes les phases, l'export et le
masquage, sans aucun refus de la garde. Il n'a **jamais tourné contre le vrai Dremio**.

### `exchange/explorer/README.md`

Les étapes au bureau.

### Pas encore créés

`reports/`, `data_model/`, `audit/AUDIT.md`, `tools/check_independence.py`.

## 5. Connaissances accumulées (issues de l'analyse du bundle et de 3 sous-agents)

### Client `dremio_sql.py`

- `Client(env).query(sql, max_rows, timeout)` renvoie `(job, columns, rows[dict], total)`.
- Environnement par défaut : intg ; le projet utilise ctlq. Pagination de 500 lignes. Jetons protégés
  par DPAPI Windows. Connexion par `python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq|intg`.
- La garde `read_only_problem(sql)` refuse, hors guillemets, SET, USE, COMMENT, INTO, LOAD, LOCK, COPY,
  CALL, EXPORT, IMPORT, REFRESH, etc., même comme nom de colonne. Ces noms doivent être entre guillemets
  doubles.
- `OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).parents[3]` : le fichier doit être à au moins 4 niveaux de profondeur.

### Pièges Dremio

- Leurres : `MFGA.DWH.*` est presque vide ; les vraies tables sont dans `MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.*`.
- Les listes IN de plus d'environ 1000 valeurs et les jointures VALUES tronquent sans prévenir.
- Gandiva : utiliser NULLIF dans les divisions.
- Chaque table DWH est versionnée par N_LOT : prendre le dernier lot avec ROW_NUMBER.

### Structure LUXIS

- Les procédures PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES remplissent les tables WRK_QUERIES_*. C'est WinDev qui écrit ensuite
  le fichier : en-têtes, ordre, nom de fichier, format.
- LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS contient la sélection de fonds par utilisateur (FLAG=1). Elle est remplie par
  proc_Fonds depuis LUXREP_TB_FONDS + TAB_FND_STRUCT.
- Le body PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES est connu : version Git 2026.01.27_15.18.09, 18 010 lignes, dans
  `source_bundle/code_source.txt`. La spec `.pks` manque.

### Fonctions de période

- `get_Date_Last_Available_Day` : NAV_CONTROLE='Y'.
- `get_Date_Last_Published_Day` : NAV_PUB='A', plus GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL +1.
- `get_Date_Published_Period`.
- Toutes lisent REPADMIN.NAV UNION EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING.
- Types de période : LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY, TO_LAST_DATE_NAV, ou un intervalle.

### Indicateur backdated (V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG)

- nav_backdated=0 : seul C_NAV_TYP='O' est gardé.
- nav_backdated=1 : tous les types sont gardés.

### Correspondances connues

- Les tables DWH_AMS_* sont des copies LUXIS des AMS_* de MFGA, ce que la phase D doit confirmer.
- GET_FUND_NAME / CCY_TB_FDS ↔ AMS_PORTFOLIO, mais les noms ne concordent que pour 115 fonds sur 3 517.
- Première NAV avec parts ↔ AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL.
- Messages ↔ AMS_MESSAGE. `MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG` a les colonnes CTABLE, CELEM, CLANGUE et LIBELLE.

### Depooling (logique héritée du projet GL)

- Lot de transfert = premier lot du pool après le dernier lot des feeders. Cela concorde pour 20
  structures sur 24.
- Questions ouvertes :
  - 8 feeders reçoivent encore des lots après le depooling sur CTLQ : 280306 → 280127 ;
    714665 → 714902, 740228, 740234 ; 190 → 239602, 253168, 253169, 280202 ;
  - les mid-pools (FUND_TYPE 5 : 200817, 229106) ;
  - 6 anciens depoolings visibles seulement dans MFGA.
- Les anciennes décisions GL sont **remplacées** par la nouvelle règle de la mission : le « double compte
  assumé », le 3e fichier `_avant_apres_depooling` et la décision du 15/10 sur la « date_from incluse ».

### Les rapports présumés dans le périmètre (en attendant reports_list.txt)

- BCR : Bcr_Mvts, Bcr_Div, Bcr_Sub_Red_Fa, Bcr_Tx_Ch_Nav, Bcr_Grands_Livres, Bcr_Accrued_Expenses,
  Bcr_Pnl_Delta, Bcr_Cash_Deposit, Bcr_Ptf_Nav, Bcr_Short_Long_Position, Bcr_Futur_Report,
  Bcr_Stat_Irp_Report, Bcr_Container.
- TA : Ta_Registre (+_Blocked, +_User), Ta_Sub_Red (+_Filtre_Reg), Ta_Position (+_Filtre_Reg),
  Ta_Position_Globale, Ta_Inflow_Outflow, Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque, Ta_Pending_*.
- Autres : Crm_Fees, Ra_Linearisation, Fa_Fees_Rate.
- IRP : General Ledger, First NAV Page (NAV et Multi CCY), Conso états financiers.
- Exclus : eFront et les variantes _v1 / _Old.
- Les deux validés, par lesquels commencer : `bcr_mouvements` (proc_Bcr_Mvts) et
  `bcr_coupons_dividendes` (proc_Bcr_Div). Paramètres connus de leurs références : fonds 280287, du
  2026-06-01 au 2026-07-01.

### Projets existants dans le bundle (à auditer)

`luxrep_reports/`, `frd-poc-general-ledger/`, `frd-poc-first-nav-page/`, `frd-poc-conso-etat-financier/`
et `scratch/`. Leurs dossiers `config/` et `templates/` manquent. `source_bundle/claude.md` est une
ANCIENNE consigne (4 rapports, Sonnet, 3 sous-agents), remplacée par la mission.

### Vigilance confidentialité

Les données clients et le secret bancaire : rien de nominatif ne doit sortir. C'est pour cela que
l'export masque.

## 6. Erreurs déjà rencontrées et corrigées (pour ne pas les refaire)

- zsh : `--include=*.sql` est développé par le shell. Utiliser `grep -rhoiE`.
- Python 3.9.6 sur le Mac :
  - `Path.write_text(newline=)` n'existe pas : utiliser `open(..., newline="\n")` ;
  - pas de backslash dans les expressions des f-strings.
- Un EXISTS corrélé dans SUM(CASE) est risqué sur Dremio. Le remplacer par un LEFT JOIN sur un
  SELECT DISTINCT.
- Phase D : exclure les colonnes qui ont échoué en C2C.
- Fausses détections de colonnes renommées sur des colonnes constantes : il faut nd ≥ 2 et mn ≠ mx.
- Masquage : une table sensible non agrégée ne sort aucune ligne.

## 8. La suite, dès réception de `from_office.txt`

1. Le découper : lignes `Q {json}`, puis la section FILES, à redécouper au format `pack_files`
   (`===== FICHIER …` et base64). Vérifier les sha256.
2. Comparer ce qui est arrivé à la liste de `round_00_files_needed.txt`, et lister ce qui manque.
3. Écrire `audit/AUDIT.md` :
   - les sources réelles de chaque table LUXIS (chargeurs + phase D) ;
   - les fonctions GET_* traduites en SQL MFGA/MFGI ;
   - la couche WinDev (noms de fichiers, en-têtes, formats) ;
   - le depooling mesuré (groupe P) ;
   - les écarts entre CTLQ et INTG.
4. Écrire `data_model/` : bronze (dernier lot via ROW_NUMBER), silver (fonds, NAV, calendrier,
   depooling) et gold (par rapport), plus `data_model.html`.
5. Construire `reports/<key>/`, en commençant par `bcr_mouvements` et `bcr_coupons_dividendes`. Chaque
   rapport est autonome et porte le CLI complet (section 1).
6. Écrire `tools/check_independence.py`, qui vérifie qu'aucun rapport n'importe un autre dossier.
7. Rédiger le tour de tests : une capsule ou une commande unique qui fait tourner chaque rapport sur ses
   3 références au bureau, lance la comparaison cellule par cellule et ramène les verdicts dans un `.txt`.
8. Corriger, refaire un tour, puis rédiger les READMEs et la synthèse finale.

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/README.md =====
# reporting_v2

Rebuild of the LUXIS reports from MFGA_INFOCENTRE / MFGI via Dremio (read-only). Work in progress.

Office PC, current step: see `exchange/explorer/README.md` (run the explorer, then export `from_office.txt`).

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/capsule/inbox.py =====
"""Unpack from_office_NN.txt (office PC -> this PC) into exchange/inbox/NN/.

    python inbox.py /path/to/from_office_01.txt

Writes: status.json, log.txt, every "output <name>" section as <name>, and every packed file under
files/<original path with the drive letter as first folder>, after checking its sha256.
Prints a summary (outputs, files restored, checksum failures).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HEAD = re.compile(r"^===== (SECTION|FICHIER BASE64|SKIPPED TOO LARGE) : (.*?) =====$")


def safe_rel(win_path: str) -> Path:
    p = win_path.replace("\\", "/")
    p = re.sub(r"^([A-Za-z]):", r"\1_drive", p).lstrip("/")
    parts = [x for x in p.split("/") if x not in ("", ".", "..")]
    return Path(*parts)


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    src = Path((argv or sys.argv[1:])[0])
    m = re.search(r"from_office_(\w+)", src.name)
    dest = HERE.parent / "inbox" / (m.group(1) if m else src.stem)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = src.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    blocks, cur = [], None
    for ln in lines:
        h = HEAD.match(ln)
        if h:
            cur = [h.group(1), h.group(2), []]
            blocks.append(cur)
        elif cur is not None:
            cur[2].append(ln)
    n_out = n_files = 0
    bad, skipped = [], []
    for kind, title, body in blocks:
        if kind == "SECTION":
            name = {"status": "status.json", "log": "log.txt"}.get(title, title.replace("output ", "", 1))
            (dest / name).write_text("\n".join(body).rstrip() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            n_out += 1
        elif kind == "FICHIER BASE64":
            path, size, sha = [x.strip() for x in title.split("|")]
            raw = base64.b64decode("".join(body).strip())
            ok = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == sha.split()[-1]
            target = dest / "files" / safe_rel(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
            n_files += 1
            if not ok:
                bad.append(path)
        else:
            skipped.append(title)
    print(f"{src.name} -> {dest}")
    print(f"  sections: {n_out}   files restored: {n_files}   checksum failures: {len(bad)}   too large: {len(skipped)}")
    for b in bad:
        print("  CHECKSUM FAILED:", b)
    for s in skipped:
        print("  TOO LARGE (not packed):", s)
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/capsule/make_capsule.py =====
"""Build to_office_NN.txt (this PC -> office PC): office_runtime.py + an embedded, readable payload.

    python make_capsule.py manifest_NN.json            -> exchange/outbox/to_office_NN.txt

manifest_NN.json:
    {"round": "01", "title": "...", "message": "...",
     "files":  {"run_round.py": "../run_round.py", "round_01_requests.txt": "../round_01_requests.txt",
                "reports/": "../../reports"},                      # a folder entry copies the tree
     "steps":  [{"type": "queries", "file": "round_01_requests.txt", "envs": ["ctlq", "intg"]},
                {"type": "cmd", "argv": ["{python}", "run_tests.py", "test_round_01_commands.txt"]}],
     "collect": {"roots": ["Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"], "patterns": ["*\\\\*.pkb", ...],
                 "skip": ["*\\\\luxrep_exchange*"], "max_depth": 12, "max_mb": 30},
     "bring_back": ["test_round_01_results.txt"]}
Paths in "files" are relative to the manifest. Only text files can be embedded (code, sql, txt, json).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SKIP = {"__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".git", "out", ".venv", "venv"}


def embed(name: str, text: str) -> list[str]:
    if "\r" in text:
        text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    lines = [f"#|@@FILE {name}"]
    lines += ["#| " + ln for ln in text.split("\n")]
    lines.append("#|@@END")
    return lines


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    mpath = Path((argv or sys.argv[1:])[0]).resolve()
    m = json.loads(mpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload = {}
    for dst, src in m.get("files", {}).items():
        sp = (mpath.parent / src).resolve()
        if dst.endswith("/"):
            for f in sorted(sp.rglob("*")):
                if f.is_file() and not (SKIP & set(f.relative_to(sp).parts)) and f.suffix != ".pyc":
                    payload[dst + f.relative_to(sp).as_posix()] = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            payload[dst] = sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    meta = {k: v for k, v in m.items() if k != "files"}
    out_lines = [HERE.joinpath("office_runtime.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip("\n"), "",
                 "# ==== EMBEDDED PAYLOAD (read by the script above; plain text) ===="]
    out_lines += embed("manifest.json", json.dumps(meta, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
    for name, text in payload.items():
        out_lines += embed(name, text)
    outbox = HERE.parent / "outbox"
    outbox.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    out = outbox / f"to_office_{m['round']}.txt"
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(out_lines) + "\n")
    print(f"{out}  ({out.stat().st_size / 1024:.0f} KB, {len(payload)} files embedded)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/capsule/office_runtime.py =====
# ==== LUXREP EXCHANGE CAPSULE ======================================================================
# This .txt file is a Python script. On the office PC, in a terminal:
#
#     python to_office_NN.txt
#
# It never modifies anything outside its own work folder, sends nothing anywhere, and talks to Dremio
# only through dremio_sql.py (read-only guard unchanged). Steps (shown and confirmed one by one):
#   1. unpack the embedded files into .\luxrep_exchange\NN\  (scripts, requests, reports code, ...)
#   2. find dremio_sql.py, check the Dremio sessions (offers `login` if expired)
#   3. run the embedded steps (Dremio queries, tests, ...)
#   4. collect the files asked for (search + your confirmation; nothing is taken without it)
#   5. write ONE file  from_office_NN.txt  next to this capsule: that is the only file to bring back.
# Options: --yes (no confirmation), --skip-queries, --skip-files, --paths my_paths.txt,
#          --roots "C:\dir1;C:\dir2", --client C:\...\dremio_sql.py, --list (show content, run nothing)
# Re-running is safe: answered Dremio queries are cached, the return file is rebuilt.
# The embedded payload is plain text below (lines starting with "#|"), readable before running.
# ===================================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime as dt
import fnmatch
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ME = Path(__file__).resolve()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- payload
def read_payload() -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    files, manifest, cur, buf = {}, {}, None, []
    for line in ME.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("#|"):
            continue
        body = line[2:]
        if body.startswith("@@FILE "):
            cur, buf = body[7:].strip(), []
        elif body.startswith("@@END"):
            files[cur] = "\n".join(buf)
            cur = None
        elif cur is not None:
            buf.append(body[1:] if body.startswith(" ") else body)
    manifest = json.loads(files.pop("manifest.json"))
    return manifest, files


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
class Tee(io.TextIOBase):
    def __init__(self, *streams):
        self.streams = streams

    def write(self, s):
        for st in self.streams:
            try:
                st.write(s)
                st.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass
        return len(s)


def ask(question: str, auto: bool) -> bool:
    if auto:
        print(question + " [auto: yes]")
        return True
    ans = input(question + " [Y/n] ").strip().lower()
    return ans in ("", "y", "yes", "o", "oui")


def find_client(explicit: str | None, work: Path) -> Path | None:
    cands = []
    if explicit:
        cands.append(Path(explicit))
    if os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"):
        cands.append(Path(os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"]))
    for start in (ME.parent, Path.cwd(), work):
        for folder in (start, *start.parents):
            cands.append(folder / "dremio_sql.py")
    home = Path.home()
    for sub in ("Documents", "Desktop", "Downloads"):
        base = home / sub
        if base.is_dir():
            try:
                for p in base.rglob("dremio_sql.py"):
                    cands.append(p)
                    break
            except OSError:
                pass
    for c in cands:
        c = c / "dremio_sql.py" if c.is_dir() else c
        if c.is_file():
            return c.resolve()
    return None


def section(out, title: str, text: str):
    out.write(f"===== SECTION : {title} =====\n{text.rstrip()}\n\n")


def pack_file(out, f: Path, max_mb: float):
    size = f.stat().st_size
    if size > max_mb * 1024 * 1024:
        out.write(f"===== SKIPPED TOO LARGE : {f} | {size} bytes =====\n\n")
        return
    raw = f.read_bytes()
    out.write(f"===== FICHIER BASE64 : {f} | {size} bytes | sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()} =====\n")
    b = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")
    out.write("\n".join(b[i:i + 120] for i in range(0, len(b), 120)) + "\n\n")


def discover(roots: list[Path], patterns: list[str], skip: list[str], max_depth: int) -> list[Path]:
    found = []
    pats = [p.lower() for p in patterns]
    skips = [s.lower() for s in skip]
    for root in roots:
        if not root.is_dir():
            continue
        root_depth = len(root.parts)
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
            d = Path(dirpath)
            low = str(d).lower().replace("/", "\\")
            if len(d.parts) - root_depth >= max_depth or any(fnmatch.fnmatch(low, s) for s in skips):
                dirnames[:] = []
                continue
            dirnames[:] = [x for x in dirnames if x.lower() not in
                           ("appdata", "__pycache__", ".git", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "$recycle.bin")]
            for fn in filenames:
                full = str(d / fn).lower().replace("/", "\\")
                if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(full, p) for p in pats):
                    found.append(d / fn)
    return sorted(set(found))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- main
def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="LuxRep exchange capsule (office side).")
    ap.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-queries", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-files", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--paths", help="text file, one file or folder per line, to bring back as well")
    ap.add_argument("--roots", help="folders to search, separated by ;")
    ap.add_argument("--client", help="path to dremio_sql.py")
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    manifest, files = read_payload()
    nn = manifest["round"]
    print(f"capsule {nn}: {manifest.get('title', '')}")
    print(f"  {len(files)} embedded files, {len(manifest.get('steps', []))} steps, "
          f"{len(manifest.get('collect', {}).get('patterns', []))} file patterns to collect")
    if args.list:
        for name in files:
            print("   file:", name)
        for st in manifest.get("steps", []):
            print("   step:", st)
        return 0

    work = ME.parent / "luxrep_exchange" / nn
    ret = ME.parent / f"from_office_{nn}.txt"
    log_buf = io.StringIO()
    real_out = sys.stdout
    sys.stdout = Tee(real_out, log_buf)
    started = time.time()
    status = {}
    try:
        # 1. unpack
        work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name, text in files.items():
            dst = work / name
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dst.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[1] {len(files)} files unpacked into {work}")
        if manifest.get("message"):
            print("    message: " + manifest["message"])

        # 2. Dremio client and sessions
        client = find_client(args.client, work)
        needs_dremio = any(s["type"] in ("queries", "cmd_dremio") for s in manifest.get("steps", []))
        if client is None and needs_dremio and not args.skip_queries:
            print("[2] dremio_sql.py not found: give its path with --client C:\\...\\dremio_sql.py")
            status["dremio"] = "client not found"
        elif needs_dremio and not args.skip_queries:
            print(f"[2] dremio client: {client}")
            os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"] = str(client)
            if len(client.parents) < 4:
                print("    WARNING: dremio_sql.py must sit at least 4 folders deep (it reads parents[3])")
            envs = sorted({e for s in manifest["steps"] for e in s.get("envs", ["ctlq"])})
            for env in envs:
                probe = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(client), "probe", "--env", env],
                                       capture_output=True, text=True)
                ok = probe.returncode == 0
                print(f"    {env}: {'session OK' if ok else 'session NOT OK: ' + (probe.stderr or probe.stdout).strip()[:200]}")
                if not ok and ask(f"    run `login --env {env}` now?", False if not args.yes else True):
                    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(client), "login", "--env", env])
                status[f"session_{env}"] = "ok" if ok else "relogged"

        # 3. steps
        for i, st in enumerate(manifest.get("steps", []), 1):
            kind = st["type"]
            if kind in ("queries",) and args.skip_queries:
                print(f"[3.{i}] {kind} skipped (--skip-queries)")
                continue
            if kind == "queries":
                if client is None:
                    print(f"[3.{i}] queries not run: no dremio_sql.py")
                    continue
                print(f"[3.{i}] Dremio queries: {st['file']} (answered ones are cached; Ctrl+C keeps them)")
                cmd = [sys.executable, str(work / "run_round.py"), str(work / st["file"]),
                       "--client", str(client), "--workers", str(st.get("workers", 3))]
                rc = subprocess.run(cmd).returncode
                status[st["file"]] = f"exit {rc}"
            elif kind in ("cmd", "cmd_dremio"):
                print(f"[3.{i}] command: {' '.join(st['argv'])}  (in {work / st.get('cwd', '.')})")
                argv = [sys.executable if a == "{python}" else a for a in st["argv"]]
                rc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=work / st.get("cwd", ".")).returncode
                status[" ".join(st["argv"])] = f"exit {rc}"

        # 4. files to collect
        chosen: list[Path] = []
        col = manifest.get("collect", {})
        if not args.skip_files and (col.get("patterns") or args.paths):
            if col.get("patterns"):
                roots = ([Path(r) for r in args.roots.split(";") if r.strip()] if args.roots else
                         [Path.home() / x for x in col.get("roots", ["Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"])])
                print(f"[4] searching {len(col['patterns'])} patterns under: " + "; ".join(map(str, roots)))
                found = discover(roots, col["patterns"], col.get("skip", []), col.get("max_depth", 12))
                found = [f for f in found if work not in f.parents and f != ret and f != ME]
                cand = work / "found_files.txt"
                cand.write_text("# delete a line to leave the file out, add lines (files or folders) to add\n" +
                                "\n".join(str(f) for f in found) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
                print(f"    {len(found)} files found, list written to {cand}")
                for f in found[:60]:
                    print("      " + str(f))
                if len(found) > 60:
                    print(f"      ... ({len(found) - 60} more in the list file)")
                if not args.yes:
                    input(f"    edit {cand} if needed (Notepad), then press Enter to continue ")
                lines = cand.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                paths = [Path(x.strip()) for x in lines if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")]
            else:
                paths = []
            if args.paths:
                paths += [Path(x.strip()) for x in Path(args.paths).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                          if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")]
            for p in paths:
                if p.is_dir():
                    chosen += [f for f in sorted(p.rglob("*")) if f.is_file() and not
                               ({"__pycache__", ".git", "venv", ".venv"} & set(f.parts))]
                elif p.is_file():
                    chosen.append(p)
                else:
                    print(f"    not found, skipped: {p}")
            print(f"[4] {len(chosen)} files will be brought back")

        # 5. return file
        outputs = [work / o for o in manifest.get("bring_back", [])]
        outputs += sorted(work.glob("*_results.txt")) + sorted(work.glob("test_round_*_results.txt"))
        with open(ret, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
            out.write(f"# from_office_{nn}  generated {dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}  "
                      f"on {os.environ.get('COMPUTERNAME', '?')}  python {sys.version.split()[0]}\n")
            section(out, "status", json.dumps(status, indent=1))
            seen = set()
            for o in outputs:
                if o.is_file() and o not in seen:
                    seen.add(o)
                    section(out, f"output {o.name}", o.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            for f in chosen:
                pack_file(out, f, col.get("max_mb", 30))
            section(out, "log", log_buf.getvalue() + f"\nwall_s: {time.time() - started:.0f}")
        mb = ret.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024
        print(f"[5] DONE -> bring back this ONE file: {ret}  ({mb:.1f} MB)")
    finally:
        sys.stdout = real_out
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/explorer/README.md =====
# Dremio explorer (office PC)

Runs several thousand read-only queries on Dremio (catalogue, the 207 targeted requests of round 01,
a profile of every relevant table, LUXIS -> MFGA/MFGI matching). Everything is stored locally in
`explore.db`, then exported to ONE text file, `from_office.txt`, to bring back.

## Steps

1. Download the GitHub repository (Code > Download ZIP) and unzip it at least 4 folders deep, e.g.
   `C:\Users\padadmin\Documents\BA\reporting_v2`. Python 3.9+ and the standard library are enough.
2. Open a terminal in that `reporting_v2` folder and tell the explorer where `dremio_sql.py` is:
   `set LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT=C:\...\dremio_sql.py`
3. Sign in to both servers:
   `python C:\...\dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq` then `python C:\...\dremio_sql.py login --env intg`
4. Run (takes hours; it can be stopped and restarted at any time, done queries are kept):
   `python exchange\explorer\explore.py run`
   If the session expires, log in again and run the same command. `python exchange\explorer\explore.py status`
   shows progress. Options: `--max-minutes 120`, `--phase A,B`, `--workers 4`.
5. Export everything to one file, adding the folders still needed (see `exchange\round_00_files_needed.txt`):
   `python exchange\explorer\explore.py export --files C:\...\lxs-apps-oracle C:\...\references C:\...\reports_list.txt`
   (`--files` is optional; folders and single files can be mixed). The result is `reporting_v2\from_office.txt`.
6. Bring `from_office.txt` back.

## Privacy

The export contains table and column names, counts, min/max, codes and verdicts. Rows of register / client /
TA tables are not exported ("client-level rows not exported"), and personal columns (names, addresses, birth
dates, IBAN, ...) are replaced by `#`, including their min/max. The raw results stay in `explore.db`.

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/explorer/explore.py =====
"""Dremio explorer for the LUXIS exit (office PC). Thousands of read-only queries, results kept locally,
a short photo-friendly summary on screen.

    python explore.py run                 all phases (resumable: re-run = continue), default 4 workers
    python explore.py run --phase A,B     only some phases;  --max-minutes 240 to stop in time
    python explore.py status              progress per phase
    python explore.py pages               summary pages to PHOTOGRAPH (Enter = next, b = back, 12 = go to page 12, q = quit)
    python explore.py pages --section S4  one section only;  --lines 55 --width 150 to fit the screen
    python explore.py source --root C:\\...\\lxs-apps-oracle      pages of the LUXIS source still needed
    python explore.py export [--files DIR ...]  ONE .txt with every result (+ optional files) to bring back
    python explore.py sql R01_P004        show one query and its stored result (local only, not for photos)

Phases (each one generated from what the previous ones found):
    A  catalogue: tables + columns (with precision/scale) of MFGA_INFOCENTRE, MFGI, LUXIS, BUSINESS, ...
    B  the 207 targeted requests of round 01 (../round_01_requests.txt)
    C  profile of every relevant table: row counts (CTLQ and INTG), per-column non-null / approx distinct /
       min / max, value lists of code columns, 5-row samples (kept local), presence of the reference funds
    D  LUXIS -> MFGA/MFGI matching: candidate pairs by name and column overlap, then fingerprints of both
       sides on the same slice, compared column by column (also detects renamed columns)
Everything is stored in explore.db (SQLite, next to this script). Nothing leaves the PC except
from_office.txt (explore.py export). The pages and the export never show client data: in register/client/TA tables, and for personal columns
(names, addresses, birth dates, IBAN, ...) values are masked; only names of tables/columns, counts,
codes and verdicts are printed.

dremio_sql.py: --client PATH, else LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT, else the parent folders. Standard library only.
"""

NAMEY_COL = re.compile(r"(NAME|NOM|LIB|LABEL|L_|CITY|VILLE|CLIENT|HOLDER)", re.I)


def masked(table: str, col: str) -> bool:
    if PERSONAL_COL.search(col or ""):
        return True
    return bool(SENSITIVE_TABLE.search(table or "")) and bool(NAMEY_COL.search(col or ""))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
def qid_quote(name: str) -> str:
    return '"' + name.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def path_quote(schema: str, table: str) -> str:
    return ".".join(qid_quote(p) for p in schema.split(".")) + "." + qid_quote(table)


def short_type(t: str, p, s) -> str:
    t = (t or "").upper()
    m = {"CHARACTER VARYING": "V", "VARCHAR": "V", "CHAR": "C", "CHARACTER": "C", "INTEGER": "I", "INT": "I",
         "BIGINT": "BI", "SMALLINT": "SI", "DOUBLE": "F8", "FLOAT": "F4", "REAL": "F4", "DATE": "DT",
         "TIMESTAMP": "TS", "TIME": "TM", "BOOLEAN": "BO", "DECIMAL": "D", "NUMERIC": "D", "VARBINARY": "BIN"}
    k = m.get(t, t[:6])
    if k == "D" and p is not None:
        return f"D{p},{s if s is not None else 0}"
    return k


def profilable(t: str) -> bool:
    t = (t or "").upper()
    return not any(x in t for x in ("BOOLEAN", "BINARY", "STRUCT", "LIST", "MAP", "ARRAY", "UNION", "INTERVAL", "NULL"))


def fmt_val(v, width=22) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return "-"
    if isinstance(v, float):
        s = repr(v) if abs(v) < 1e15 else f"{v:.6g}"
    else:
        s = str(v)
    s = s.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
    return s if len(s) <= width else s[:width - 1] + "~"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ store
class Store:
    def __init__(self, path: Path):
        self.con = sqlite3.connect(str(path), check_same_thread=False)
        self.con.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS q (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, phase TEXT, purpose TEXT, env TEXT,
            sql TEXT, status TEXT, columns TEXT, rows TEXT, total INTEGER, error TEXT, elapsed REAL, ts TEXT,
            meta TEXT)""")
        self.con.commit()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def done(self, qid: str, sql: str) -> bool:
        r = self.con.execute("SELECT status, sql FROM q WHERE id = ?", (qid,)).fetchone()
        return bool(r) and r[0] == "OK" and r[1] == sql

    def save(self, item: dict, res: dict):
        with self.lock:
            self.con.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO q VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (
                item["id"], item["phase"], item.get("purpose", ""), item["env"], item["sql"], res["status"],
                json.dumps(res.get("columns")), json.dumps(res.get("rows"), default=str), res.get("total"),
                res.get("error"), res.get("elapsed"), dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                json.dumps(item.get("meta", {}), default=str)))
            self.con.commit()

    def get(self, qid: str):
        r = self.con.execute("SELECT status, columns, rows, total, error, meta, sql, purpose, env FROM q WHERE id = ?",
                             (qid,)).fetchone()
        if not r:
            return None
        return {"status": r[0], "columns": json.loads(r[1] or "null"), "rows": json.loads(r[2] or "null"),
                "total": r[3], "error": r[4], "meta": json.loads(r[5] or "{}"), "sql": r[6], "purpose": r[7],
                "env": r[8]}

    def ids(self, prefix: str) -> list[str]:
        return [r[0] for r in self.con.execute("SELECT id FROM q WHERE id LIKE ? ORDER BY id", (prefix + "%",))]

    def stats(self):
        return self.con.execute("SELECT phase, status, COUNT(*), SUM(elapsed) FROM q GROUP BY phase, status "
                                "ORDER BY phase, status").fetchall()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ dremio
def load_client(explicit: str | None):
    cands = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else []
    if os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"):
        cands.append(Path(os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"]))
    for start in (HERE, Path.cwd()):
        cands += [f / "dremio_sql.py" for f in (start, *start.parents)]
    for c in cands:
        c = c / "dremio_sql.py" if c.is_dir() else c
        if c.is_file():
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dremio_sql", c)
            mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
            print(f"dremio client: {c}")
            return mod
    sys.exit("explore: dremio_sql.py not found (--client PATH or LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT)")


class Runner:
    def __init__(self, mod, store: Store, workers: int, deadline: float | None):
        self.mod, self.store, self.workers, self.deadline = mod, store, workers, deadline
        self.local = threading.local()
        self.auth_failed = threading.Event()

    def _client(self, env):
        cache = getattr(self.local, "c", None)
        if cache is None:
            cache = self.local.c = {}
        if env not in cache:
            cache[env] = self.mod.Client(env=env)
        return cache[env]

    def _one(self, item):
        if self.auth_failed.is_set() or (self.deadline and time.time() > self.deadline):
            return None
        problem = self.mod.read_only_problem(item["sql"])
        if problem:
            return {"status": "ERROR", "error": "refused by guard: " + problem, "elapsed": 0}
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            job, cols, rows, total = self._client(item["env"]).query(item["sql"], item.get("max_rows", 500),
                                                                     item.get("timeout", 600))
            return {"status": "OK", "columns": cols, "rows": rows, "total": int(total), "elapsed": time.time() - t0}
        except Exception as exc:
            msg = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            if "HTTP 401" in msg or "no Dremio" in msg:
                self.auth_failed.set()
            return {"status": "ERROR", "error": msg[:1500], "elapsed": time.time() - t0}

    def run(self, items: list[dict], label: str):
        todo = [i for i in items if not self.store.done(i["id"], i["sql"])]
        print(f"  {label}: {len(items)} queries, {len(items) - len(todo)} already done, {len(todo)} to run", flush=True)
        if not todo:
            return
        n_ok = n_err = 0
        t0 = time.time()
        with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.workers) as pool:
            futs = {pool.submit(self._one, i): i for i in todo}
            for k, f in enumerate(cf.as_completed(futs), 1):
                item, res = futs[f], f.result()
                if res is None:
                    continue
                self.store.save(item, res)
                n_ok += res["status"] == "OK"
                n_err += res["status"] == "ERROR"
                if k % 25 == 0 or k == len(todo):
                    print(f"    {k}/{len(todo)}  ok {n_ok}  error {n_err}  {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
        if self.auth_failed.is_set():
            raise SystemExit("Dremio session expired: run `python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq` (and intg), "
                             "then the same command again (done queries are kept).")
        if self.deadline and time.time() > self.deadline:
            raise SystemExit("time limit reached: run the same command again to continue.")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ catalogue access
class Catalog:
    def __init__(self, store: Store):
        self.tables = {}     # (schema, table) -> type
        self.cols = {}       # (schema, table) -> [(name, type, p, s)]
        for qid in store.ids("A_TAB_"):
            r = store.get(qid)
            if r and r["status"] == "OK":
                for row in r["rows"]:
                    self.tables[(row["TABLE_SCHEMA"], row["TABLE_NAME"])] = row.get("TABLE_TYPE")
        for qid in store.ids("A_COL_"):
            r = store.get(qid)
            if r and r["status"] == "OK":
                for row in r["rows"]:
                    k = (row["TABLE_SCHEMA"], row["TABLE_NAME"])
                    self.cols.setdefault(k, []).append((int(row["ORDINAL_POSITION"] or 0), row["COLUMN_NAME"],
                                                        row["DATA_TYPE"], row.get("NUMERIC_PRECISION"),
                                                        row.get("NUMERIC_SCALE")))
        for k in self.cols:
            self.cols[k] = [c[1:] for c in sorted(self.cols[k])]

    def colnames(self, key):
        return [c[0] for c in self.cols.get(key, [])]

    def find(self, schema: str, table: str):
        for k in self.tables:
            if k[0].upper() == schema.upper() and k[1].upper() == table.upper():
                return k
        for k in self.cols:
            if k[0].upper() == schema.upper() and k[1].upper() == table.upper():
                return k
        return None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ phase A
def phase_a(run: Runner):
    items = []
    for root in CATALOG_ROOTS:
        items.append({"id": f"A_TAB_{root}", "phase": "A", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 200000, "timeout": 1800,
                      "purpose": f"tables under {root}",
                      "sql": f"""SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{root}' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE '{root}.%'"""})
    items.append({"id": "A_TAB_INTG_MFGA_INFOCENTRE", "phase": "A", "env": "intg", "max_rows": 200000,
                  "timeout": 1800, "purpose": "tables on INTG (MFGA_INFOCENTRE + MFGI + LUXIS)",
                  "sql": """SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE%' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGI%' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'LUXIS%'"""})
    run.run(items, "A1 catalogue")
    schemas = set()
    for root in CATALOG_ROOTS:
        r = run.store.get(f"A_TAB_{root}")
        if r and r["status"] == "OK":
            schemas |= {row["TABLE_SCHEMA"] for row in r["rows"]}
    wanted = sorted(s for s in schemas if any(s == c or s.startswith(c + ".") for c in COLUMN_ROOTS))
    items = []
    for s in wanted:
        items.append({"id": f"A_COL_{s}", "phase": "A", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 600000, "timeout": 1800,
                      "purpose": f"columns of every table in {s}",
                      "sql": f"""SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE,
       NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS" WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{s}'"""})
    run.run(items, f"A2 columns ({len(wanted)} schemas)")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ phase B
def parse_requests(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    out, cur = [], None
    head = re.compile(r"^\s*--\s*@(\w+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$")
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n"):
        m = head.match(line)
        if m and m.group(1) == "id":
            cur = {"id": m.group(2), "phase": "B", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 500, "timeout": 900, "lines": []}
            out.append(cur)
        elif cur is not None and m and not cur["lines"]:
            k, v = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            cur[k] = int(v) if k in ("max_rows", "timeout") else v
        elif cur is not None:
            cur["lines"].append(line)
    for c in out:
        c["sql"] = "\n".join(c.pop("lines")).strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    return out


def phase_b(run: Runner):
    if not REQ01.is_file():
        print(f"  B skipped: {REQ01} not found")
        return
    run.run(parse_requests(REQ01), "B round 01 targeted requests")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ phase C
def profile_targets(cat: Catalog) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    keys = []
    for (s, t) in cat.cols:
        su, tu = s.upper(), t.upper()
        if su == "LUXIS.REPADMIN" and (tu in LUXIS_TARGETS or tu.startswith(LUXIS_TARGET_PREFIXES)):
            keys.append((s, t))
        elif su in [x.upper() for x in MFGA_PROFILE_SCHEMAS]:
            keys.append((s, t))
        elif su.startswith("MFGI"):
            keys.append((s, t))
        elif su == "BUSINESS.FUND_ACCOUNTING":
            keys.append((s, t))
    return sorted(set(keys))


def slug(s: str, t: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", f"{s}__{t}")


def source_expr(cat: Catalog, key, count) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """FROM expression (full table or a slice) and a label."""
    full = path_quote(*key)
    cols = {c.upper(): c for c in cat.colnames(key)}
    if count is not None and count <= FULL_SCAN_MAX_ROWS:
        return full, "full"
    conds, label = [], []
    if "N_LOT" in cols and "C_FUND" in cols:
        conds.append(f"{qid_quote(cols['N_LOT'])} > {LOT_WINDOW[0]} AND {qid_quote(cols['N_LOT'])} <= {LOT_WINDOW[1]}")
        label.append("lots Jun26")
    elif "D_NAV" in cols:
        conds.append(f"{qid_quote(cols['D_NAV'])} > DATE '{DATE_WINDOW[0]}' AND {qid_quote(cols['D_NAV'])} <= DATE '{DATE_WINDOW[1]}'")
        label.append("dnav Jun26")
    if "C_FUND" in cols and count is not None and count > 50 * FULL_SCAN_MAX_ROWS:
        conds.append(f"CAST({qid_quote(cols['C_FUND'])} AS VARCHAR) IN ({','.join(repr(f) for f in REF_FUNDS)})")
        label.append("ref funds")
    where = (" WHERE " + " AND ".join(conds)) if conds else ""
    return f"(SELECT * FROM {full}{where} LIMIT {SLICE_LIMIT}) zz", "slice:" + ("+".join(label) or "first rows") + f"<= {SLICE_LIMIT}"


def stats_sql(src: str, cols: list[tuple], distinct: bool) -> str:
    parts = ['COUNT(*) AS "zz_n"']
    for i, (name, _t, _p, _s) in enumerate(cols):
        q = qid_quote(name)
        parts += [f'COUNT({q}) AS "nn_{i}"', f'MIN({q}) AS "mn_{i}"', f'MAX({q}) AS "mx_{i}"']
        if distinct:
            parts.append(f'APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT({q}) AS "nd_{i}"')
    return "SELECT " + ", ".join(parts) + f" FROM {src}"


def phase_c(run: Runner):
    store = run.store
    cat = Catalog(store)
    keys = profile_targets(cat)
    print(f"  C: {len(keys)} tables to profile")
    # C1 row counts (CTLQ + INTG for the report tables)
    items = []
    for k in keys:
        items.append({"id": f"C1_{slug(*k)}", "phase": "C", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 1, "timeout": 600,
                      "purpose": f"row count {k[0]}.{k[1]}", "meta": {"key": k},
                      "sql": f'SELECT COUNT(*) AS "zz_n" FROM {path_quote(*k)}'})
        if k[0].upper() == "LUXIS.REPADMIN" or k[0].upper() == "MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH":
            items.append({"id": f"C1I_{slug(*k)}", "phase": "C", "env": "intg", "max_rows": 1, "timeout": 600,
                          "purpose": f"row count on INTG {k[0]}.{k[1]}", "meta": {"key": k},
                          "sql": f'SELECT COUNT(*) AS "zz_n" FROM {path_quote(*k)}'})
    run.run(items, "C1 row counts")
    counts = {}
    for k in keys:
        r = store.get(f"C1_{slug(*k)}")
        counts[k] = int(r["rows"][0]["zz_n"]) if r and r["status"] == "OK" and r["rows"] else None
    # C2 column stats by chunk (with approx distinct, fallback without)
    items, plan = [], {}
    for k in keys:
        src, label = source_expr(cat, k, counts[k])
        cols = [c for c in cat.cols[k] if profilable(c[1])]
        plan[k] = (src, label, cols)
        for ci in range(0, len(cols), CHUNK_COLS):
            chunk = cols[ci:ci + CHUNK_COLS]
            items.append({"id": f"C2_{slug(*k)}_{ci // CHUNK_COLS}", "phase": "C", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 1,
                          "timeout": 900, "purpose": f"column stats {k[0]}.{k[1]} [{label}]",
                          "meta": {"key": k, "label": label, "cols": [c[0] for c in chunk]},
                          "sql": stats_sql(src, chunk, True)})
        items.append({"id": f"C5_{slug(*k)}", "phase": "C", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 5, "timeout": 600,
                      "purpose": f"5-row sample {k[0]}.{k[1]} (local only)", "meta": {"key": k},
                      "sql": f"SELECT * FROM {src} LIMIT 5" if src.startswith("(") else f"SELECT * FROM {src} LIMIT 5"})
        names = {c.upper(): c for c in cat.colnames(k)}
        if "C_FUND" in names:
            cf_ = qid_quote(names["C_FUND"])
            extra = f', MIN({qid_quote(names["N_LOT"])}) AS "lot_min", MAX({qid_quote(names["N_LOT"])}) AS "lot_max"' \
                if "N_LOT" in names else ""
            items.append({"id": f"C6_{slug(*k)}", "phase": "C", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 100, "timeout": 900,
                          "purpose": f"reference funds present in {k[0]}.{k[1]}", "meta": {"key": k},
                          "sql": f"SELECT CAST({cf_} AS VARCHAR) AS \"fund\", COUNT(*) AS \"n\"{extra} FROM {path_quote(*k)} "
                                 f"WHERE CAST({cf_} AS VARCHAR) IN ({','.join(repr(f) for f in REF_FUNDS)}) GROUP BY 1"})
    run.run(items, "C2 column stats + C5 samples + C6 reference funds")
    retry = []
    for it in items:
        if not it["id"].startswith("C2_"):
            continue
        r = store.get(it["id"])
        if r and r["status"] == "ERROR":
            k = tuple(it["meta"]["key"])
            src, label, cols = plan[k]
            chunk = [c for c in cols if c[0] in it["meta"]["cols"]]
            retry.append(dict(it, id=it["id"].replace("C2_", "C2B_"), sql=stats_sql(src, chunk, False),
                              purpose=it["purpose"] + " (no approx distinct)"))
    run.run(retry, "C2B stats retry without approx distinct")
    single = []
    for it in retry:
        r = store.get(it["id"])
        if r and r["status"] == "ERROR":
            k = tuple(it["meta"]["key"])
            src, label, cols = plan[k]
            for c in [c for c in cols if c[0] in it["meta"]["cols"]]:
                single.append({"id": f"C2C_{slug(*k)}_{re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '_', c[0])}", "phase": "C",
                               "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 1, "timeout": 600, "purpose": f"single column stats {c[0]}",
                               "meta": {"key": k, "label": label, "cols": [c[0]]},
                               "sql": stats_sql(src, [c], False)})
    run.run(single, "C2C single-column stats (isolating failing columns)")
    # C4 value lists of code columns
    prof = collect_profiles(store)
    items = []
    for k in keys:
        src, label, cols = plan[k]
        lows = [c for c, st in prof.get(k, {}).items()
                if st.get("nd") is not None and 0 < st["nd"] <= TOPVAL_MAX_DISTINCT and not PERSONAL_COL.search(c)]
        for c in lows[:TOPVAL_MAX_COLS]:
            q = qid_quote(c)
            items.append({"id": f"C4_{slug(*k)}_{re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '_', c)}", "phase": "C", "env": "ctlq",
                          "max_rows": TOPVAL_MAX_DISTINCT + 1, "timeout": 900, "meta": {"key": k, "col": c, "label": label},
                          "purpose": f"values of {k[1]}.{c} [{label}]",
                          "sql": f'SELECT {q} AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM {src} GROUP BY {q} ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT {TOPVAL_MAX_DISTINCT + 1}'})
    run.run(items, "C4 value lists of code columns")


def collect_profiles(store: Store) -> dict:
    prof = {}
    for prefix in ("C2_", "C2B_", "C2C_"):
        for qid in store.ids(prefix):
            r = store.get(qid)
            if not r or r["status"] != "OK" or not r["rows"]:
                continue
            k = tuple(r["meta"]["key"])
            row = r["rows"][0]
            d = prof.setdefault(k, {})
            for i, c in enumerate(r["meta"]["cols"]):
                cur = d.setdefault(c, {"label": r["meta"].get("label")})
                cur["n"] = row.get("zz_n")
                cur["nn"] = row.get(f"nn_{i}")
                cur["mn"] = row.get(f"mn_{i}")
                cur["mx"] = row.get(f"mx_{i}")
                if row.get(f"nd_{i}") is not None:
                    cur["nd"] = row.get(f"nd_{i}")
    return prof


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ phase D
def candidate_pairs(cat: Catalog, counts: dict) -> list[tuple]:
    lux = [k for k in cat.cols if k[0].upper() == "LUXIS.REPADMIN" and
           (k[1].upper() in LUXIS_TARGETS or k[1].upper().startswith(LUXIS_TARGET_PREFIXES))]
    oth = [k for k in cat.cols if k[0].upper().startswith(("MFGA_INFOCENTRE.", "MFGI"))]
    oth_sets = {k: {c.upper() for c in cat.colnames(k)} for k in oth}
    pairs = []
    for L in lux:
        ls = {c.upper() for c in cat.colnames(L)}
        name = L[1].upper()
        scored = []
        for M, ms in oth_sets.items():
            j = len(ls & ms) / max(1, len(ls | ms))
            mn = M[1].upper()
            rule = (name.startswith("DWH_AMS_") and mn == name[4:]) or \
                   (name.startswith("DWH_AMS_") and mn == name[4:].replace("SEC_", "SECURITIES_")) or \
                   (name.startswith("DWT_GTA_") and M[0].upper().startswith("MFGI") and
                    (mn == name[8:] or mn.startswith(name[8:]) or name[8:].startswith(mn))) or \
                   (mn == name and not M[0].upper().startswith("MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH"))
            if rule or j >= 0.25:
                scored.append((1.0 if rule else 0.0, j, M))
        scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1]))
        for r_, j, M in scored[:4]:
            pairs.append((L, M, round(j, 3), bool(r_)))
    return pairs


def common_slice(cat: Catalog, L, M, counts) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
    lc = {c.upper(): c for c in cat.colnames(L)}
    mc = {c.upper(): c for c in cat.colnames(M)}
    funds = ",".join(repr(f) for f in REF_FUNDS)
    if "C_FUND" in lc and "C_FUND" in mc and "N_LOT" in lc and "N_LOT" in mc:
        w = lambda c: (f"WHERE CAST({qid_quote(c['C_FUND'])} AS VARCHAR) IN ({funds}) AND {qid_quote(c['N_LOT'])} > "
                       f"{LOT_WINDOW[0]} AND {qid_quote(c['N_LOT'])} <= {LOT_WINDOW[1]}")
        return w(lc), w(mc), "ref funds + lots Jun26"
    if "C_FUND" in lc and "C_FUND" in mc:
        w = lambda c: f"WHERE CAST({qid_quote(c['C_FUND'])} AS VARCHAR) IN ({funds})"
        return w(lc), w(mc), "ref funds"
    nl, nm = counts.get(L), counts.get(M)
    if nl is not None and nm is not None and nl <= 20_000_000 and nm <= 20_000_000:
        return "", "", "full tables"
    return None


def phase_d(run: Runner):
    store = run.store
    cat = Catalog(store)
    counts = {}
    for k in cat.cols:
        r = store.get(f"C1_{slug(*k)}")
        counts[k] = int(r["rows"][0]["zz_n"]) if r and r["status"] == "OK" and r["rows"] else None
    pairs = candidate_pairs(cat, counts)
    bad_cols = set()
    for qid in store.ids("C2C_"):
        r = store.get(qid)
        if r and r["status"] == "ERROR":
            bad_cols.add((tuple(r["meta"]["key"]), r["meta"]["cols"][0]))
    print(f"  D: {len(pairs)} candidate pairs LUXIS -> MFGA/MFGI ({len(bad_cols)} unprofilable columns left out)")
    items = []
    for L, M, j, rule in pairs:
        sl = common_slice(cat, L, M, counts)
        if sl is None:
            continue
        pid = f"{slug(*L)}__TO__{slug(*M)}"
        for side, key, where in (("L", L, sl[0]), ("M", M, sl[1])):
            cols = [c for c in cat.cols[key] if profilable(c[1]) and (tuple(key), c[0]) not in bad_cols]
            for ci in range(0, len(cols), CHUNK_COLS):
                chunk = cols[ci:ci + CHUNK_COLS]
                parts = ['COUNT(*) AS "zz_n"']
                for i, (name, t, _p, _s) in enumerate(chunk):
                    q = qid_quote(name)
                    parts += [f'COUNT({q}) AS "nn_{i}"', f'COUNT(DISTINCT {q}) AS "nd_{i}"', f'MIN({q}) AS "mn_{i}"',
                              f'MAX({q}) AS "mx_{i}"']
                items.append({"id": f"D_{pid}_{side}{ci // CHUNK_COLS}", "phase": "D", "env": "ctlq", "max_rows": 1,
                              "timeout": 900, "purpose": f"fingerprint {side} {key[1]} [{sl[2]}]",
                              "meta": {"pair": [list(L), list(M)], "side": side, "key": key, "cols": [c[0] for c in chunk],
                                       "slice": sl[2], "jaccard": j, "rule": rule},
                              "sql": "SELECT " + ", ".join(parts) + f" FROM {path_quote(*key)} {where}"})
    run.run(items, "D fingerprints of candidate pairs")


def fingerprints(store: Store) -> dict:
    out = {}
    for qid in store.ids("D_"):
        r = store.get(qid)
        if not r or r["status"] != "OK" or not r["rows"]:
            continue
        m = r["meta"]
        pk = (tuple(m["pair"][0]), tuple(m["pair"][1]))
        d = out.setdefault(pk, {"L": {}, "M": {}, "slice": m["slice"], "jaccard": m["jaccard"], "rule": m["rule"]})
        row = r["rows"][0]
        for i, c in enumerate(m["cols"]):
            d[m["side"]][c] = (row.get("zz_n"), row.get(f"nn_{i}"), row.get(f"nd_{i}"), str(row.get(f"mn_{i}")),
                               str(row.get(f"mx_{i}")))
    return out


def compare_pair(fp: dict) -> dict:
    L, M = fp["L"], fp["M"]
    nL = next(iter(L.values()))[0] if L else None
    nM = next(iter(M.values()))[0] if M else None
    same, diff, renamed = [], [], []
    for c, sig in L.items():
        if c in M:
            (same if sig[1:] == M[c][1:] else diff).append(c)
    used = set(same)
    for c, sig in L.items():
        if c in same or sig[1] in (0, None) or (sig[2] is not None and sig[2] < 2) or sig[3] == sig[4]:
            continue
        hits = [mc for mc, ms in M.items() if mc not in used and ms[1:] == sig[1:] and mc != c]
        if len(hits) == 1:
            renamed.append((c, hits[0]))
            used.add(hits[0])
    return {"nL": nL, "nM": nM, "same": same, "diff": diff, "renamed": renamed, "nLcols": len(L), "nMcols": len(M)}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ pages
class Pager:
    def __init__(self, width: int, lines: int):
        self.width, self.lines = width, lines
        self.sections = []           # (code, title, [lines])

    def add(self, code: str, title: str, lines: list[str]):
        self.sections.append((code, title, lines))

    def build(self, only: str | None = None) -> list[list[str]]:
        pages = []
        stamp = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        body_h = self.lines - 2
        for code, title, lines in self.sections:
            if only and code not in only.split(","):
                continue
            wrapped = []
            for ln in lines:
                while len(ln) > self.width - 4:
                    wrapped.append(ln[:self.width - 4])
                    ln = "  " + ln[self.width - 4:]
                wrapped.append(ln)
            chunks = [wrapped[i:i + body_h] for i in range(0, max(1, len(wrapped)), body_h)] or [[]]
            for ci, ch in enumerate(chunks):
                pages.append((code, title, ci + 1, len(chunks), ch))
        out = []
        for n, (code, title, ci, cn, ch) in enumerate(pages, 1):
            head = f"PAGE {n:03d}/{len(pages):03d}  {code} {title} ({ci}/{cn})  {stamp}"
            body = [f"{ln:<{self.width - 4}}|{line_crc(ln)}" for ln in ch]
            out.append([head, "-" * (self.width)] + body)
        return out


def line_crc(ln: str) -> str:
    """2-hex checksum of the line without any whitespace (robust to spaces lost on a photo)."""
    bare = re.sub(r"\s", "", ln)
    return "%02x" % (zlib.crc32(bare.encode("utf-8")) & 0xff)


def esc_cell(v, table, col, width=20):
    if masked(table, col):
        return "#"
    return fmt_val(v, width)


def build_pages(store: Store, width: int, lines: int) -> Pager:
    pg = Pager(width, lines)
    cat = Catalog(store)
    # S1 status
    st = ["phase status  n  seconds"] + [f"{p:<5} {s:<6} {n:>6} {int(e or 0):>8}" for p, s, n, e in store.stats()]
    for env in ("ctlq", "intg"):
        r = store.get("R01_M02" + ("3" if env == "ctlq" else "4"))
        if r and r["status"] == "OK" and r["rows"]:
            st.append(f"freshness {env}: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={fmt_val(v, 25)}" for k, v in r["rows"][0].items()))
    pg.add("S1", "RUN STATUS", st)
    # S2 catalogue per schema
    per = {}
    for (s, t), typ in cat.tables.items():
        per.setdefault(s, [0, 0])
        per[s][0 if (typ or "").upper().startswith("TABLE") else 1] += 1
    s2 = ["schema  tables  views"] + [f"{s}  {a}  {b}" for s, (a, b) in sorted(per.items())]
    intg = store.get("A_TAB_INTG_MFGA_INFOCENTRE")
    if intg and intg["status"] == "OK":
        intg_set = {(r["TABLE_SCHEMA"], r["TABLE_NAME"]) for r in intg["rows"]}
        miss = sorted(f"{s}.{t}" for (s, t) in cat.tables if s.upper().startswith(("MFGA_INFOCENTRE", "MFGI", "LUXIS.REPADMIN"))
                      and (s, t) not in intg_set and (t.upper() in LUXIS_TARGETS or s.upper().startswith(("MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH", "MFGI"))))
        s2.append(f"on CTLQ but not on INTG ({len(miss)}): " + ", ".join(miss[:300]))
    pg.add("S2", "CATALOGUE", s2)
    # S3 errors (all phases, compact)
    errs = store.con.execute("SELECT id, error FROM q WHERE status = 'ERROR' ORDER BY id").fetchall()
    s3 = [i + ": " + re.sub(r"\s+", " ", e or "")[:width - len(i) - 8] for i, e in errs[:600]]
    pg.add("S3", f"ERRORS ({len(errs)})", s3 or ["none"])
    # S4 round 01 digests
    s4 = []
    skip_rows = re.compile(r"^R01_(A00[1-4]|C00\d)$")
    caps = {"P": 400, "W": 3, "N": 60, "B": 40, "F": 45, "D": 15, "G": 30, "R": 5, "M": 25, "E": 20, "X": 40, "A": 60}
    for qid in store.ids("R01_"):
        r = store.get(qid)
        sens = bool(SENSITIVE_TABLE.search(r["sql"] or ""))
        s4.append(f"== {qid} [{r['status']}] {r['purpose'][:width - 30]}")
        if r["status"] != "OK":
            s4.append("   err: " + re.sub(r"\s+", " ", r["error"] or "")[:width - 12])
            continue
        cols = r["columns"] or []
        s4.append(f"   rows {len(r['rows'] or [])}/{r['total']}  cols: " + ",".join(cols))
        if skip_rows.match(qid):
            continue
        cap = caps.get(qid[4], 15)
        tbl = "SENSITIVE" if sens else ""
        aggregate = bool(re.search(r"\b(GROUP\s+BY|COUNT\s*\(|SUM\s*\(|LISTAGG)", r["sql"] or "", re.I)) and \
            not re.search(r"\bSELECT\s+(\w+\.)?\*", r["sql"] or "", re.I)
        if sens and not aggregate:
            zz = {c: v for c, v in ((r["rows"] or [{}])[0] if r["rows"] else {}).items() if c.upper().startswith("ZZ_")}
            s4.append("   (client-level rows not shown) " + " ".join(f"{c}={fmt_val(v)}" for c, v in zz.items()))
            continue
        for row in (r["rows"] or [])[:cap]:
            cells = []
            for c in cols:
                v = row.get(c)
                if sens and not isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not re.match(r"^(N|NB|COUNT|ZZ_|N_|LOT|MIN|MAX)", c, re.I):
                    cells.append("#")
                else:
                    cells.append(esc_cell(v, tbl, c))
            s4.append("   " + "|".join(cells))
        if len(r["rows"] or []) > cap:
            s4.append(f"   ... {len(r['rows']) - cap} more rows (local)")
    pg.add("S4", "ROUND 01 RESULTS", s4 or ["phase B not run"])
    # S5 columns of the tables that matter
    prof = collect_profiles(store)
    paired = {M for (_L, M) in fingerprints(store)}
    keys = [k for k in cat.cols if (k[0].upper() == "LUXIS.REPADMIN" and k[1].upper() in LUXIS_TARGETS)
            or (k[0].upper() == "LUXIS.REPADMIN" and k[1].upper().startswith(("WRK_QUERIES_", "LUXREP_")))
            or (k[0].upper() == "MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH" and (k[1].upper() in USED_MFGA or
                                                         k[1].upper().startswith(USED_MFGA_PREFIXES)))
            or (k[0].upper().startswith("MFGI") and re.search(MFGI_KEYWORDS, k[1], re.I))
            or k in paired]
    s5 = []
    for k in sorted(keys):
        r = store.get(f"C1_{slug(*k)}")
        ri = store.get(f"C1I_{slug(*k)}")
        n = r["rows"][0]["zz_n"] if r and r["status"] == "OK" and r["rows"] else "?"
        ni = ri["rows"][0]["zz_n"] if ri and ri["status"] == "OK" and ri["rows"] else "-"
        cols = ", ".join(f"{c} {short_type(t, p, s)}" for c, t, p, s in cat.cols[k])
        s5.append(f"{k[0]}.{k[1]} rows={n} intg={ni}: {cols}")
    pg.add("S5", "COLUMNS (name type; V varchar, D p,s decimal, DT date, TS timestamp)", s5)
    # S6 code values
    s6 = []
    for qid in store.ids("C4_"):
        r = store.get(qid)
        if not r or r["status"] != "OK":
            continue
        k, c = tuple(r["meta"]["key"]), r["meta"]["col"]
        if not (k[0].upper() in ("LUXIS.REPADMIN", "MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH") or k[0].upper().startswith("MFGI")):
            continue
        rows = r["rows"] or []
        vals = ",".join(f"{'#' if masked(k[1], c) else fmt_val(x['v'], 14)}={x['n']}" for x in rows[:TOPVAL_MAX_DISTINCT])
        s6.append(f"{k[1]}.{c}{'+' if len(rows) > TOPVAL_MAX_DISTINCT else ''}: {vals}")
    pg.add("S6", "CODE VALUES (value=count, on profile scope)", s6 or ["phase C not run"])
    # S7 matching
    s7 = []
    for (L, M), fp in sorted(fingerprints(store).items()):
        cp = compare_pair(fp)
        ren = ",".join(f"{a}>{b}" for a, b in cp["renamed"])
        s7.append(f"{L[1]} -> {M[0]}.{M[1]} [{fp['slice']}] rows {cp['nL']}/{cp['nM']} jac {fp['jaccard']} "
                  f"same {len(cp['same'])}/{cp['nLcols']} diff {len(cp['diff'])}"
                  + (f" diffcols:{','.join(cp['diff'][:25])}" if cp["diff"] else "") + (f" renamed:{ren}" if ren else ""))
    pg.add("S7", "LUXIS -> MFGA/MFGI MATCHING (same = identical count/distinct/min/max)", s7 or ["phase D not run"])
    # S8 profiles of the LUXIS targets and their MFGA twins (one line per table)
    s8 = []
    for k in sorted(keys):
        p = prof.get(k, {})
        if not p:
            continue
        label = next(iter(p.values())).get("label")
        nulls = [c for c, v in p.items() if v.get("nn") == 0]
        lot = p.get("N_LOT") or {}
        dn = p.get("D_NAV") or {}
        s8.append(f"{k[1]} [{label}] n={next(iter(p.values())).get('n')} lot {lot.get('mn')}..{lot.get('mx')} "
                  f"dnav {fmt_val(dn.get('mn'), 10)}..{fmt_val(dn.get('mx'), 10)} empty cols: {','.join(nulls[:40])}")
    pg.add("S8", "PROFILES (scope, lots, NAV dates, always-empty columns)", s8 or ["phase C not run"])
    # S9 every table name (to ask for more columns next time)
    s9 = []
    for root in ("MFGA_INFOCENTRE", "MFGI", "BUSINESS", "FRI", "LUXIS.EFRONT"):
        names = []
        for (s, t) in sorted(cat.tables):
            if s == root or s.startswith(root + "."):
                r = store.get(f"C1_{slug(s, t)}")
                n = r["rows"][0]["zz_n"] if r and r["status"] == "OK" and r["rows"] else ""
                names.append(f"{s[len(root) + 1:] + '.' if s != root else ''}{t}{'=' + str(n) if n != '' else ''}")
        if names:
            s9.append(f"[{root}] " + " ".join(names))
    pg.add("S9", "ALL TABLE NAMES (name=rows when profiled)", s9 or ["phase A not run"])
    return pg


def show_pages(pages: list[list[str]], start: int = 1):
    i = max(0, start - 1)
    while 0 <= i < len(pages):
        os.system("cls" if os.name == "nt" else "clear")
        print("\n".join(pages[i]))
        ans = input("[Enter] next  [b] back  [number] go to  [q] quit > ").strip().lower()
        if ans == "q":
            break
        if ans == "b":
            i -= 1
        elif ans.isdigit():
            i = int(ans) - 1
        else:
            i += 1
