def compact_plsql(text: str) -> list[str]:
    text = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)
    out = []
    for ln in text.splitlines():
        ln = re.sub(r"--.*$", "", ln).rstrip()
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        ind = len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip())
        out.append(" " * min(ind // 2, 8) + re.sub(r"\s+", " ", ln.strip()))
    return out


def source_pages(root: Path, width: int, lines: int, names_filter: str | None):
    files = [f for f in root.rglob("*") if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in
             (".sql", ".pkb", ".pks", ".fnc", ".prc", ".vw", ".trg", ".tab", ".pls", ".plb", ".txt")]
    texts = {}
    for f in files:
        try:
            texts[f] = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            pass
    pg = Pager(width, lines)
    names = names_filter.split(",") if names_filter else SOURCE_NAMES
    found_idx = []
    for name in names:
        pat = re.compile(r"(CREATE\s+(OR\s+REPLACE\s+)?(EDITIONABLE\s+)?(FUNCTION|PROCEDURE|VIEW|TABLE)\s+(\"?REPADMIN\"?\.)?\"?"
                         + name + r"\"?\b)|(\b(FUNCTION|PROCEDURE)\s+" + name + r"\b)", re.I)
        hit = None
        for f, t in texts.items():
            m = pat.search(t)
            if m:
                hit = (f, m.start())
                break
        if not hit:
            found_idx.append(f"{name}: NOT FOUND")
            continue
        f, pos = hit
        t = texts[f]
        end_m = re.compile(r"\bEND\s+\"?" + name + r"\"?\s*;", re.I).search(t, pos)
        stop = end_m.end() if end_m else min(len(t), pos + 20000)
        if not end_m:
            nxt = re.compile(r"\n\s*(CREATE\s|FUNCTION\s|PROCEDURE\s)", re.I).search(t, pos + 10)
            stop = nxt.start() if nxt else stop
        body = compact_plsql(t[pos:stop])
        found_idx.append(f"{name}: {f.name} line {t.count(chr(10), 0, pos) + 1} ({len(body)} lines)")
        pg.add("SRC", name, body)
    loaders = []
    for tbl in LOADED_TABLES:
        rx = re.compile(r"\b(INSERT\s+INTO|MERGE\s+INTO|UPDATE|DELETE\s+FROM|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE)\s+(\"?REPADMIN\"?\.)?\"?"
                        + tbl + r"\"?\b", re.I)
        for f, t in texts.items():
            for m in rx.finditer(t):
                before = t[:m.start()]
                procs = re.findall(r"\b(?:PROCEDURE|FUNCTION|PACKAGE\s+BODY|TRIGGER)\s+([\w.\"]+)", before, re.I)
                loaders.append(f"{tbl}: {m.group(1).upper()} in {f.name} line {before.count(chr(10)) + 1} "
                               f"({procs[-1] if procs else '?'})")
    pg.sections.insert(0, ("SRC0", "INDEX of needed objects + who writes the LUXIS tables", found_idx + [""] + loaders))
    return pg


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ export (one .txt back)
AGGREGATE = re.compile(r"\b(GROUP\s+BY|COUNT\s*\(|SUM\s*\(|LISTAGG|APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT|MIN\s*\(|MAX\s*\()", re.I)


def export_rows(r: dict) -> tuple[str, list[list]]:
    """Rows as they may leave the PC: personal columns masked (also their MIN/MAX), client-level rows of sensitive
    tables dropped, text values of sensitive tables masked unless they are short codes."""
    sql = r["sql"] or ""
    meta = r.get("meta") or {}
    key = meta.get("key") or ["", ""]
    table = key[1] if len(key) > 1 else ""
    sens = bool(SENSITIVE_TABLE.search(table) or SENSITIVE_TABLE.search(sql))
    aggregate = bool(AGGREGATE.search(sql)) and not re.search(r"\bSELECT\s+(\w+\.)?\*", sql, re.I)
    cols = r["columns"] or []
    rows = r["rows"] or []
    if sens and not aggregate:
        return "client-level rows not exported", [[row.get(c) for c in cols if c.upper().startswith("ZZ_")]
                                                   for row in rows[:1]]
    src = {f"{k}_{i}": c for c, k, i in re.findall(r'(?:MIN|MAX)\("((?:[^"]|"")+)"\) AS "(mn|mx)_(\d+)"', sql)}
    if "col" in meta:
        src["v"] = meta["col"]
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cells = []
        for c in cols:
            v = row.get(c)
            base = src.get(c, c)
            if masked(table, base) or (sens and isinstance(v, str) and c in src
                                       and (len(v) > 12 or NAMEY_COL.search(base))):
                v = "#"
            cells.append(v)
        out.append(cells)
    return "", out


def export_txt(store: Store, out: Path, files: list[str], max_mb: float):
    n = 0
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write(f"# from_office explore export {dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}\n")
        for ph, stt, k, e in store.stats():
            fh.write(f"# stats {ph} {stt} {k} {int(e or 0)}s\n")
        for (qid,) in store.con.execute("SELECT id FROM q ORDER BY id"):
            r = store.get(qid)
            note, rows = export_rows(r) if r["status"] == "OK" else ("", [])
            rec = {"id": qid, "env": r["env"], "status": r["status"], "purpose": r["purpose"], "total": r["total"],
                   "error": r["error"], "meta": r["meta"], "sql": r["sql"], "columns": r["columns"],
                   "note": note, "rows": rows}
            fh.write("Q " + json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
            n += 1
    if files:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pack_files", HERE.parent / "pack_files.py")
        pack = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(pack)
        tmp = out.with_suffix(".files.tmp")
        pack.main([str(tmp), *files, "--max-mb", str(max_mb)])
        with open(out, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
            fh.write("\n# ==== FILES ====\n")
            fh.write(tmp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        tmp.unlink()
    print(f"{n} query results -> {out}  ({out.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ main
def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="LUXIS exit Dremio explorer (office PC)")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    r = sub.add_parser("run")
    r.add_argument("--phase", default="A,B,C,D")
    r.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=4)
    r.add_argument("--max-minutes", type=float)
    r.add_argument("--client")
    sub.add_parser("status")
    p = sub.add_parser("pages")
    p.add_argument("--section")
    p.add_argument("--lines", type=int, default=55)
    p.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=150)
    p.add_argument("--start", type=int, default=1)
    s = sub.add_parser("source")
    s.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    s.add_argument("--names", help="comma list, default: every object the reports need")
    s.add_argument("--lines", type=int, default=55)
    s.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=150)
    x = sub.add_parser("export")
    x.add_argument("--out", default=str(HERE.parent.parent / "from_office.txt"))
    x.add_argument("--files", nargs="*", default=[], help="folders/files to add (LUXIS source, references, ...)")
    x.add_argument("--max-mb", type=float, default=40.0)
    q = sub.add_parser("sql")
    q.add_argument("id")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    store = Store(DB_PATH)
    if args.cmd == "run":
        mod = load_client(args.client)
        deadline = time.time() + args.max_minutes * 60 if args.max_minutes else None
        run = Runner(mod, store, args.workers, deadline)
        phases = {"A": phase_a, "B": phase_b, "C": phase_c, "D": phase_d}
        for ph in args.phase.split(","):
            print(f"phase {ph}", flush=True)
            phases[ph.strip()](run)
        print("done. Next: python explore.py export")
    elif args.cmd == "status":
        for ph, stt, n, e in store.stats():
            print(f"{ph:<3} {stt:<6} {n:>7}  {int(e or 0)} s")
    elif args.cmd == "pages":
        pg = build_pages(store, args.width, args.lines)
        pages = pg.build(args.section)
        out = HERE / "pages.txt"
        out.write_text("\n\n".join("\n".join(x) for x in pages), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"{len(pages)} pages (also in {out}); sections: " +
              ", ".join(f"{c} {t[:30]}" for c, t, _ in pg.sections))
        input("press Enter to show page 1 ")
        show_pages(pages, args.start)
    elif args.cmd == "source":
        pg = source_pages(Path(args.root), args.width, args.lines, args.names)
        pages = pg.build()
        (HERE / "source_pages.txt").write_text("\n\n".join("\n".join(x) for x in pages), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"{len(pages)} pages")
        input("press Enter to show page 1 ")
        show_pages(pages)
    elif args.cmd == "export":
        export_txt(store, Path(args.out), args.files, args.max_mb)
    elif args.cmd == "sql":
        res = store.get(args.id)
        print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, default=str)[:20000] if res else "unknown id")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

add("F", "LUXREP_TB_FONDS: sample (source of the LUXIS fund selector, proc_Fonds) + total",
    f"SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS ZZ_TOTAL_ROWS FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t ORDER BY FA_NUM LIMIT 20", max_rows=20)
add("F", "LUXREP_TB_FONDS reference funds (BCR + TA test funds)",
    f"SELECT * FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS WHERE FA_NUM IN ({FUNDS_BCR},{TA_FA}) ORDER BY FA_NUM")
add("F", "LUXREP_TB_FONDS profile: counts by FUND_TYPE / LIQUIDATION / ACTIVATION / DE_DROIT",
    f"""SELECT FUND_TYPE, LIQUIDATION, ACTIVATION, DE_DROIT, COUNT(*) AS N, COUNT(DISTINCT FA_NUM) AS N_FUNDS,
       MIN(FA_NUM) AS EX1, MAX(FA_NUM) AS EX2
FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS GROUP BY FUND_TYPE, LIQUIDATION, ACTIVATION, DE_DROIT ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4""")
add("F", "TAB_FND_STRUCT sample (structure name of proc_Fonds)",
    f"SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS ZZ_TOTAL_ROWS FROM {LX}.TAB_FND_STRUCT t LIMIT 10", max_rows=10)
add("F", "TAB_FND_MAIN reference funds, all columns (class level)",
    f"SELECT * FROM {LX}.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ({FUNDS_BCR},{TA_FA}) ORDER BY FA_NUM", max_rows=300)
add("F", "LUXREP_TB_FONDS vs TAB_FND_MAIN: is LUXREP_TB_FONDS a distinct-fund projection of TAB_FND_MAIN? (name/ccy equality counts)",
    f"""WITH tb AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) AS N1, MAX(FUND_CCY) AS C1 FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS GROUP BY FA_NUM),
     tf AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) AS N2, MIN(FUND_NAME) AS N2B, MAX(FUND_CCY) AS C2 FROM {LX}.TAB_FND_MAIN GROUP BY FA_NUM)
SELECT CASE WHEN tf.FA_NUM IS NULL THEN 'ONLY_TB' WHEN tb.FA_NUM IS NULL THEN 'ONLY_TFM' ELSE 'BOTH' END AS SIDE,
       CASE WHEN tb.N1 = tf.N2 THEN 'NAME_EQ' WHEN tb.N1 = tf.N2B THEN 'NAME_EQ_MIN' ELSE 'NAME_DIFF' END AS NAME_CMP,
       CASE WHEN tb.C1 = tf.C2 THEN 'CCY_EQ' ELSE 'CCY_DIFF' END AS CCY_CMP, COUNT(*) AS N,
       MIN(COALESCE(tb.FA_NUM, tf.FA_NUM)) AS EX
FROM tb FULL OUTER JOIN tf ON tb.FA_NUM = tf.FA_NUM GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3""")
add("F", "AMS_PORTFOLIO last lot of reference funds, all columns (look for a long/official name, fund type, father, consolidated flag)",
    f"""SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
FROM {IC}.AMS_PORTFOLIO p WHERE C_FUND IN ({FUNDS_BCR},{TA_FA})) x WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY C_FUND""")
add("F", "fund name concordance LUXREP_TB_FONDS.FUND_NAME vs AMS_PORTFOLIO.L_FUND (last lot): equal / upper-trim equal / prefix",
    f"""WITH p AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN FROM {IC}.AMS_PORTFOLIO) x WHERE RN = 1),
     t AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) FUND_NAME, MAX(FUND_CCY) FUND_CCY FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS GROUP BY FA_NUM)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.C_FUND IS NULL THEN 'NOT_IN_MFGA'
            WHEN t.FUND_NAME = p.L_FUND THEN 'EQ'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.FUND_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(p.L_FUND)) THEN 'EQ_CASE_TRIM'
            WHEN POSITION(UPPER(TRIM(p.L_FUND)) IN UPPER(t.FUND_NAME)) > 0 THEN 'MFGA_IN_LUXIS'
            ELSE 'DIFF' END AS NAME_CMP,
       CASE WHEN t.FUND_CCY = p.C_CCY THEN 'CCY_EQ' ELSE 'CCY_DIFF' END AS CCY_CMP,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(t.FA_NUM) AS EX_FUND
FROM t LEFT JOIN p ON p.C_FUND = t.FA_NUM GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2""")
add("F", "fund name examples LUXIS vs MFGA (40 funds where they differ)",
    f"""WITH p AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND FROM (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN FROM {IC}.AMS_PORTFOLIO) x WHERE RN = 1)
SELECT t.FA_NUM, t.FUND_NAME AS LUXIS_NAME, p.L_FUND AS MFGA_NAME
FROM {LX}.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t JOIN p ON p.C_FUND = t.FA_NUM
WHERE t.FUND_NAME <> p.L_FUND ORDER BY t.FA_NUM LIMIT 40""", max_rows=40)

# N. LUXIS NAV table (NAV_CONTROLE / NAV_PUB / dates) vs AMS_LOT - core of every period type
# =====================================================================================
add("N", "REPADMIN.NAV all columns, 280287 last 15 NAVs",
    f"SELECT * FROM {LX}.NAV WHERE NAV_FUND_NO = {F_BCR} ORDER BY NAV_DATE_NAV DESC LIMIT 15", max_rows=15)
add("N", "AMS_LOT all columns, 280287 lots of June 2026",
    f"SELECT * FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE C_FUND = {F_BCR} AND D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-20' AND {D_TO} ORDER BY N_LOT",
    max_rows=200)
add("N", "REPADMIN.NAV value profile: NAV_CONTROLE x NAV_PUB x NAV_TYP_TRT (2026)",
    f"""SELECT NAV_CONTROLE, NAV_PUB, NAV_TYP_TRT, COUNT(*) AS N, COUNT(DISTINCT NAV_FUND_NO) AS N_FUNDS
FROM {LX}.NAV WHERE NAV_DATE_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3""")
add("N", "AMS_LOT value profile: C_NAV_TYP x C_TRAIT x validation/dispo filled (2026)",
    f"""SELECT C_NAV_TYP, C_TRAIT, CASE WHEN D_H_VALIDATION_NAV IS NULL THEN 'VAL_NULL' ELSE 'VAL_SET' END AS VAL,
       CASE WHEN D_H_DISPO IS NULL THEN 'DISPO_NULL' ELSE 'DISPO_SET' END AS DISPO, COUNT(*) AS N,
       COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) AS N_FUNDS
FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4""")
add("N", "CONCORDANCE NAV vs AMS_LOT per (fund, NAV date) 2026-H1: NAV_CONTROLE/NAV_PUB vs lot attributes of the last lot",
    f"""WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, C_NAV_TYP, C_TRAIT, D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, D_H_DISPO, D_H_PROCESS,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN,
              COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV) NL,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV) NO
       FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'),
     n AS (SELECT NAV_FUND_NO, NAV_DATE_NAV, NAV_CONTROLE, NAV_PUB FROM {LX}.NAV
           WHERE NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
SELECT n.NAV_CONTROLE, n.NAV_PUB,
       CASE WHEN l.C_FUND IS NULL THEN 'NO_LOT' ELSE 'LOT' END AS HAS_LOT,
       l.C_NAV_TYP AS LAST_TYP, CASE WHEN l.NO > 0 THEN 'HAS_O' ELSE 'NO_O' END AS ANY_O, l.C_TRAIT AS LAST_TRAIT,
       CASE WHEN l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV IS NULL THEN 'VAL_NULL' ELSE 'VAL_SET' END AS VAL,
       CASE WHEN l.D_H_DISPO IS NULL THEN 'DISPO_NULL' ELSE 'DISPO_SET' END AS DISPO,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(n.NAV_FUND_NO) AS EX_FUND, MAX(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS EX_DATE
FROM n LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM l WHERE RN = 1) l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8""", timeout=1800)
add("N", "CONCORDANCE reverse: AMS_LOT (fund, D_NAV) 2026-H1 with no REPADMIN.NAV row, by C_NAV_TYP of last lot",
    f"""WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, MAX(C_NAV_TYP) AS T_MAX, MIN(C_NAV_TYP) AS T_MIN FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT
       WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY C_FUND, D_NAV)
SELECT l.T_MIN, l.T_MAX, CASE WHEN n.NAV_FUND_NO IS NULL THEN 'NO_NAV' ELSE 'NAV' END AS IN_NAV, COUNT(*) AS N,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.C_FUND) AS N_FUNDS, MIN(l.C_FUND) AS EX_FUND
FROM l LEFT JOIN {LX}.NAV n ON n.NAV_FUND_NO = l.C_FUND AND n.NAV_DATE_NAV = l.D_NAV
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3""", timeout=1800)
add("N", "CONCORDANCE NAV_DATE_TRT (calc date) vs AMS_LOT D_H_PROCESS / D_H_VALIDATION_NAV / D_H_DISPO of last O lot (2026-H1)",
    f"""WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, D_H_PROCESS, D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, D_H_DISPO,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN
       FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND C_NAV_TYP = 'O')
SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=PROCESS'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=VALIDATION'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_DISPO AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=DISPO'
            WHEN n.NAV_DATE_TRT IS NULL THEN 'TRT_NULL' ELSE 'TRT_OTHER' END AS TRT_CMP,
       CASE WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_DISPO AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=DISPO'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=VALIDATION'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=PROCESS'
            WHEN n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION IS NULL THEN 'PUB_NULL' ELSE 'PUB_OTHER' END AS PUB_CMP,
       n.NAV_PUB, COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(n.NAV_FUND_NO) AS EX_FUND, MIN(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS EX_DATE
FROM {LX}.NAV n JOIN (SELECT * FROM l WHERE RN = 1) l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
WHERE n.NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3""", timeout=1800)
add("N", "NAV vs AMS_LOT for 280287 side by side (2026-05-25 .. 2026-07-10)",
    f"""SELECT n.NAV_DATE_NAV, n.NAV_CONTROLE, n.NAV_PUB, n.NAV_TYP_TRT, n.NAV_DATE_TRT, n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION,
       l.N_LOT, l.C_NAV_TYP, l.C_TRAIT, l.D_H_PROCESS, l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, l.D_H_DISPO
FROM {LX}.NAV n LEFT JOIN {IC}.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
WHERE n.NAV_FUND_NO = {F_BCR} AND n.NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-10'
ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV, l.N_LOT""", max_rows=300)
add("N", "Infocentre own copies of LUXIS tables? (MFGA_INFOCENTRE.REPADMIN.NAV seen in old code): sample",

    f"""SELECT NAV_BACKDATED, COUNT(*) AS N,
       SUBSTR(LISTAGG(CASE WHEN NAV_BACKDATED = 1 THEN FUND_NO END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FUND_NO), 1, 2000) AS FUNDS
FROM {LX}.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG GROUP BY NAV_BACKDATED""")
add("B", "V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG all columns, 20 rows (does it carry more than FUND_NO/NAV_BACKDATED?)",
    f"SELECT * FROM {LX}.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG ORDER BY NAV_BACKDATED DESC, FUND_NO LIMIT 20", max_rows=20)
add("B", "CANDIDATE RULE backdated = fund has lots of a non-official NAV type / several lots per NAV date: cross-tab vs flag (2026)",
    f"""WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_O,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP <> 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NOT_O,
              COUNT(DISTINCT C_NAV_TYP) AS N_TYPES, MAX(C_NAV_TYP) AS MAX_TYP, MIN(C_NAV_TYP) AS MIN_TYP,
              COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS, COUNT(DISTINCT D_NAV) AS N_DNAV
       FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY C_FUND)
SELECT b.NAV_BACKDATED, CASE WHEN l.N_NOT_O > 0 THEN 'HAS_NOT_O' ELSE 'ONLY_O' END AS TYPES, l.MIN_TYP, l.MAX_TYP,
       CASE WHEN l.N_LOTS > 3 * l.N_DNAV THEN 'MANY_LOTS_PER_NAV' ELSE 'FEW_LOTS_PER_NAV' END AS DENSITY,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(b.FUND_NO) AS EX
FROM {LX}.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG b JOIN l ON l.C_FUND = b.FUND_NO GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5""")
add("B", "AMS_LOT for backdated fund 280499, 2026-06 (how backdating shows in MFGA)",
    f"SELECT * FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT WHERE C_FUND = '280499' AND D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND {D_TO} ORDER BY N_LOT",
    max_rows=300)
add("B", "AMS_PORTFOLIO columns that could carry the backdated flag: last lot of backdated vs non-backdated funds (10 each)",
    f"""WITH b AS (SELECT FUND_NO, NAV_BACKDATED, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NAV_BACKDATED ORDER BY FUND_NO) R
             FROM {LX}.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG)
SELECT b.NAV_BACKDATED, p.* FROM (SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN
      FROM {IC}.AMS_PORTFOLIO x) p JOIN b ON b.FUND_NO = p.C_FUND AND b.R <= 10 WHERE p.RN = 1
ORDER BY b.NAV_BACKDATED, p.C_FUND""", max_rows=40)

add("P", "every (pool, feeder) link in AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL with first/last D_NAV and row count (full history)",
    f"""SELECT C_FUND AS POOL, C_SUB_FUND AS FEEDER, MIN(D_NAV) AS LINK_FIRST, MAX(D_NAV) AS LINK_LAST,
       COUNT(*) AS N_ROWS, COUNT(DISTINCT D_NAV) AS N_DNAV, MIN(N_LOT) AS LOT_MIN, MAX(N_LOT) AS LOT_MAX
FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_FUND, C_SUB_FUND ORDER BY 1, 2""", max_rows=20000, timeout=1800)
add("P", "AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL all columns, pool 280421 last 2 NAV dates",
    f"""SELECT * FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL WHERE C_FUND = {POOL}
  AND D_NAV >= (SELECT MAX(D_NAV) - 3 FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL WHERE C_FUND = {POOL}) ORDER BY D_NAV, C_SUB_FUND LIMIT 200""")
add("P", "per pool and per feeder: AMS_LOT activity (first/last D_NAV, last lot, lot count since 2023) for every fund present in VAL_POOL",
    f"""WITH f AS (SELECT C_FUND AS F FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL UNION SELECT C_SUB_FUND FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL)
SELECT l.C_FUND, MIN(l.D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV, MAX(l.N_LOT) AS LAST_LOT, COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS,
       MAX(CASE WHEN l.C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN l.D_NAV END) AS LAST_O_NAV
FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT l WHERE l.C_FUND IN (SELECT F FROM f) GROUP BY l.C_FUND ORDER BY 1""", max_rows=20000, timeout=1800)
add("P", "candidate transfer lot per pool: first pool lot after the last lot of all its (ended) feeders, with its NAV",
    f"""WITH link AS (SELECT C_FUND AS POOL, C_SUB_FUND AS FEEDER, MAX(D_NAV) AS LINK_LAST
              FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_FUND, C_SUB_FUND),
     plast AS (SELECT C_FUND, MAX(D_NAV) AS POOL_LAST FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT GROUP BY C_FUND),
     ended AS (SELECT k.POOL, k.FEEDER, k.LINK_LAST FROM link k JOIN plast p ON p.C_FUND = k.POOL
               WHERE p.POOL_LAST > k.LINK_LAST),
     flast AS (SELECT e.POOL, MAX(l.N_LOT) AS FEEDERS_LAST_LOT, MAX(e.LINK_LAST) AS DEPOOL_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT e.FEEDER) AS N_FEEDERS
               FROM ended e JOIN {IC}.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = e.FEEDER AND l.D_NAV <= e.LINK_LAST GROUP BY e.POOL)
SELECT f.POOL, f.N_FEEDERS, f.DEPOOL_DATE, f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT,
       MIN(l.N_LOT) AS TRANSFER_LOT, MIN(l.D_NAV) AS TRANSFER_NAV
FROM flast f LEFT JOIN {IC}.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = f.POOL AND l.N_LOT > f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT
GROUP BY f.POOL, f.N_FEEDERS, f.DEPOOL_DATE, f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT ORDER BY f.DEPOOL_DATE DESC""", max_rows=5000, timeout=1800)
add("P", "OPEN QUESTION: feeders with lots after their depooling (280127, 714902, 740228, 740234, 239602, 253168, 253169, 280202): lots + entries count",
    f"""SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, l.D_NAV, l.C_NAV_TYP, l.C_TRAIT, l.D_H_PROCESS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {IC}.AMS_CASH_MVT c WHERE c.C_FUND = l.C_FUND AND c.N_LOT = l.N_LOT) AS N_CASH_MVT,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {IC}.AMS_MVT m WHERE m.C_FUND = l.C_FUND AND m.N_LOT = l.N_LOT) AS N_MVT
FROM {IC}.AMS_LOT l
WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280127','714902','740228','740234','239602','253168','253169','280202')
  AND l.D_NAV >= DATE '2026-06-01' ORDER BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT""", max_rows=2000, timeout=1800)
add("P", "same funds on INTG (frozen 03/07/2026): do the post-depooling lots exist there?",
    f"""SELECT C_FUND, COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS, MIN(D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV, MAX(N_LOT) AS LAST_LOT

add("P", "mid-pools (FUND_TYPE 5) and multi-level: funds that are BOTH pool and feeder in VAL_POOL",
    f"""SELECT a.C_FUND AS MIDPOOL, MIN(a.D_NAV) AS AS_POOL_FIRST, MAX(a.D_NAV) AS AS_POOL_LAST,
       MIN(b.C_FUND) AS ITS_POOL, MIN(b.D_NAV) AS AS_FEEDER_FIRST, MAX(b.D_NAV) AS AS_FEEDER_LAST

add("P", "feeders linked to several pools over time",
    f"""SELECT C_SUB_FUND, COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) AS N_POOLS,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT C_FUND, ',') AS POOLS, MIN(D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV
FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_SUB_FUND HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) > 1 ORDER BY 1""", max_rows=2000)
add("P", "PROOF ONLY (not a source): TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK depooling structures, to measure the MFGA detection against them",
    f"""SELECT COALESCE(FA_POOL_NUM, FA_NUM) AS POOL, DEPOOLING_DATE, DEPOOLING_LOT, FUND_TYPE,

add("P", "LUXIS fund types of every fund present in VAL_POOL (2 feeder, 3 pool, 5 mid-pool): to check the MFGA roles",
    f"""WITH f AS (SELECT C_FUND AS F, 'POOL' AS ROLE FROM {IC}.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL

add("P", "AMS_PORTFOLIO pool-related columns (C_CONSOLIDATED, C_FUND_FATHER ...) for pool 280421 and its feeders, last lot",

def write():
    lines = ["-- round 01 requests (generated). Run on the office PC:",
             "--   python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt",
             f"-- {len(Q)} requests. Groups: A catalogue, C columns, W LUXIS work tables, F funds, N NAV/lots,",
             "--   B backdated, E eFront, P depooling, D LUXIS copies vs MFGA, G TA/MFGI, R config tables, X FX rates",
             ""]
    for qid, purpose, env, max_rows, timeout, sql in Q:
        lines.append(f"-- @id: {qid}")
        lines.append(f"-- @purpose: {purpose}")
        lines.append(f"-- @env: {env}")
        lines.append(f"-- @max_rows: {max_rows}")
        if timeout:
            lines.append(f"-- @timeout: {timeout}")
        lines.append(sql + ";")
        lines.append("")
    OUT.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    print(len(Q), "requests ->", OUT)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    write()

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/outbox/to_office_01.txt =====
# ==== LUXREP EXCHANGE CAPSULE ======================================================================
# This .txt file is a Python script. On the office PC, in a terminal:
#
#     python to_office_NN.txt
#
# It never modifies anything outside its own work folder, sends nothing anywhere, and talks to Dremio
# only through dremio_sql.py (read-only guard unchanged). Steps (shown and confirmed one by one):
#   1. unpack the embedded files into .\luxrep_exchange\NN\  (scripts, requests, reports code, ...)
#   2. find dremio_sql.py, check the Dremio sessions (offers `login` if expired)
#   3. run the embedded steps (Dremio queries, tests, ...)
#   4. collect the files asked for (search + your confirmation; nothing is taken without it)
#   5. write ONE file  from_office_NN.txt  next to this capsule: that is the only file to bring back.
# Options: --yes (no confirmation), --skip-queries, --skip-files, --paths my_paths.txt,
#          --roots "C:\dir1;C:\dir2", --client C:\...\dremio_sql.py, --list (show content, run nothing)
# Re-running is safe: answered Dremio queries are cached, the return file is rebuilt.
# The embedded payload is plain text below (lines starting with "#|"), readable before running.
# ===================================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime as dt
import fnmatch
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ME = Path(__file__).resolve()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- payload
def read_payload() -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    files, manifest, cur, buf = {}, {}, None, []
    for line in ME.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("#|"):
            continue
        body = line[2:]
        if body.startswith("@@FILE "):
            cur, buf = body[7:].strip(), []
        elif body.startswith("@@END"):
            files[cur] = "\n".join(buf)
            cur = None
        elif cur is not None:
            buf.append(body[1:] if body.startswith(" ") else body)
    manifest = json.loads(files.pop("manifest.json"))
    return manifest, files


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
class Tee(io.TextIOBase):
    def __init__(self, *streams):
        self.streams = streams

    def write(self, s):
        for st in self.streams:
            try:
                st.write(s)
                st.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass
        return len(s)


def ask(question: str, auto: bool) -> bool:
    if auto:
        print(question + " [auto: yes]")
        return True
    ans = input(question + " [Y/n] ").strip().lower()
    return ans in ("", "y", "yes", "o", "oui")


def find_client(explicit: str | None, work: Path) -> Path | None:
    cands = []
    if explicit:
        cands.append(Path(explicit))
    if os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"):
        cands.append(Path(os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"]))
    for start in (ME.parent, Path.cwd(), work):
        for folder in (start, *start.parents):
            cands.append(folder / "dremio_sql.py")
    home = Path.home()
    for sub in ("Documents", "Desktop", "Downloads"):
        base = home / sub
        if base.is_dir():
            try:
                for p in base.rglob("dremio_sql.py"):
                    cands.append(p)
                    break
            except OSError:
                pass
    for c in cands:
        c = c / "dremio_sql.py" if c.is_dir() else c
        if c.is_file():
            return c.resolve()
    return None


def section(out, title: str, text: str):
    out.write(f"===== SECTION : {title} =====\n{text.rstrip()}\n\n")


def pack_file(out, f: Path, max_mb: float):
    size = f.stat().st_size
    if size > max_mb * 1024 * 1024:
        out.write(f"===== SKIPPED TOO LARGE : {f} | {size} bytes =====\n\n")
        return
    raw = f.read_bytes()
    out.write(f"===== FICHIER BASE64 : {f} | {size} bytes | sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()} =====\n")
    b = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")
    out.write("\n".join(b[i:i + 120] for i in range(0, len(b), 120)) + "\n\n")


def discover(roots: list[Path], patterns: list[str], skip: list[str], max_depth: int) -> list[Path]:
    found = []
    pats = [p.lower() for p in patterns]
    skips = [s.lower() for s in skip]
    for root in roots:
        if not root.is_dir():
            continue
        root_depth = len(root.parts)
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
            d = Path(dirpath)
            low = str(d).lower().replace("/", "\\")
            if len(d.parts) - root_depth >= max_depth or any(fnmatch.fnmatch(low, s) for s in skips):
                dirnames[:] = []
                continue
            dirnames[:] = [x for x in dirnames if x.lower() not in
                           ("appdata", "__pycache__", ".git", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "$recycle.bin")]
            for fn in filenames:
                full = str(d / fn).lower().replace("/", "\\")
                if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(full, p) for p in pats):
                    found.append(d / fn)
    return sorted(set(found))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- main
def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="LuxRep exchange capsule (office side).")
    ap.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-queries", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-files", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--paths", help="text file, one file or folder per line, to bring back as well")
    ap.add_argument("--roots", help="folders to search, separated by ;")
    ap.add_argument("--client", help="path to dremio_sql.py")
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    manifest, files = read_payload()
    nn = manifest["round"]
    print(f"capsule {nn}: {manifest.get('title', '')}")
    print(f"  {len(files)} embedded files, {len(manifest.get('steps', []))} steps, "
          f"{len(manifest.get('collect', {}).get('patterns', []))} file patterns to collect")
    if args.list:
        for name in files:
            print("   file:", name)
        for st in manifest.get("steps", []):
            print("   step:", st)
        return 0

    work = ME.parent / "luxrep_exchange" / nn
    ret = ME.parent / f"from_office_{nn}.txt"
    log_buf = io.StringIO()
    real_out = sys.stdout
    sys.stdout = Tee(real_out, log_buf)
    started = time.time()
    status = {}
    try:
        # 1. unpack
        work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name, text in files.items():
            dst = work / name
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dst.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[1] {len(files)} files unpacked into {work}")
        if manifest.get("message"):
            print("    message: " + manifest["message"])

        # 2. Dremio client and sessions
        client = find_client(args.client, work)
        needs_dremio = any(s["type"] in ("queries", "cmd_dremio") for s in manifest.get("steps", []))
        if client is None and needs_dremio and not args.skip_queries:
            print("[2] dremio_sql.py not found: give its path with --client C:\\...\\dremio_sql.py")
            status["dremio"] = "client not found"
        elif needs_dremio and not args.skip_queries:
            print(f"[2] dremio client: {client}")
            os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"] = str(client)
            if len(client.parents) < 4:
                print("    WARNING: dremio_sql.py must sit at least 4 folders deep (it reads parents[3])")
            envs = sorted({e for s in manifest["steps"] for e in s.get("envs", ["ctlq"])})
            for env in envs:
                probe = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(client), "probe", "--env", env],
                                       capture_output=True, text=True)
                ok = probe.returncode == 0
                print(f"    {env}: {'session OK' if ok else 'session NOT OK: ' + (probe.stderr or probe.stdout).strip()[:200]}")
                if not ok and ask(f"    run `login --env {env}` now?", False if not args.yes else True):
                    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(client), "login", "--env", env])
                status[f"session_{env}"] = "ok" if ok else "relogged"

        # 3. steps
        for i, st in enumerate(manifest.get("steps", []), 1):
            kind = st["type"]
            if kind in ("queries",) and args.skip_queries:
                print(f"[3.{i}] {kind} skipped (--skip-queries)")
                continue
            if kind == "queries":
                if client is None:
                    print(f"[3.{i}] queries not run: no dremio_sql.py")
                    continue
                print(f"[3.{i}] Dremio queries: {st['file']} (answered ones are cached; Ctrl+C keeps them)")
                cmd = [sys.executable, str(work / "run_round.py"), str(work / st["file"]),
                       "--client", str(client), "--workers", str(st.get("workers", 3))]
                rc = subprocess.run(cmd).returncode
                status[st["file"]] = f"exit {rc}"
            elif kind in ("cmd", "cmd_dremio"):
                print(f"[3.{i}] command: {' '.join(st['argv'])}  (in {work / st.get('cwd', '.')})")
                argv = [sys.executable if a == "{python}" else a for a in st["argv"]]
                rc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=work / st.get("cwd", ".")).returncode
                status[" ".join(st["argv"])] = f"exit {rc}"

        # 4. files to collect
        chosen: list[Path] = []
        col = manifest.get("collect", {})
        if not args.skip_files and (col.get("patterns") or args.paths):
            if col.get("patterns"):
                roots = ([Path(r) for r in args.roots.split(";") if r.strip()] if args.roots else
                         [Path.home() / x for x in col.get("roots", ["Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"])])
                print(f"[4] searching {len(col['patterns'])} patterns under: " + "; ".join(map(str, roots)))
                found = discover(roots, col["patterns"], col.get("skip", []), col.get("max_depth", 12))
                found = [f for f in found if work not in f.parents and f != ret and f != ME]
                cand = work / "found_files.txt"
                cand.write_text("# delete a line to leave the file out, add lines (files or folders) to add\n" +
                                "\n".join(str(f) for f in found) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
                print(f"    {len(found)} files found, list written to {cand}")
                for f in found[:60]:
                    print("      " + str(f))
                if len(found) > 60:
                    print(f"      ... ({len(found) - 60} more in the list file)")
                if not args.yes:
                    input(f"    edit {cand} if needed (Notepad), then press Enter to continue ")
                lines = cand.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                paths = [Path(x.strip()) for x in lines if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")]
            else:
                paths = []
            if args.paths:
                paths += [Path(x.strip()) for x in Path(args.paths).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                          if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")]
            for p in paths:
                if p.is_dir():
                    chosen += [f for f in sorted(p.rglob("*")) if f.is_file() and not
                               ({"__pycache__", ".git", "venv", ".venv"} & set(f.parts))]
                elif p.is_file():
                    chosen.append(p)
                else:
                    print(f"    not found, skipped: {p}")
            print(f"[4] {len(chosen)} files will be brought back")

        # 5. return file
        outputs = [work / o for o in manifest.get("bring_back", [])]
        outputs += sorted(work.glob("*_results.txt")) + sorted(work.glob("test_round_*_results.txt"))
        with open(ret, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
            out.write(f"# from_office_{nn}  generated {dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}  "
                      f"on {os.environ.get('COMPUTERNAME', '?')}  python {sys.version.split()[0]}\n")
            section(out, "status", json.dumps(status, indent=1))
            seen = set()
            for o in outputs:
                if o.is_file() and o not in seen:
                    seen.add(o)
                    section(out, f"output {o.name}", o.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            for f in chosen:
                pack_file(out, f, col.get("max_mb", 30))
            section(out, "log", log_buf.getvalue() + f"\nwall_s: {time.time() - started:.0f}")
        mb = ret.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024
        print(f"[5] DONE -> bring back this ONE file: {ret}  ({mb:.1f} MB)")
    finally:
        sys.stdout = real_out
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#|@@FILE run_round.py
#| """Run one round of Dremio requests and write a single results file.
#| 
#| Usage (office PC, after `python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq`, and `--env intg` if the round uses it):
#| 
#|     python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt
#|     python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --workers 4 --timeout 900
#|     python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --only R01_A001,R01_A002
#|     python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --check          (parse + read-only check, no Dremio call)
#| 
#| Request file format (one block per query):
#| 
#|     -- @id: R01_Q001
#|     -- @purpose: free text
#|     -- @env: ctlq                 (optional, default ctlq; intg allowed)
#|     -- @max_rows: 500             (optional, default 500)
#|     -- @timeout: 600              (optional, seconds)
#|     SELECT ... ;
#| 
#| Output: <requests>_results.txt next to the requests file (round_01_requests.txt -> round_01_results.txt).
#| Every finished query is also appended to <results>.cache.jsonl: if the run stops (expired session,
#| network, Ctrl+C), run the same command again and the queries already answered are not re-run.
#| Delete the cache file to force a full re-run.
#| 
#| Dependencies: Python 3.9+ standard library and dremio_sql.py (never modified). dremio_sql.py is found via
#| --client, then the LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT environment variable, then by walking up the parent folders of
#| this script and of the current directory.
#| """
#| from __future__ import annotations
#| 
#| import argparse
#| import concurrent.futures as cf
#| import datetime as dt
#| import importlib.util
#| import json
#| import os
#| import re
#| import sys
#| import threading
#| import time
#| from pathlib import Path
#| 
#| DEFAULT_ENV = "ctlq"
#| DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 500
#| DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 600
#| HEADER = re.compile(r"^\s*--\s*@(\w+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$")
#| 
#| 
#| # ---------------------------------------------------------------- client loading
#| def find_client(explicit: str | None) -> Path:
#|     candidates = []
#|     if explicit:
#|         candidates.append(Path(explicit))
#|     if os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"):
#|         candidates.append(Path(os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"]))
#|     for start in (Path(__file__).resolve().parent, Path.cwd().resolve()):
#|         for folder in (start, *start.parents):
#|             candidates.append(folder / "dremio_sql.py")
#|     for c in candidates:
#|         if c.is_dir():
#|             c = c / "dremio_sql.py"
#|         if c.is_file():
#|             return c.resolve()
#|     sys.exit("run_round: dremio_sql.py not found (use --client PATH or set LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT)")
#| 
#| 
#| def load_client(path: Path):
#|     spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dremio_sql", path)
#|     mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
#|     try:
#|         spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
#|     except IndexError:
#|         sys.exit(f"run_round: {path} must sit at least 4 folders deep (it computes Path(__file__).parents[3])")
#|     return mod
#| 
#| 
#| # ---------------------------------------------------------------- request parsing
#| def parse_requests(text: str) -> list[dict]:
#|     blocks, cur = [], None
#|     for line in text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n"):
#|         m = HEADER.match(line)
#|         if m and m.group(1).lower() == "id":
#|             cur = {"id": m.group(2), "purpose": "", "env": DEFAULT_ENV, "max_rows": DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
#|                    "timeout": None, "sql_lines": []}
#|             blocks.append(cur)
#|             continue
#|         if cur is None:
#|             continue  # file preamble
#|         if m and not cur["sql_lines"]:
#|             key, val = m.group(1).lower(), m.group(2)
#|             if key in ("max_rows", "timeout"):
#|                 cur[key] = int(val)
#|             else:
#|                 cur[key] = val
#|             continue
#|         cur["sql_lines"].append(line)
#|     out, seen = [], set()
#|     for b in blocks:
#|         sql = "\n".join(b.pop("sql_lines")).strip()
#|         while sql.endswith(";"):
#|             sql = sql[:-1].rstrip()
#|         b["sql"] = sql
#|         if b["id"] in seen:
#|             sys.exit(f"run_round: duplicate id {b['id']}")
#|         seen.add(b["id"])
#|         out.append(b)
#|     return out
#| 
#| 
#| # ---------------------------------------------------------------- formatting
#| def cell(v) -> str:
#|     if v is None:
#|         return "<null>"
#|     if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
#|         v = json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
#|     s = str(v)
#|     return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("|", "\\|").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")
#| 
#| 
#| def render(req: dict, res: dict) -> str:
#|     lines = [f"=== {req['id']}",
#|              f"purpose: {req['purpose']}",
#|              f"env: {req['env']}   max_rows: {req['max_rows']}   elapsed_s: {res.get('elapsed', 0):.1f}"]
#|     if res["status"] == "ERROR":
#|         lines.append("status: ERROR")
#|         lines.append("error: " + cell(res["error"]))
#|         lines.append("sql: " + cell(req["sql"]))
#|     else:
#|         total, n = res["total"], len(res["rows"])
#|         trunc = total > n
#|         lines.append(f"status: OK   rows: {n}   total_rows: {total}" + ("   TRUNCATED" if trunc else ""))
#|         lines.append("columns: " + " | ".join(cell(c) for c in res["columns"]))
#|         for r in res["rows"]:
#|             lines.append(" | ".join(cell(r.get(c)) for c in res["columns"]))
#|     lines.append("")
#|     return "\n".join(lines)
#| 
#| 
#| # ---------------------------------------------------------------- execution
#| class Runner:
#|     def __init__(self, mod, timeout_default: int, env_override: str | None):
#|         self.mod = mod
#|         self.timeout_default = timeout_default
#|         self.env_override = env_override
#|         self.local = threading.local()
#|         self.auth_failed = threading.Event()
#| 
#|     def client(self, env: str):
#|         cache = getattr(self.local, "clients", None)
#|         if cache is None:
#|             cache = self.local.clients = {}
#|         if env not in cache:
#|             cache[env] = self.mod.Client(env=env)
#|         return cache[env]
#| 
#|     def run(self, req: dict) -> dict:
#|         env = self.env_override or req["env"]
#|         req["env"] = env
#|         if self.auth_failed.is_set():
#|             return {"status": "SKIPPED"}
#|         t0 = time.time()
#|         try:
#|             job, columns, rows, total = self.client(env).query(
#|                 req["sql"], req["max_rows"], req["timeout"] or self.timeout_default)
#|             return {"status": "OK", "job": job, "columns": columns, "rows": rows, "total": int(total),
#|                     "elapsed": time.time() - t0}
#|         except Exception as exc:  # keep going: one failure never stops the round
#|             msg = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
#|             if "HTTP 401" in msg or "no Dremio" in msg:
#|                 self.auth_failed.set()
#|             return {"status": "ERROR", "error": msg, "elapsed": time.time() - t0}
#| 
#| 
#| def main(argv=None) -> int:
#|     p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run a round of read-only Dremio requests into one results file.")
#|     p.add_argument("requests", help="round_NN_requests.txt")
#|     p.add_argument("-o", "--out", help="results file (default: round_NN_results.txt next to the requests)")
#|     p.add_argument("--client", help="path to dremio_sql.py")
#|     p.add_argument("--env", choices=["ctlq", "intg"], help="force one environment for every query")
#|     p.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=3, help="parallel queries (default 3)")
#|     p.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, help="default per-query timeout, seconds")
#|     p.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated ids or id prefixes to run")
#|     p.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="parse and check read-only rules only")
#|     args = p.parse_args(argv)
#| 
#|     req_path = Path(args.requests).resolve()
#|     reqs = parse_requests(req_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
#|     if args.only:
#|         keys = [k.strip() for k in args.only.split(",") if k.strip()]
#|         reqs = [r for r in reqs if any(r["id"] == k or r["id"].startswith(k) for k in keys)]
#|     mod = load_client(find_client(args.client))
#| 
#|     bad = [(r["id"], mod.read_only_problem(r["sql"])) for r in reqs]
#|     bad = [(i, b) for i, b in bad if b]
#|     if args.check:
#|         for i, b in bad:
#|             print(f"REFUSED {i}: {b}")
#|         print(f"{len(reqs)} requests parsed, {len(bad)} refused by the read-only guard")
#|         return 1 if bad else 0
#| 
#|     out = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else req_path.with_name(
#|         req_path.name.replace("_requests", "_results") if "_requests" in req_path.name
#|         else req_path.stem + "_results.txt")
#|     cache_path = out.with_name(out.name + ".cache.jsonl")
#|     done = {}
#|     if cache_path.is_file():
#|         for line in cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
#|             if line.strip():
#|                 d = json.loads(line)
#|                 if d["result"]["status"] == "OK" and d.get("sql") == next(
#|                         (r["sql"] for r in reqs if r["id"] == d["id"]), None):
#|                     done[d["id"]] = d["result"]
#|     todo = [r for r in reqs if r["id"] not in done]
#|     print(f"{len(reqs)} requests, {len(done)} already answered (cache), {len(todo)} to run, "
#|           f"{args.workers} workers -> {out.name}")
#| 
#|     runner = Runner(mod, args.timeout, args.env)
#|     results = dict(done)
#|     lock = threading.Lock()
#|     started = time.time()
#|     try:
#|         with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, args.workers)) as pool, \
#|                 cache_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as cache:
#|             futs = {pool.submit(runner.run, r): r for r in todo}
#|             for k, f in enumerate(cf.as_completed(futs), 1):
#|                 r, res = futs[f], f.result()
#|                 if res["status"] == "SKIPPED":
#|                     continue
#|                 with lock:
#|                     results[r["id"]] = res
#|                     cache.write(json.dumps({"id": r["id"], "sql": r["sql"], "result": res},
#|                                            ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
#|                     cache.flush()
#|                 info = (f"{len(res['rows'])}/{res['total']} rows" if res["status"] == "OK"
#|                         else res["error"][:120])
#|                 print(f"[{k}/{len(todo)}] {r['id']} {res['status']} {info} ({res['elapsed']:.0f}s)", flush=True)
#|     except KeyboardInterrupt:
#|         print("interrupted: partial results written; run the same command again to continue")
#| 
#|     ok = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r["status"] == "OK")
#|     err = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r["status"] == "ERROR")
#|     trunc = [i for i, r in results.items() if r["status"] == "OK" and r["total"] > len(r["rows"])]
#|     missing = [r["id"] for r in reqs if r["id"] not in results]
#|     head = [f"# results of {req_path.name}",

#|@@FILE pack_files.py
#| """Pack files and folders into ONE .txt file that can be carried to the other PC.
#| 
#|     python pack_files.py round_00_files.txt  C:\\path\\to\\folder  C:\\path\\to\\file.xlsx ...
#|     python pack_files.py round_00_files.txt  @list.txt          (one path per line in list.txt)
#| 
#| Format (same header as the bundles already exchanged):
#| 
#|     ===== FICHIER : <path> =====                  text file, verbatim (utf-8; cp1252 files are decoded)
#|     ===== FICHIER BASE64 : <path> | <size> bytes | sha256 <hex> =====
#|                                                   any non-text file (xlsx, xls, csv kept byte-exact, zip...)
#|     ===== XLSX DUMP : <path> =====                readable dump of an .xlsx: sheets, dimensions, column widths,
#|                                                   merged cells, then one line per cell:
#|                                                   <sheet>!<cell> | <type> | <numFmt> | <style id> | <value>
#| 
#| CSV and other report outputs are always sent in BASE64 (exact bytes: encoding, separator, line endings) AND
#| as text, because the comparison must be byte- and cell-exact. Standard library only; nothing is modified.
#| Skipped: __pycache__, .git, .venv, node_modules, files above --max-mb (default 25 MB).
#| """
#| from __future__ import annotations
#| 
#| import argparse
#| import base64
#| import hashlib
#| import re
#| import sys
#| import zipfile
#| import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
#| from pathlib import Path
#| 
#| TEXT_EXT = {".txt", ".md", ".py", ".sql", ".json", ".pks", ".pkb", ".pls", ".plb", ".prc", ".fnc", ".trg", ".vw",
#|             ".tab", ".ddl", ".wdw", ".wdg", ".wde", ".wdc", ".xml", ".html", ".htm", ".js", ".css", ".ini",
#|             ".cfg", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".bat", ".ps1", ".sh", ".log", ".tsv", ".properties"}
#| EXACT_ALSO_TEXT = {".csv"}               # base64 + text
#| SKIP_DIRS = {"__pycache__", ".git", ".venv", "venv", "node_modules", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache"}
#| NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
#|       "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"}
#| BUILTIN_FMT = {0: "General", 1: "0", 2: "0.00", 3: "#,##0", 4: "#,##0.00", 9: "0%", 10: "0.00%", 11: "0.00E+00",
#|                14: "mm-dd-yy", 15: "d-mmm-yy", 16: "d-mmm", 17: "mmm-yy", 18: "h:mm AM/PM", 19: "h:mm:ss AM/PM",
#|                20: "h:mm", 21: "h:mm:ss", 22: "m/d/yy h:mm", 37: "#,##0 ;(#,##0)", 38: "#,##0 ;[Red](#,##0)",
#|                39: "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)", 40: "#,##0.00;[Red](#,##0.00)", 45: "mm:ss", 46: "[h]:mm:ss",
#|                47: "mmss.0", 48: "##0.0E+0", 49: "@"}
#| 
#| 
#| def esc(s: str) -> str:
#|     return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("|", "\\|").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")
#| 
#| 
#| def decode_text(raw: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
#|     for enc in ("utf-8-sig", "cp1252", "latin-1"):
#|         try:
#|             return raw.decode(enc), enc
#|         except UnicodeDecodeError:
#|             continue
#|     return raw.decode("latin-1", "replace"), "latin-1"
#| 
#| 
#| def xlsx_dump(path: Path) -> list[str]:
#|     out = []
#|     with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
#|         names = set(z.namelist())
#|         shared = []
#|         if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
#|             for si in ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall("m:si", NS):
#|                 shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t")))
#|         fmts, xf_fmt = dict(BUILTIN_FMT), []
#|         if "xl/styles.xml" in names:
#|             st = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/styles.xml"))
#|             for nf in st.findall("m:numFmts/m:numFmt", NS):
#|                 fmts[int(nf.get("numFmtId"))] = nf.get("formatCode")
#|             for xf in st.findall("m:cellXfs/m:xf", NS):
#|                 xf_fmt.append(int(xf.get("numFmtId", "0")))
#|         wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
#|         rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
#|         target = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels}
#|         for sh in wb.findall("m:sheets/m:sheet", NS):
#|             rid = sh.get(f"{{{NS['r']}}}id")
#|             t = target[rid].lstrip("/")
#|             t = t if t.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + t
#|             root = ET.fromstring(z.read(t))
#|             sname = sh.get("name")
#|             dim = root.find("m:dimension", NS)
#|             out.append(f"# sheet {sname} | state={sh.get('state', 'visible')} | dimension="
#|                        f"{dim.get('ref') if dim is not None else '?'}")
#|             for c in root.findall("m:cols/m:col", NS):
#|                 out.append(f"# col {c.get('min')}-{c.get('max')} width={c.get('width')} hidden={c.get('hidden', '0')}")
#|             for mc in root.findall("m:mergeCells/m:mergeCell", NS):
#|                 out.append(f"# merged {mc.get('ref')}")
#|             for row in root.findall("m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
#|                 for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
#|                     typ, s = c.get("t", "n"), int(c.get("s", "0"))
#|                     v, f = c.find("m:v", NS), c.find("m:f", NS)
#|                     if typ == "s" and v is not None:
#|                         val = shared[int(v.text)]
#|                     elif typ == "inlineStr":
#|                         val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in c.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t"))
#|                     else:
#|                         val = v.text if v is not None else ""
#|                     if f is not None:
#|                         val += f"  [formula: {f.text}]"
#|                     fmt = fmts.get(xf_fmt[s] if s < len(xf_fmt) else 0, "?")
#|                     out.append(f"{sname}!{c.get('r')} | {typ} | {esc(str(fmt))} | {s} | {esc(val)}")
#|     return out
#| 
#| 
#| def iter_files(paths: list[str]):
#|     for p in paths:
#|         if p.startswith("@"):
#|             lines = Path(p[1:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
#|             yield from iter_files([x.strip() for x in lines if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")])
#|             continue
#|         path = Path(p)
#|         if path.is_dir():
#|             for f in sorted(path.rglob("*")):
#|                 if f.is_file() and not (set(f.relative_to(path).parts) & SKIP_DIRS):
#|                     yield f
#|         elif path.is_file():
#|             yield path
#|         else:
#|             print(f"pack_files: not found, skipped: {p}", file=sys.stderr)
#|             yield ("MISSING", p)

#| def main(argv=None) -> int:
#|     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Pack files/folders into one .txt for transport.")
#|     ap.add_argument("output")
#|     ap.add_argument("paths", nargs="+", help="files, folders, or @list.txt")
#|     ap.add_argument("--max-mb", type=float, default=25.0)
#|     args = ap.parse_args(argv)
#|     n = 0
#|     with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
#|         out.write("# packed by pack_files.py\n")
#|         for f in iter_files(args.paths):
#|             if isinstance(f, tuple):
#|                 out.write(f"===== MISSING : {f[1]} =====\n\n")
#|                 continue
#|             size = f.stat().st_size
#|             if size > args.max_mb * 1024 * 1024:
#|                 out.write(f"===== SKIPPED TOO LARGE : {f} | {size} bytes =====\n\n")
#|                 continue
#|             raw = f.read_bytes()
#|             ext = f.suffix.lower()
#|             is_text = ext in TEXT_EXT or (ext == "" and b"\x00" not in raw[:4096])
#|             if is_text and ext not in EXACT_ALSO_TEXT:
#|                 text, enc = decode_text(raw)
#|                 out.write(f"===== FICHIER : {f} =====\n")
#|                 if enc not in ("utf-8-sig",):
#|                     out.write(f"# (decoded from {enc})\n")
#|                 out.write(text.replace("\r\n", "\n"))
#|                 out.write("\n\n")

#|                 out.write(f"===== FICHIER BASE64 : {f} | {size} bytes | sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()} =====\n")
#|                 b = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")

#|                     except Exception as exc:  # the base64 copy above stays usable
#|                         out.write(f"===== XLSX DUMP FAILED : {f} | {exc} =====\n\n")
#|             n += 1

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/pack_files.py =====
"""Pack files and folders into ONE .txt file that can be carried to the other PC.

    python pack_files.py round_00_files.txt  C:\\path\\to\\folder  C:\\path\\to\\file.xlsx ...
    python pack_files.py round_00_files.txt  @list.txt          (one path per line in list.txt)

Format (same header as the bundles already exchanged):

    ===== FICHIER : <path> =====                  text file, verbatim (utf-8; cp1252 files are decoded)
    ===== FICHIER BASE64 : <path> | <size> bytes | sha256 <hex> =====
                                                  any non-text file (xlsx, xls, csv kept byte-exact, zip...)
    ===== XLSX DUMP : <path> =====                readable dump of an .xlsx: sheets, dimensions, column widths,
                                                  merged cells, then one line per cell:
                                                  <sheet>!<cell> | <type> | <numFmt> | <style id> | <value>

CSV and other report outputs are always sent in BASE64 (exact bytes: encoding, separator, line endings) AND
as text, because the comparison must be byte- and cell-exact. Standard library only; nothing is modified.
Skipped: __pycache__, .git, .venv, node_modules, files above --max-mb (default 25 MB).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

TEXT_EXT = {".txt", ".md", ".py", ".sql", ".json", ".pks", ".pkb", ".pls", ".plb", ".prc", ".fnc", ".trg", ".vw",
            ".tab", ".ddl", ".wdw", ".wdg", ".wde", ".wdc", ".xml", ".html", ".htm", ".js", ".css", ".ini",
            ".cfg", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".bat", ".ps1", ".sh", ".log", ".tsv", ".properties"}
EXACT_ALSO_TEXT = {".csv"}               # base64 + text
SKIP_DIRS = {"__pycache__", ".git", ".venv", "venv", "node_modules", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache"}
NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
      "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"}
BUILTIN_FMT = {0: "General", 1: "0", 2: "0.00", 3: "#,##0", 4: "#,##0.00", 9: "0%", 10: "0.00%", 11: "0.00E+00",
               14: "mm-dd-yy", 15: "d-mmm-yy", 16: "d-mmm", 17: "mmm-yy", 18: "h:mm AM/PM", 19: "h:mm:ss AM/PM",
               20: "h:mm", 21: "h:mm:ss", 22: "m/d/yy h:mm", 37: "#,##0 ;(#,##0)", 38: "#,##0 ;[Red](#,##0)",
               39: "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)", 40: "#,##0.00;[Red](#,##0.00)", 45: "mm:ss", 46: "[h]:mm:ss",
               47: "mmss.0", 48: "##0.0E+0", 49: "@"}


def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("|", "\\|").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")


def decode_text(raw: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    for enc in ("utf-8-sig", "cp1252", "latin-1"):
        try:
            return raw.decode(enc), enc
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    return raw.decode("latin-1", "replace"), "latin-1"


def xlsx_dump(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    out = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        names = set(z.namelist())
        shared = []
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
            for si in ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall("m:si", NS):
                shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t")))
        fmts, xf_fmt = dict(BUILTIN_FMT), []
        if "xl/styles.xml" in names:
            st = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/styles.xml"))
            for nf in st.findall("m:numFmts/m:numFmt", NS):
                fmts[int(nf.get("numFmtId"))] = nf.get("formatCode")
            for xf in st.findall("m:cellXfs/m:xf", NS):
                xf_fmt.append(int(xf.get("numFmtId", "0")))
        wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        target = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels}
        for sh in wb.findall("m:sheets/m:sheet", NS):
            rid = sh.get(f"{{{NS['r']}}}id")
            t = target[rid].lstrip("/")
            t = t if t.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + t
            root = ET.fromstring(z.read(t))
            sname = sh.get("name")
            dim = root.find("m:dimension", NS)
            out.append(f"# sheet {sname} | state={sh.get('state', 'visible')} | dimension="
                       f"{dim.get('ref') if dim is not None else '?'}")
            for c in root.findall("m:cols/m:col", NS):
                out.append(f"# col {c.get('min')}-{c.get('max')} width={c.get('width')} hidden={c.get('hidden', '0')}")
            for mc in root.findall("m:mergeCells/m:mergeCell", NS):
                out.append(f"# merged {mc.get('ref')}")
            for row in root.findall("m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
                for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                    typ, s = c.get("t", "n"), int(c.get("s", "0"))
                    v, f = c.find("m:v", NS), c.find("m:f", NS)
                    if typ == "s" and v is not None:
                        val = shared[int(v.text)]
                    elif typ == "inlineStr":
                        val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in c.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t"))
                    else:
                        val = v.text if v is not None else ""
                    if f is not None:
                        val += f"  [formula: {f.text}]"
                    fmt = fmts.get(xf_fmt[s] if s < len(xf_fmt) else 0, "?")
                    out.append(f"{sname}!{c.get('r')} | {typ} | {esc(str(fmt))} | {s} | {esc(val)}")
    return out


def iter_files(paths: list[str]):
    for p in paths:
        if p.startswith("@"):
            lines = Path(p[1:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            yield from iter_files([x.strip() for x in lines if x.strip() and not x.startswith("#")])
            continue
        path = Path(p)
        if path.is_dir():
            for f in sorted(path.rglob("*")):
                if f.is_file() and not (set(f.relative_to(path).parts) & SKIP_DIRS):
                    yield f
        elif path.is_file():
            yield path
        else:
            print(f"pack_files: not found, skipped: {p}", file=sys.stderr)
            yield ("MISSING", p)


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Pack files/folders into one .txt for transport.")
    ap.add_argument("output")
    ap.add_argument("paths", nargs="+", help="files, folders, or @list.txt")
    ap.add_argument("--max-mb", type=float, default=25.0)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    n = 0
    with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
        out.write("# packed by pack_files.py\n")
        for f in iter_files(args.paths):
            if isinstance(f, tuple):
                out.write(f"===== MISSING : {f[1]} =====\n\n")
                continue
            size = f.stat().st_size
            if size > args.max_mb * 1024 * 1024:
                out.write(f"===== SKIPPED TOO LARGE : {f} | {size} bytes =====\n\n")
                continue
            raw = f.read_bytes()
            ext = f.suffix.lower()
            is_text = ext in TEXT_EXT or (ext == "" and b"\x00" not in raw[:4096])
            if is_text and ext not in EXACT_ALSO_TEXT:
                text, enc = decode_text(raw)
                out.write(f"===== FICHIER : {f} =====\n")
                if enc not in ("utf-8-sig",):
                    out.write(f"# (decoded from {enc})\n")
                out.write(text.replace("\r\n", "\n"))
                out.write("\n\n")
            else:
                out.write(f"===== FICHIER BASE64 : {f} | {size} bytes | sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()} =====\n")
                b = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")
                out.write("\n".join(b[i:i + 120] for i in range(0, len(b), 120)))
                out.write("\n\n")
                if ext in EXACT_ALSO_TEXT:
                    text, enc = decode_text(raw)
                    out.write(f"===== FICHIER : {f} =====\n# (text view, decoded from {enc}; exact bytes above)\n")
                    out.write(text.replace("\r\n", "\n") + "\n\n")
                if ext in (".xlsx", ".xlsm"):
                    try:
                        out.write(f"===== XLSX DUMP : {f} =====\n" + "\n".join(xlsx_dump(f)) + "\n\n")
                    except Exception as exc:  # the base64 copy above stays usable
                        out.write(f"===== XLSX DUMP FAILED : {f} | {exc} =====\n\n")
            n += 1
    print(f"{n} files packed into {args.output}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

3. WINDEV (the LuxRep Queries screens: they call the procedure, then read WRK_* and WRITE the file)

3.1 [BLOCKING] For every report: the WinDev window / procedure that (a) builds the parameters passed to the
    Oracle procedure (exact values of p_Period_Type, p_Code_Service, p_Reg_Type, p_Code_Ope_Type, p_Version,

    query on WRK_QUERIES_* (SELECT list = column headers, ORDER BY = row order), (c) builds the FILE NAME,

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/round_01_requests.txt =====
-- round 01 requests (generated). Run on the office PC:
--   python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt
-- 207 requests. Groups: A catalogue, C columns, W LUXIS work tables, F funds, N NAV/lots,
--   B backdated, E eFront, P depooling, D LUXIS copies vs MFGA, G TA/MFGI, R config tables, X FX rates

-- @id: R01_A001
-- @purpose: catalogue: every table/view under MFGA_INFOCENTRE
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE.%'
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_A002
-- @purpose: catalogue: every table/view under MFGI
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MFGI' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGI.%'
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_A003
-- @purpose: catalogue: every table/view under LUXIS
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'LUXIS' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'LUXIS.%'
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_A004
-- @purpose: catalogue: list of top-level sources/schemas with table counts (all sources)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 5000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, COUNT(*) AS N_TABLES
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA;

-- @id: R01_A005
-- @purpose: catalogue: is an Oracle dictionary (ALL_SOURCE / ALL_VIEWS / USER_SOURCE ...) exposed anywhere? would let us read LUXIS function sources directly
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE UPPER(TABLE_NAME) IN ('ALL_SOURCE','USER_SOURCE','DBA_SOURCE','ALL_VIEWS','USER_VIEWS','DBA_VIEWS',
                            'ALL_OBJECTS','ALL_TAB_COLUMNS','ALL_DEPENDENCIES','ALL_TRIGGERS','ALL_MVIEWS')
ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_A006
-- @purpose: plan B: try reading LUXIS function sources through an Oracle dictionary path (expected to fail if not exposed)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 400
SELECT NAME, TYPE, LINE, TEXT FROM LUXIS.SYS.ALL_SOURCE
WHERE OWNER = 'REPADMIN' AND NAME IN ('GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS','GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL')
ORDER BY NAME, TYPE, LINE;

-- @id: R01_A007
-- @purpose: Dremio virtual datasets: SQL definition of views over LUXIS / MFGA / MFGI (BUSINESS, FRI, STAGGING ...) that mention REPADMIN tables used by the reports
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, SUBSTR(VIEW_DEFINITION, 1, 1500) AS VIEW_DEFINITION_START
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."VIEWS"
WHERE UPPER(VIEW_DEFINITION) LIKE '%REPADMIN%'
   OR UPPER(VIEW_DEFINITION) LIKE '%MFGI.GTA%'
   OR UPPER(VIEW_DEFINITION) LIKE '%AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL%'
ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_C001
-- @purpose: columns of every table under MFGA_INFOCENTRE, one row per table (name:type in ordinal order)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS N_COLS,
       LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME || ':' || DATA_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) AS COLS
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE.%'
GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_C002
-- @purpose: columns of every table under MFGI, one row per table (name:type in ordinal order)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS N_COLS,
       LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME || ':' || DATA_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) AS COLS
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MFGI' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGI.%'
GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_C003
-- @purpose: columns of every LUXIS.REPADMIN table/view read by the reports (incl. TAB_FND_STRUCT, V_DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS N_COLS,
       LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME || ':' || DATA_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) AS COLS
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'LUXIS.REPADMIN'
  AND TABLE_NAME IN ('CFA_RECON_SFI_FA','DOC_NUM_CDE_TBL_DESCR','DOC_NUM_ENTITE','DOC_NUM_RELATION','DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL','DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT','DWH_AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND','DWH_AMS_DEAL_FUTURE','DWH_AMS_EQUI_FONDS','DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES','DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL','DWH_AMS_LOT','DWH_AMS_MVT','DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_PNL_DELTA','DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT','DWH_AMS_PORTFOLIO','DWH_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID','DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER','DWH_AMS_ACC_POS','DWH_AMS_ACC_DEF','DWH_AMS_ACC_LINK_CHARTS','DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT','DWT_GTA_FUNDS','DWT_GTA_MESSAGE','DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE','DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE','DWT_GTA_REGISTER','DWT_GTA_REG_CONTRACT','DWT_GTA_SEC_INTL_ID','DWT_GTA_TFC','DWT_GTA_CLIENT','DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE','DWT_GTA_ADRESSES_ELEC','FONDS_TIERS_PUB_V2','LUXREP_ENVOI','LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS','LUXREP_QUERIES_FUTUR_ACCOUNT','LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_EXCLU','LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_FONDS','LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_UMBRELLA','LUXREP_SETUP_DO_CLASS','LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE','LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE','LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE_SETUP','LUXREP_TA_PENDING','LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES','LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED','LUXREP_TB_FONDS','MESI_TRANSACTION_L001','NAV','NAV_PARTS','NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY','OP_TA','OP_TA_ARC','POS_TA','POS_TA_ARC','RELATION_ADRESSAGE','REPORT_DEFINITION','TAB_FND_CPT_AVQ','TAB_FND_MAIN','TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK','TAB_FND_STRUCT','TA_POSITIONS','TURNOVER_CORRESP_NUM_FA_TA','V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG','V_DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE','WEBSERVICE_DATA','WKF_FULL_DETAILS_FACTU','FUND_PTF_CONSO','TBL_TFM','GLOBAL_VAR','GLOBAL_VARIABLES','MFFA_REP_NAV','MFFA_REP_NAV_MULTI_CCY','MFFA_REP_NAV_PART','MFFA_REP_GENERAL_LEDGER')
GROUP BY TABLE_NAME ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_C004
-- @purpose: columns of every LUXIS.REPADMIN WRK_* / *QUERIES* table: the exact LUXIS output layouts (column order = file order?)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 1000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS N_COLS,
       LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME || ':' || DATA_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) AS COLS
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'LUXIS.REPADMIN'
  AND (TABLE_NAME LIKE 'WRK%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%QUERIES%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE 'LUXREP%')
GROUP BY TABLE_NAME ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_C005
-- @purpose: columns of every LUXIS table (all schemas), compact: catalogue of what else LUXIS holds (eFront, JSON, MD ...)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS N_COLS,
       SUBSTR(LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION), 1, 2000) AS COLS
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'LUXIS%'
GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;

-- @id: R01_C006
-- @purpose: plan B (if LISTAGG is refused): raw columns of the key MFGA/MFGI/LUXIS tables
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"
WHERE (TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH' AND TABLE_NAME IN
        ('AMS_LOT','AMS_PORTFOLIO','AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL','AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL','AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT','AMS_NAV_ARC_PNL_DELTA',
         'AMS_EQUI_FONDS','AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL','AMS_PTF_SHARE','AMS_DEAL_FUTURE','AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES'))
   OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGI.GTA%'
   OR (TABLE_SCHEMA = 'LUXIS.REPADMIN' AND TABLE_NAME IN
        ('NAV','NAV_PARTS','OP_TA','POS_TA','TA_POSITIONS','LUXREP_TB_FONDS','TAB_FND_MAIN','V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG'))
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

SELECT * FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ('280287','280299','812645','280499','242013','280421','280273','280274','280268','280605','241582','282303','280334') ORDER BY FA_NUM;

-- @id: R01_F006
-- @purpose: LUXREP_TB_FONDS vs TAB_FND_MAIN: is LUXREP_TB_FONDS a distinct-fund projection of TAB_FND_MAIN? (name/ccy equality counts)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
WITH tb AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) AS N1, MAX(FUND_CCY) AS C1 FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS GROUP BY FA_NUM),
     tf AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) AS N2, MIN(FUND_NAME) AS N2B, MAX(FUND_CCY) AS C2 FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN GROUP BY FA_NUM)
SELECT CASE WHEN tf.FA_NUM IS NULL THEN 'ONLY_TB' WHEN tb.FA_NUM IS NULL THEN 'ONLY_TFM' ELSE 'BOTH' END AS SIDE,
       CASE WHEN tb.N1 = tf.N2 THEN 'NAME_EQ' WHEN tb.N1 = tf.N2B THEN 'NAME_EQ_MIN' ELSE 'NAME_DIFF' END AS NAME_CMP,
       CASE WHEN tb.C1 = tf.C2 THEN 'CCY_EQ' ELSE 'CCY_DIFF' END AS CCY_CMP, COUNT(*) AS N,
       MIN(COALESCE(tb.FA_NUM, tf.FA_NUM)) AS EX
FROM tb FULL OUTER JOIN tf ON tb.FA_NUM = tf.FA_NUM GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

-- @id: R01_F007
-- @purpose: AMS_PORTFOLIO last lot of reference funds, all columns (look for a long/official name, fund type, father, consolidated flag)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p WHERE C_FUND IN ('280287','280299','812645','280499','242013','280421','280273','280274','280268','280605','241582','282303','280334')) x WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY C_FUND;

-- @id: R01_F008
-- @purpose: fund name concordance LUXREP_TB_FONDS.FUND_NAME vs AMS_PORTFOLIO.L_FUND (last lot): equal / upper-trim equal / prefix
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
WITH p AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO) x WHERE RN = 1),
     t AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) FUND_NAME, MAX(FUND_CCY) FUND_CCY FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS GROUP BY FA_NUM)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.C_FUND IS NULL THEN 'NOT_IN_MFGA'
            WHEN t.FUND_NAME = p.L_FUND THEN 'EQ'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.FUND_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(p.L_FUND)) THEN 'EQ_CASE_TRIM'
            WHEN POSITION(UPPER(TRIM(p.L_FUND)) IN UPPER(t.FUND_NAME)) > 0 THEN 'MFGA_IN_LUXIS'
            ELSE 'DIFF' END AS NAME_CMP,
       CASE WHEN t.FUND_CCY = p.C_CCY THEN 'CCY_EQ' ELSE 'CCY_DIFF' END AS CCY_CMP,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(t.FA_NUM) AS EX_FUND
FROM t LEFT JOIN p ON p.C_FUND = t.FA_NUM GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_F009
-- @purpose: fund name examples LUXIS vs MFGA (40 funds where they differ)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 40
WITH p AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND FROM (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO) x WHERE RN = 1)
SELECT t.FA_NUM, t.FUND_NAME AS LUXIS_NAME, p.L_FUND AS MFGA_NAME
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t JOIN p ON p.C_FUND = t.FA_NUM
WHERE t.FUND_NAME <> p.L_FUND ORDER BY t.FA_NUM LIMIT 40;

-- @id: R01_N001
-- @purpose: REPADMIN.NAV all columns, 280287 last 15 NAVs

SELECT * FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV WHERE NAV_FUND_NO = '280287' ORDER BY NAV_DATE_NAV DESC LIMIT 15;
