-- @id: R01_N003
-- @purpose: REPADMIN.NAV value profile: NAV_CONTROLE x NAV_PUB x NAV_TYP_TRT (2026)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT NAV_CONTROLE, NAV_PUB, NAV_TYP_TRT, COUNT(*) AS N, COUNT(DISTINCT NAV_FUND_NO) AS N_FUNDS
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV WHERE NAV_DATE_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

-- @id: R01_N004
-- @purpose: AMS_LOT value profile: C_NAV_TYP x C_TRAIT x validation/dispo filled (2026)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT C_NAV_TYP, C_TRAIT, CASE WHEN D_H_VALIDATION_NAV IS NULL THEN 'VAL_NULL' ELSE 'VAL_SET' END AS VAL,
       CASE WHEN D_H_DISPO IS NULL THEN 'DISPO_NULL' ELSE 'DISPO_SET' END AS DISPO, COUNT(*) AS N,
       COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) AS N_FUNDS
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

-- @id: R01_N005
-- @purpose: CONCORDANCE NAV vs AMS_LOT per (fund, NAV date) 2026-H1: NAV_CONTROLE/NAV_PUB vs lot attributes of the last lot
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, C_NAV_TYP, C_TRAIT, D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, D_H_DISPO, D_H_PROCESS,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN,
              COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV) NL,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV) NO
       FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'),
     n AS (SELECT NAV_FUND_NO, NAV_DATE_NAV, NAV_CONTROLE, NAV_PUB FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV
           WHERE NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
SELECT n.NAV_CONTROLE, n.NAV_PUB,
       CASE WHEN l.C_FUND IS NULL THEN 'NO_LOT' ELSE 'LOT' END AS HAS_LOT,
       l.C_NAV_TYP AS LAST_TYP, CASE WHEN l.NO > 0 THEN 'HAS_O' ELSE 'NO_O' END AS ANY_O, l.C_TRAIT AS LAST_TRAIT,
       CASE WHEN l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV IS NULL THEN 'VAL_NULL' ELSE 'VAL_SET' END AS VAL,
       CASE WHEN l.D_H_DISPO IS NULL THEN 'DISPO_NULL' ELSE 'DISPO_SET' END AS DISPO,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(n.NAV_FUND_NO) AS EX_FUND, MAX(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS EX_DATE
FROM n LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM l WHERE RN = 1) l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8;

-- @id: R01_N006
-- @purpose: CONCORDANCE reverse: AMS_LOT (fund, D_NAV) 2026-H1 with no REPADMIN.NAV row, by C_NAV_TYP of last lot
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, MAX(C_NAV_TYP) AS T_MAX, MIN(C_NAV_TYP) AS T_MIN FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT
       WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY C_FUND, D_NAV)
SELECT l.T_MIN, l.T_MAX, CASE WHEN n.NAV_FUND_NO IS NULL THEN 'NO_NAV' ELSE 'NAV' END AS IN_NAV, COUNT(*) AS N,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.C_FUND) AS N_FUNDS, MIN(l.C_FUND) AS EX_FUND
FROM l LEFT JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n ON n.NAV_FUND_NO = l.C_FUND AND n.NAV_DATE_NAV = l.D_NAV
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

-- @id: R01_N007
-- @purpose: CONCORDANCE NAV_DATE_TRT (calc date) vs AMS_LOT D_H_PROCESS / D_H_VALIDATION_NAV / D_H_DISPO of last O lot (2026-H1)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, D_H_PROCESS, D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, D_H_DISPO,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN
       FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND C_NAV_TYP = 'O')
SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=PROCESS'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=VALIDATION'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_DISPO AS DATE) THEN 'TRT=DISPO'
            WHEN n.NAV_DATE_TRT IS NULL THEN 'TRT_NULL' ELSE 'TRT_OTHER' END AS TRT_CMP,
       CASE WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_DISPO AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=DISPO'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=VALIDATION'
            WHEN CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) = CAST(l.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE) THEN 'PUB=PROCESS'
            WHEN n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION IS NULL THEN 'PUB_NULL' ELSE 'PUB_OTHER' END AS PUB_CMP,
       n.NAV_PUB, COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(n.NAV_FUND_NO) AS EX_FUND, MIN(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS EX_DATE
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n JOIN (SELECT * FROM l WHERE RN = 1) l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
WHERE n.NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

-- @id: R01_N008
-- @purpose: NAV vs AMS_LOT for 280287 side by side (2026-05-25 .. 2026-07-10)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 300
SELECT n.NAV_DATE_NAV, n.NAV_CONTROLE, n.NAV_PUB, n.NAV_TYP_TRT, n.NAV_DATE_TRT, n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION,
       l.N_LOT, l.C_NAV_TYP, l.C_TRAIT, l.D_H_PROCESS, l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, l.D_H_DISPO
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO AND l.D_NAV = n.NAV_DATE_NAV
WHERE n.NAV_FUND_NO = '280287' AND n.NAV_DATE_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-10'
ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV, l.N_LOT;

-- @id: R01_N009

SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS ZZ_TOTAL_ROWS FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.REPADMIN.NAV t WHERE NAV_FUND_NO = '280287' ORDER BY NAV_DATE_NAV DESC LIMIT 5;

-- @id: R01_N010

-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 5
SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS ZZ_TOTAL_ROWS FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING t LIMIT 5;

-- @id: R01_B001
-- @purpose: V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG: profile + the list of backdated funds
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT NAV_BACKDATED, COUNT(*) AS N,
       SUBSTR(LISTAGG(CASE WHEN NAV_BACKDATED = 1 THEN FUND_NO END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FUND_NO), 1, 2000) AS FUNDS
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG GROUP BY NAV_BACKDATED;

-- @id: R01_B002
-- @purpose: V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG all columns, 20 rows (does it carry more than FUND_NO/NAV_BACKDATED?)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20
SELECT * FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG ORDER BY NAV_BACKDATED DESC, FUND_NO LIMIT 20;

-- @id: R01_B003
-- @purpose: CANDIDATE RULE backdated = fund has lots of a non-official NAV type / several lots per NAV date: cross-tab vs flag (2026)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
WITH l AS (SELECT C_FUND,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_O,
              SUM(CASE WHEN C_NAV_TYP <> 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NOT_O,
              COUNT(DISTINCT C_NAV_TYP) AS N_TYPES, MAX(C_NAV_TYP) AS MAX_TYP, MIN(C_NAV_TYP) AS MIN_TYP,
              COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS, COUNT(DISTINCT D_NAV) AS N_DNAV
       FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY C_FUND)
SELECT b.NAV_BACKDATED, CASE WHEN l.N_NOT_O > 0 THEN 'HAS_NOT_O' ELSE 'ONLY_O' END AS TYPES, l.MIN_TYP, l.MAX_TYP,
       CASE WHEN l.N_LOTS > 3 * l.N_DNAV THEN 'MANY_LOTS_PER_NAV' ELSE 'FEW_LOTS_PER_NAV' END AS DENSITY,
       COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(b.FUND_NO) AS EX
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG b JOIN l ON l.C_FUND = b.FUND_NO GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5;

-- @id: R01_B004
-- @purpose: AMS_LOT for backdated fund 280499, 2026-06 (how backdating shows in MFGA)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 300
SELECT * FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE C_FUND = '280499' AND D_NAV BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-07-01' ORDER BY N_LOT;

-- @id: R01_B005
-- @purpose: AMS_PORTFOLIO columns that could carry the backdated flag: last lot of backdated vs non-backdated funds (10 each)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 40
WITH b AS (SELECT FUND_NO, NAV_BACKDATED, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NAV_BACKDATED ORDER BY FUND_NO) R
             FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG)
SELECT b.NAV_BACKDATED, p.* FROM (SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN
      FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO x) p JOIN b ON b.FUND_NO = p.C_FUND AND b.R <= 10 WHERE p.RN = 1
ORDER BY b.NAV_BACKDATED, p.C_FUND;

-- @id: R01_E001
-- @purpose: eFront funds: TAB_FND_MAIN.EFRONT x presence in AMS_LOT x presence in MFGA_INFOCENTRE.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
WITH t AS (SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(EFRONT) AS EFRONT FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN GROUP BY FA_NUM),
     l AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_FUND FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE D_NAV >= DATE '2025-01-01'),
     c AS (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING)
SELECT t.EFRONT, CASE WHEN l.C_FUND IS NULL THEN 'NO_LOT' ELSE 'LOT' END AS IN_MFGA,
       CASE WHEN c.FA_NUM IS NULL THEN 'NO_EF_CLOSING' ELSE 'EF_CLOSING' END AS IN_EF, COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(t.FA_NUM) AS EX
FROM t LEFT JOIN l ON l.C_FUND = t.FA_NUM LEFT JOIN c ON c.FA_NUM = t.FA_NUM
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

-- @id: R01_E002
-- @purpose: plan B (if the Infocentre path fails): LUXIS.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING sample
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 5
SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS ZZ_TOTAL_ROWS FROM LUXIS.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING t LIMIT 5;

-- @id: R01_P001
-- @purpose: every (pool, feeder) link in AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL with first/last D_NAV and row count (full history)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT C_FUND AS POOL, C_SUB_FUND AS FEEDER, MIN(D_NAV) AS LINK_FIRST, MAX(D_NAV) AS LINK_LAST,
       COUNT(*) AS N_ROWS, COUNT(DISTINCT D_NAV) AS N_DNAV, MIN(N_LOT) AS LOT_MIN, MAX(N_LOT) AS LOT_MAX
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_FUND, C_SUB_FUND ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_P002
-- @purpose: AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL all columns, pool 280421 last 2 NAV dates
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT * FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL WHERE C_FUND = '280421'
  AND D_NAV >= (SELECT MAX(D_NAV) - 3 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL WHERE C_FUND = '280421') ORDER BY D_NAV, C_SUB_FUND LIMIT 200;

-- @id: R01_P003
-- @purpose: per pool and per feeder: AMS_LOT activity (first/last D_NAV, last lot, lot count since 2023) for every fund present in VAL_POOL
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20000
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH f AS (SELECT C_FUND AS F FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL UNION SELECT C_SUB_FUND FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL)
SELECT l.C_FUND, MIN(l.D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV, MAX(l.N_LOT) AS LAST_LOT, COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS,
       MAX(CASE WHEN l.C_NAV_TYP = 'O' THEN l.D_NAV END) AS LAST_O_NAV
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l WHERE l.C_FUND IN (SELECT F FROM f) GROUP BY l.C_FUND ORDER BY 1;

-- @id: R01_P004
-- @purpose: candidate transfer lot per pool: first pool lot after the last lot of all its (ended) feeders, with its NAV
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 5000
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH link AS (SELECT C_FUND AS POOL, C_SUB_FUND AS FEEDER, MAX(D_NAV) AS LINK_LAST
              FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_FUND, C_SUB_FUND),
     plast AS (SELECT C_FUND, MAX(D_NAV) AS POOL_LAST FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT GROUP BY C_FUND),
     ended AS (SELECT k.POOL, k.FEEDER, k.LINK_LAST FROM link k JOIN plast p ON p.C_FUND = k.POOL
               WHERE p.POOL_LAST > k.LINK_LAST),
     flast AS (SELECT e.POOL, MAX(l.N_LOT) AS FEEDERS_LAST_LOT, MAX(e.LINK_LAST) AS DEPOOL_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT e.FEEDER) AS N_FEEDERS
               FROM ended e JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = e.FEEDER AND l.D_NAV <= e.LINK_LAST GROUP BY e.POOL)
SELECT f.POOL, f.N_FEEDERS, f.DEPOOL_DATE, f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT,
       MIN(l.N_LOT) AS TRANSFER_LOT, MIN(l.D_NAV) AS TRANSFER_NAV
FROM flast f LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l ON l.C_FUND = f.POOL AND l.N_LOT > f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT
GROUP BY f.POOL, f.N_FEEDERS, f.DEPOOL_DATE, f.FEEDERS_LAST_LOT ORDER BY f.DEPOOL_DATE DESC;

-- @id: R01_P005
-- @purpose: OPEN QUESTION: feeders with lots after their depooling (280127, 714902, 740228, 740234, 239602, 253168, 253169, 280202): lots + entries count
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, l.D_NAV, l.C_NAV_TYP, l.C_TRAIT, l.D_H_PROCESS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_CASH_MVT c WHERE c.C_FUND = l.C_FUND AND c.N_LOT = l.N_LOT) AS N_CASH_MVT,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT m WHERE m.C_FUND = l.C_FUND AND m.N_LOT = l.N_LOT) AS N_MVT
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280127','714902','740228','740234','239602','253168','253169','280202')
  AND l.D_NAV >= DATE '2026-06-01' ORDER BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT;

-- @id: R01_P006
-- @purpose: same funds on INTG (frozen 03/07/2026): do the post-depooling lots exist there?
-- @env: intg
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT C_FUND, COUNT(*) AS N_LOTS, MIN(D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV, MAX(N_LOT) AS LAST_LOT
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT WHERE C_FUND IN ('280127','714902','740228','740234','239602','253168','253169','280202')
  AND D_NAV >= DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY C_FUND ORDER BY 1;

-- @id: R01_P007
-- @purpose: mid-pools (FUND_TYPE 5) and multi-level: funds that are BOTH pool and feeder in VAL_POOL
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
-- @timeout: 1800
SELECT a.C_FUND AS MIDPOOL, MIN(a.D_NAV) AS AS_POOL_FIRST, MAX(a.D_NAV) AS AS_POOL_LAST,
       MIN(b.C_FUND) AS ITS_POOL, MIN(b.D_NAV) AS AS_FEEDER_FIRST, MAX(b.D_NAV) AS AS_FEEDER_LAST
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL a JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL b ON b.C_SUB_FUND = a.C_FUND
GROUP BY a.C_FUND ORDER BY 1;

-- @id: R01_P008
-- @purpose: feeders linked to several pools over time
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
SELECT C_SUB_FUND, COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) AS N_POOLS,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT C_FUND, ',') AS POOLS, MIN(D_NAV) AS FIRST_NAV, MAX(D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL GROUP BY C_SUB_FUND HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT C_FUND) > 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- @id: R01_P009
-- @purpose: PROOF ONLY (not a source): TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK depooling structures, to measure the MFGA detection against them
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
SELECT COALESCE(FA_POOL_NUM, FA_NUM) AS POOL, DEPOOLING_DATE, DEPOOLING_LOT, FUND_TYPE,
       COUNT(*) AS N_CLASSES, COUNT(DISTINCT FA_NUM) AS N_FUNDS,
       SUBSTR(LISTAGG(DISTINCT FA_NUM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FA_NUM), 1, 600) AS FUNDS
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 2, 1, 4;

-- @id: R01_P010
-- @purpose: LUXIS fund types of every fund present in VAL_POOL (2 feeder, 3 pool, 5 mid-pool): to check the MFGA roles
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
WITH f AS (SELECT C_FUND AS F, 'POOL' AS ROLE FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL
           UNION SELECT C_SUB_FUND, 'FEEDER' FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL)
SELECT f.ROLE, t.FUND_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT f.F) AS N, MIN(f.F) AS EX1, MAX(f.F) AS EX2
FROM f LEFT JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t ON t.FA_NUM = f.F GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_G032
-- @purpose: MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG: profile by language and table (to replace DWT_GTA_MESSAGE / GET_DWT_MESSAGE)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
SELECT CLANGUE, COUNT(*) AS N, COUNT(DISTINCT CTABLE) AS N_TABLES FROM MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG GROUP BY CLANGUE ORDER BY 1;

-- @id: R01_G033
-- @purpose: CONCORDANCE DWT_GTA_MESSAGE (last lot) vs MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG on (table, element, label), by table
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 500
-- @timeout: 1800
WITH d AS (SELECT C_TABLE, C_ELEMENT, C_LNG, L_LIBELLE FROM (SELECT C_TABLE, C_ELEMENT, C_LNG, L_LIBELLE,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_TABLE, C_ELEMENT, C_LNG ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) RN FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE) x WHERE RN = 1),
     m AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(CTABLE) AS T, TRIM(CELEM) AS E, LIBELLE AS L FROM MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG)
SELECT d.C_TABLE, d.C_LNG, COUNT(*) AS N_DWT, SUM(CASE WHEN m.T IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_SAME_LABEL
FROM d LEFT JOIN m ON m.T = TRIM(d.C_TABLE) AND m.E = TRIM(d.C_ELEMENT) AND m.L = d.L_LIBELLE
WHERE d.C_TABLE IN ('TYPREG','TYPGRP','TYPPERS','REGTYP','SETTLE','COUNTRY','CDELIV','COPER','TCOMM','MONNAIES')
GROUP BY d.C_TABLE, d.C_LNG ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- @id: R01_G034
-- @purpose: side by side DWT_GTA_MESSAGE vs CODESMSG for table COPER (operation codes), 30 rows
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 30
SELECT d.C_TABLE, d.C_ELEMENT, d.C_LNG, d.L_LIBELLE, d.L_ABREGE, d.N_LOT, m.CTABLE, m.CELEM, m.CLANGUE, m.LIBELLE
FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE d LEFT JOIN MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG m ON TRIM(m.CTABLE) = TRIM(d.C_TABLE) AND TRIM(m.CELEM) = TRIM(d.C_ELEMENT)
WHERE d.C_TABLE = 'COPER' ORDER BY d.C_ELEMENT, d.C_LNG, d.N_LOT DESC LIMIT 30;

-- @id: R01_G035
-- @purpose: MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG: 20 rows of COPER / TYPREG (format of codes and languages)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 20
SELECT * FROM MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG WHERE CTABLE IN ('COPER','TYPREG') ORDER BY CTABLE, CELEM LIMIT 20;

-- @id: R01_X002
-- @purpose: MFGA tables whose name suggests FX rates (any schema)
-- @env: ctlq
-- @max_rows: 2000
-- @timeout: 1200
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"
WHERE (TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGA%' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'MFGI%' OR TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE 'LUXIS%')
  AND (UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%FRX%' OR UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%RATE%' OR UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%XRATE%'
       OR UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%CHANGE%' OR UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%CCY%' OR UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%CURR%')
ORDER BY 1, 2;

===== FICHIER : reporting_v2/exchange/run_round.py =====
"""Run one round of Dremio requests and write a single results file.

Usage (office PC, after `python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq`, and `--env intg` if the round uses it):

    python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt
    python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --workers 4 --timeout 900
    python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --only R01_A001,R01_A002
    python run_round.py round_01_requests.txt --check          (parse + read-only check, no Dremio call)

Request file format (one block per query):

    -- @id: R01_Q001
    -- @purpose: free text
    -- @env: ctlq                 (optional, default ctlq; intg allowed)
    -- @max_rows: 500             (optional, default 500)
    -- @timeout: 600              (optional, seconds)
    SELECT ... ;

Output: <requests>_results.txt next to the requests file (round_01_requests.txt -> round_01_results.txt).
Every finished query is also appended to <results>.cache.jsonl: if the run stops (expired session,
network, Ctrl+C), run the same command again and the queries already answered are not re-run.
Delete the cache file to force a full re-run.

Dependencies: Python 3.9+ standard library and dremio_sql.py (never modified). dremio_sql.py is found via
--client, then the LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT environment variable, then by walking up the parent folders of
this script and of the current directory.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import concurrent.futures as cf
import datetime as dt
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_ENV = "ctlq"
DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 500
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 600
HEADER = re.compile(r"^\s*--\s*@(\w+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- client loading
def find_client(explicit: str | None) -> Path:
    candidates = []
    if explicit:
        candidates.append(Path(explicit))
    if os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"):
        candidates.append(Path(os.environ["LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT"]))
    for start in (Path(__file__).resolve().parent, Path.cwd().resolve()):
        for folder in (start, *start.parents):
            candidates.append(folder / "dremio_sql.py")
    for c in candidates:
        if c.is_dir():
            c = c / "dremio_sql.py"
        if c.is_file():
            return c.resolve()
    sys.exit("run_round: dremio_sql.py not found (use --client PATH or set LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT)")


def load_client(path: Path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dremio_sql", path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    except IndexError:
        sys.exit(f"run_round: {path} must sit at least 4 folders deep (it computes Path(__file__).parents[3])")
    return mod


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- request parsing
def parse_requests(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    blocks, cur = [], None
    for line in text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n"):
        m = HEADER.match(line)
        if m and m.group(1).lower() == "id":
            cur = {"id": m.group(2), "purpose": "", "env": DEFAULT_ENV, "max_rows": DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
                   "timeout": None, "sql_lines": []}
            blocks.append(cur)
            continue
        if cur is None:
            continue  # file preamble
        if m and not cur["sql_lines"]:
            key, val = m.group(1).lower(), m.group(2)
            if key in ("max_rows", "timeout"):
                cur[key] = int(val)
            else:
                cur[key] = val
            continue
        cur["sql_lines"].append(line)
    out, seen = [], set()
    for b in blocks:
        sql = "\n".join(b.pop("sql_lines")).strip()
        while sql.endswith(";"):
            sql = sql[:-1].rstrip()
        b["sql"] = sql
        if b["id"] in seen:
            sys.exit(f"run_round: duplicate id {b['id']}")
        seen.add(b["id"])
        out.append(b)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- formatting
def cell(v) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return "<null>"
    if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
        v = json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
    s = str(v)
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("|", "\\|").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")


def render(req: dict, res: dict) -> str:
    lines = [f"=== {req['id']}",
             f"purpose: {req['purpose']}",
             f"env: {req['env']}   max_rows: {req['max_rows']}   elapsed_s: {res.get('elapsed', 0):.1f}"]
    if res["status"] == "ERROR":
        lines.append("status: ERROR")
        lines.append("error: " + cell(res["error"]))
        lines.append("sql: " + cell(req["sql"]))
    else:
        total, n = res["total"], len(res["rows"])
        trunc = total > n
        lines.append(f"status: OK   rows: {n}   total_rows: {total}" + ("   TRUNCATED" if trunc else ""))
        lines.append("columns: " + " | ".join(cell(c) for c in res["columns"]))
        for r in res["rows"]:
            lines.append(" | ".join(cell(r.get(c)) for c in res["columns"]))
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- execution
class Runner:
    def __init__(self, mod, timeout_default: int, env_override: str | None):
        self.mod = mod
        self.timeout_default = timeout_default
        self.env_override = env_override
        self.local = threading.local()
        self.auth_failed = threading.Event()

    def client(self, env: str):
        cache = getattr(self.local, "clients", None)
        if cache is None:
            cache = self.local.clients = {}
        if env not in cache:
            cache[env] = self.mod.Client(env=env)
        return cache[env]

    def run(self, req: dict) -> dict:
        env = self.env_override or req["env"]
        req["env"] = env
        if self.auth_failed.is_set():
            return {"status": "SKIPPED"}
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            job, columns, rows, total = self.client(env).query(
                req["sql"], req["max_rows"], req["timeout"] or self.timeout_default)
            return {"status": "OK", "job": job, "columns": columns, "rows": rows, "total": int(total),
                    "elapsed": time.time() - t0}
        except Exception as exc:  # keep going: one failure never stops the round
            msg = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            if "HTTP 401" in msg or "no Dremio" in msg:
                self.auth_failed.set()
            return {"status": "ERROR", "error": msg, "elapsed": time.time() - t0}


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run a round of read-only Dremio requests into one results file.")
    p.add_argument("requests", help="round_NN_requests.txt")
    p.add_argument("-o", "--out", help="results file (default: round_NN_results.txt next to the requests)")
    p.add_argument("--client", help="path to dremio_sql.py")
    p.add_argument("--env", choices=["ctlq", "intg"], help="force one environment for every query")
    p.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=3, help="parallel queries (default 3)")
    p.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, help="default per-query timeout, seconds")
    p.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated ids or id prefixes to run")
    p.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="parse and check read-only rules only")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    req_path = Path(args.requests).resolve()
    reqs = parse_requests(req_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if args.only:
        keys = [k.strip() for k in args.only.split(",") if k.strip()]
        reqs = [r for r in reqs if any(r["id"] == k or r["id"].startswith(k) for k in keys)]
    mod = load_client(find_client(args.client))

    bad = [(r["id"], mod.read_only_problem(r["sql"])) for r in reqs]
    bad = [(i, b) for i, b in bad if b]
    if args.check:
        for i, b in bad:
            print(f"REFUSED {i}: {b}")
        print(f"{len(reqs)} requests parsed, {len(bad)} refused by the read-only guard")
        return 1 if bad else 0

    out = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else req_path.with_name(
        req_path.name.replace("_requests", "_results") if "_requests" in req_path.name
        else req_path.stem + "_results.txt")
    cache_path = out.with_name(out.name + ".cache.jsonl")
    done = {}
    if cache_path.is_file():
        for line in cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            if line.strip():
                d = json.loads(line)
                if d["result"]["status"] == "OK" and d.get("sql") == next(
                        (r["sql"] for r in reqs if r["id"] == d["id"]), None):
                    done[d["id"]] = d["result"]
    todo = [r for r in reqs if r["id"] not in done]
    print(f"{len(reqs)} requests, {len(done)} already answered (cache), {len(todo)} to run, "
          f"{args.workers} workers -> {out.name}")

    runner = Runner(mod, args.timeout, args.env)
    results = dict(done)
    lock = threading.Lock()
    started = time.time()
    try:
        with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, args.workers)) as pool, \
                cache_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as cache:
            futs = {pool.submit(runner.run, r): r for r in todo}
            for k, f in enumerate(cf.as_completed(futs), 1):
                r, res = futs[f], f.result()
                if res["status"] == "SKIPPED":
                    continue
                with lock:
                    results[r["id"]] = res
                    cache.write(json.dumps({"id": r["id"], "sql": r["sql"], "result": res},
                                           ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
                    cache.flush()
                info = (f"{len(res['rows'])}/{res['total']} rows" if res["status"] == "OK"
                        else res["error"][:120])
                print(f"[{k}/{len(todo)}] {r['id']} {res['status']} {info} ({res['elapsed']:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("interrupted: partial results written; run the same command again to continue")

    ok = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r["status"] == "OK")
    err = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r["status"] == "ERROR")
    trunc = [i for i, r in results.items() if r["status"] == "OK" and r["total"] > len(r["rows"])]
    missing = [r["id"] for r in reqs if r["id"] not in results]
    head = [f"# results of {req_path.name}",
            f"# generated: {dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}   wall_s: {time.time() - started:.0f}",
            f"# requests: {len(reqs)}   ok: {ok}   error: {err}   not_run: {len(missing)}   truncated: {len(trunc)}",
            "# cells: <null> = NULL; | \\ newlines are escaped as \\| \\\\ \\n",
            "# truncated ids: " + (", ".join(trunc) or "none"),
            "# error ids: " + (", ".join(i for i, r in results.items() if r["status"] == "ERROR") or "none"),
            "# not run: " + (", ".join(missing) or "none"),
            ""]
    body = [render(r, results[r["id"]]) for r in reqs if r["id"] in results]
    out.write_text("\n".join(head + body), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"written {out} ({ok} ok, {err} error, {len(missing)} not run)")
    if runner.auth_failed.is_set():
        print("Dremio session refused or expired: run `python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq` (and intg) "
              "then the same command again; answered queries are kept.")
        return 3
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

for i, m in enumerate(ms):
    p = m.group(1)
    rel = p[len(prefix):] if p.startswith(prefix) else p.replace(':', '')

import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/cinqtreize-ops/sortie-lxs/source_bundle')
from dremio_sql import read_only_problem
CAT = {
 ("MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH","AMS_LOT"): [("C_FUND","CHARACTER VARYING"),("N_LOT","BIGINT"),("D_NAV","DATE"),("C_NAV_TYP","CHARACTER VARYING")],
 ("MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH","AMS_MVT"): [("C_FUND","CHARACTER VARYING"),("N_LOT","BIGINT"),("Q_QTY","DECIMAL"),("BADCOL","CHARACTER VARYING")],
 ("MFGI.GTA","REGISTER"): [("REGISTER_ID","INTEGER"),("NAME","CHARACTER VARYING"),("REG_TYPE","CHARACTER VARYING")],
 ("LUXIS.REPADMIN","DWH_AMS_LOT"): [("C_FUND","CHARACTER VARYING"),("N_LOT","BIGINT"),("D_NAV","DATE"),("C_NAV_TYP","CHARACTER VARYING")],
 ("LUXIS.REPADMIN","DWT_GTA_REGISTER"): [("C_N_REGISTER","INTEGER"),("L_NAME","CHARACTER VARYING"),("C_REG_TYP","CHARACTER VARYING"),("N_LOT","BIGINT")],
 ("LUXIS.REPADMIN","NAV"): [("NAV_FUND_NO","CHARACTER VARYING"),("NAV_DATE_NAV","DATE"),("NAV_PUB","CHARACTER VARYING")],
 ("LUXIS.REPADMIN","SOMETHING_ELSE"): [("X","INTEGER")],
}
class Client:
    def __init__(self, env='intg'): self.env=env
    def query(self, sql, max_rows, timeout):
        if 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"' in sql:
            rows=[{"TABLE_SCHEMA":s,"TABLE_NAME":t,"TABLE_TYPE":"TABLE"} for (s,t) in CAT if any(s==r or s.startswith(r+'.') or s.startswith(r) for r in re.findall(r"'([A-Z_]+)[.%']",sql))]
            return 'j',["TABLE_SCHEMA","TABLE_NAME","TABLE_TYPE"],rows,len(rows)
        if 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA."COLUMNS"' in sql:
            sch=re.search(r"TABLE_SCHEMA = '([^']+)'",sql).group(1)
            rows=[{"TABLE_SCHEMA":s,"TABLE_NAME":t,"ORDINAL_POSITION":i+1,"COLUMN_NAME":c,"DATA_TYPE":ty,"NUMERIC_PRECISION":18 if ty=="DECIMAL" else None,"NUMERIC_SCALE":4 if ty=="DECIMAL" else None} for (s,t),cols in CAT.items() if s==sch for i,(c,ty) in enumerate(cols)]
            return 'j',list(rows[0]) if rows else [],rows,len(rows)
        if 'AMS_MVT' in sql and 'APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT' in sql: raise RuntimeError('job FAILED: function not supported')
        if '"BADCOL"' in sql and 'MIN("BADCOL")' in sql: raise RuntimeError('job FAILED: bad column type')
        aliases=re.findall(r'AS "(\w+)"',sql)
        if aliases==["zz_n"]:
            n=5_000_000 if 'AMS_MVT' in sql and 'zz' in sql else 1000
            return 'j',aliases,[{"zz_n":n}],1
        if aliases and aliases[0]=="zz_n":
            row={a:(1000 if a=='zz_n' else 900 if a.startswith('nn') else 3 if a.startswith('nd') else 'A' if a.startswith('mn') else 'Z') for a in aliases}
            return 'j',aliases,[row],1
        if aliases[:2]==["v","n"]:
            rows=[{"v":"O","n":10},{"v":"P","n":2}]; return 'j',["v","n"],rows,2
        rows=[{"COL1":"Dupont","N":5,"LIBELLE":"x"} for _ in range(min(3,max_rows))]
        return 'j',["COL1","N","LIBELLE"],rows,len(rows)

- [Query volume feedback](feedback-query-volume.md) — user wants thousands of generated exploration queries, not a curated few

===== FICHIER : memory/dremio-client-quirks.md =====
---
name: dremio-client-quirks
description: dremio_sql.py guard and Dremio pitfalls learnt for the LUXIS-exit project
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: 7b547b9d-31bd-422d-90b1-3f89692adfcb
  modified: 2026-10-29T17:49:24.628Z
---

- dremio_sql.py guard refuses words SET USE COMMENT INTO LOAD LOCK COPY CALL EXPORT IMPORT REFRESH etc. anywhere outside quotes (even as column names: double-quote them). Validate locally with read_only_problem (run_round.py --check).
- dremio_sql.py does Path(__file__).parents[3] at import: must sit >= 4 folders deep. Client.query(sql, max_rows, timeout) -> (job, columns, rows[dict], total). Default env intg; project uses ctlq.
- Decoys: MFGA.DWH.* are near-empty; real tables are MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.*. Literal IN lists >~1000 / VALUES joins silently truncate. Use NULLIF for divisions (Gandiva). Every DWH table is versioned by N_LOT.
Related: [[luxis-exit-project]]

===== FICHIER : memory/feedback-query-volume.md =====
---
name: feedback-query-volume
description: User wants far more Dremio exploration queries than a curated round (hundreds/thousands, generated)
metadata:
  type: feedback
---
User found 207 curated queries too few: "il faut vraiment que tu regardes énormément de requêtes possibles".

**Why:** each trip to the office is costly; exhaustive exploration up front avoids extra rounds.
**How to apply:** generate queries at the office from the catalogue (profiles of every relevant table, cascading fallbacks, auto-matching), not hand-picked lists; keep only summaries for the return channel. See [[luxis-exit-project]].

===== FICHIER : memory/luxis-exit-project.md =====
---
name: luxis-exit-project
description: "State of the LUXIS-exit reporting_v2 mission (rebuild LUXIS reports from MFGA/MFGI via Dremio, offline PC)"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 7b547b9d-31bd-422d-90b1-3f89692adfcb
  modified: 2026-10-29T17:49:24.528Z
---

Mission (pasted 2026-10-29): rebuild ~30 LUXIS reports in /Users/cinqtreize-ops/sortie-lxs/reporting_v2/, one autonomous folder per report, Dremio only reachable from the office PC; exchange only via .txt files.

- Input bundle okeopjr.txt was split into source_bundle/ (587 files). source_bundle/claude.md is an OLD instruction (4 reports, Sonnet) superseded by the mission.
- Step 0 done 2026-10-29: exchange/round_00_files_needed.txt, round_01_requests.txt (207 queries, generator exchange/gen/gen_round01.py), run_round.py, pack_files.py (txt+base64 transport). Waiting for files + round_01_results.txt.
- Transport = capsule (2026-10-29): exchange/capsule/make_capsule.py manifest_NN.json -> outbox/to_office_NN.txt (a .txt that is a Python script: `python to_office_NN.txt` at office runs steps + collects files) ; office returns ONE from_office_NN.txt ; unpack with exchange/capsule/inbox.py -> exchange/inbox/NN/. Use it for every round (queries and tests).
- Channel (updated 2026-10-29): this PC -> office via public GitHub repo https://github.com/Sabofxx/reporting_v2 (user asked me to publish it; uploaded with gh api contents PUT, no local git; user downloads the ZIP). Office -> me: ONE .txt, `explore.py export [--files ...]` -> reporting_v2/from_office.txt (lines `Q {json}` per query, masked, then pack_files section). No photos anymore.
- New rule overrides old GL decisions: no pool pre-transfer lines (no double count), no third avant/apres file, depooling detected from AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL not TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK.

**Why:** each office round-trip is expensive; keep state so the next session resumes at step 1 (audit) without re-deriving.
**How to apply:** on resume, check the returned files against round_00 list, then audit/AUDIT.md. See [[dremio-client-quirks]].

# Mission : reconstruire les rapports LUXIS hors de LUXIS (MFGA / MFGI Infocentre), un dossier autonome par rapport

Tu travailles avec Opus 5.5. Tu peux lancer **au maximum 5 sous-agents en parallèle** (Opus 5.5). Tu commences par l'**étape 0** (§ 0) : me demander tous les fichiers dont tu as besoin, puis t'arrêter. Ensuite, tu travailles **sans t'arrêter jusqu'au bout**, sauf quand tu as besoin de données Dremio (voir § 3, « Échanges avec le PC du bureau »). Dans ce cas, tu prépares UN fichier d'échange aussi complet que possible, tu t'arrêtes, puis tu reprends dès que je te rends le fichier de résultats.

Toute la documentation, les noms de fichiers, le code, la CLI et les messages sont en **anglais**. Je te parle en français.

## 1. Contexte

- LUXIS est l'application de reporting actuelle (Oracle, schéma `REPADMIN`). Ses rapports sont dans le package `PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES`, et d'autres packages pour l'IRP. **Tu as accès au code source LUXIS complet** : packages, fonctions, vues.
- L'objectif est de **sortir de LUXIS** : produire **exactement les mêmes rapports que LUXIS** (mêmes colonnes, même ordre, mêmes valeurs, mêmes formats, même nom de fichier), mais à partir de :
  - `MFGA_INFOCENTRE` (Multifonds Fund Accounting, schéma `DWH` surtout) ;
  - `MFGI` (Multifonds Global Transfer Agent : `MFGI.GTA`, `MFGI.AMS`, ...) — il remplace les copies LUXIS `LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_*`, `OP_TA`, `POS_TA`, `TA_POSITIONS`, etc.
- Les rapports doivent **survivre au depooling** (§ 5).
- Tout passe par **Dremio, en lecture seule** (SELECT / WITH uniquement). Serveurs : `ctlq` (défaut) et `intg` (copie figée au 03/07/2026).
- **Tu n'as PAS accès à Dremio depuis ce PC.** Le PC du bureau, lui, l'a : il a le client `dremio_sql.py` déjà configuré (`python dremio_sql.py login --env ctlq`). Les rapports que tu écris tourneront là-bas et interrogeront Dremio via `dremio_sql.py`.

## 3. Échanges avec le PC du bureau (règle centrale)

Les deux PC ne communiquent **que par fichiers `.txt`**, transportés à la main. **Chaque aller-retour coûte cher : minimise-les.** Vise au plus 2 ou 3 tours de données pour le mapping de TOUS les rapports, puis des tours de tests.

### 3.1 Tours de requêtes (mapping et exploration)

1. Tu écris **un seul fichier** `exchange/round_NN_requests.txt`, qui contient toutes les requêtes dont tu as besoin à ce stade pour tous les rapports, regroupées et numérotées :
   ```
   -- @id: R01_Q001
   -- @purpose: columns of MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND (coupons_dividendes, bcr_sub_red_fa)
   -- @env: ctlq
   -- @max_rows: 500
   SELECT ... ;
   ```
2. Tu fournis **un script autonome** `exchange/run_round.py` qui, sur le PC du bureau :
   - lit ce fichier ;
   - exécute chaque requête via `dremio_sql.py` (`Client(env=...).query(sql, limit, timeout)`) ;
   - écrit **un seul fichier** `exchange/round_NN_results.txt` (pour chaque requête : id, nombre de lignes, colonnes, lignes séparées par `|`, ou le message d'erreur) ;
   - continue même si une requête échoue.

   Il ne doit dépendre de rien d'autre que `dremio_sql.py` et de la bibliothèque standard.
3. Tu me donnes **la commande exacte** à lancer, tu t'arrêtes et tu attends le fichier de résultats.

Pour rentabiliser chaque tour :
- Demande en masse les métadonnées (`INFORMATION_SCHEMA."TABLES"` / `"COLUMNS"` sur `MFGA_INFOCENTRE%`, `MFGI%`, `LUXIS%`).
- Demande des échantillons ciblés sur les fonds des références, des comptages, et des requêtes de **concordance LUXIS vs MFGA/MFGI** (même donnée des deux côtés, différences comptées).
- Anticipe les requêtes du tour suivant : si une hypothèse peut échouer, mets dès maintenant la requête du plan B.
- Borne toujours la taille (`LIMIT`, agrégats) pour que le fichier reste lisible.

### 3.2 Tours de tests

Quand des rapports sont prêts :
- tu écris `exchange/test_round_NN_commands.txt` : la liste des commandes CLI à lancer, sur les 3 références de chaque rapport, plus des cas de depooling et des cas limites ;
- tu fournis `exchange/run_tests.py`, qui lance toutes ces commandes et regroupe dans **un seul** `exchange/test_round_NN_results.txt` : la sortie console, le verdict, le résumé du `compare` et les 200 premiers écarts cellule par cellule de chaque cas.

Demain je serai au bureau et je ferai beaucoup de tests : prépare des tours de tests riches.

## 4. Architecture : un dossier autonome par rapport (règle absolue)

```
reporting_v2/
  reports/
    <report_key>/              ex. bcr_mouvements, bcr_coupons_dividendes, ta_registres, general_ledger, ...
      __main__.py              CLI du rapport : python -m reports.<report_key> ...  (ou python <report_key>/cli.py)
      ...                      tout le code du rapport : connexion (chargement de dremio_sql.py), paramètres,
                               fenêtres de lots, depooling, SQL, contrôles, écriture XLSX/CSV, compare
      sql/                     un fichier .sql par étape, paramétré (aucune valeur codée en dur)
      config/                  si nécessaire (jamais de donnée qui vieillit sans le dire, cf. § 6)
      tests/                   tests unitaires hors ligne (SQL rendu, paramètres, compare, écriture)
      README.md                documentation du rapport (§ 8)
  data_model/
    bronze/  silver/  gold/    scripts SQL de création (§ 7)
    data_model.html            la grande documentation du data model (§ 7)
  exchange/                    fichiers d'échange et scripts run_round.py / run_tests.py
  audit/AUDIT.md               audit du code existant (§ 9)
  tools/check_independence.py  vérification de l'indépendance (outil de contrôle, pas un rapport)
```

**Indépendance :**
- Un rapport ne doit importer, lire ou partager **aucun fichier** d'un autre rapport. Aucun dossier `core/` ou `common/` commun : chaque dossier embarque sa propre copie de ce dont il a besoin. La duplication de code est acceptée et voulue.
- La seule dépendance externe autorisée est `dremio_sql.py`. Chaque rapport le trouve via la variable d'environnement `LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT`, sinon en remontant les dossiers parents.
- Bibliothèques tierces autorisées (`pip install` possible) ; chaque dossier a son `requirements.txt`. N'importe quelle version récente de Python 3.
- `tools/check_independence.py` le prouve. Pour chaque dossier :
  1. il le copie **seul** dans un répertoire temporaire ;
  2. il lance `--help` et les tests unitaires hors ligne ;
  3. il vérifie par analyse statique qu'aucun import ni chemin ne pointe vers un autre rapport, et que tout le SQL est SELECT/WITH.

  Le résultat va dans `audit/AUDIT.md`.

**CLI (terminal uniquement, pas de page web)**, une par rapport, sur le modèle de l'existant :
- `run` : paramètres en options, ou menu interactif si aucune option n'est donnée.
- `compare <sortie> <référence LUXIS>` : rapprochement **cellule par cellule**.
- `show-sql` : rend le SQL sans l'exécuter.
- `probe` : vérifie la session Dremio.
- `funds` : sélecteur de fonds.
- `depooling <fonds>` : structure détectée.

Paramètres repris de LUXIS pour chaque rapport : fonds (sélecteur), sélecteur de date (NAV / calcul), plage Date From / Date To, type de période (plage, dernier jour disponible, jusqu'à la dernière NAV publiée), formats XLSX / CSV, `--env ctlq|intg` (défaut `ctlq`), `--names mfga|luxis` (source du nom et de la devise du fonds, au choix), plus les paramètres propres au rapport.

Sorties :
- les fichiers **au nom et au format LUXIS** (XLSX et CSV) ;
- `summary.json` : paramètres, fenêtres de lots, depooling, contrôles, verdict CONFORME / ÉCART / NON VÉRIFIABLE ;
- les SQL exécutés ;
- une page HTML statique de synthèse, sans serveur.

## 5. Depooling (pour TOUS les rapports, pas seulement les BCR)

- **Source de détection : `MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL`** (`C_FUND` = pool, `C_SUB_FUND` = feeder), combinée à `AMS_LOT`. **Ne pas utiliser `TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK` ni la Table Fonds de LUXIS.** Retravaille la détection pour qu'elle tienne dans la durée (§ 6).
- **Le rapport reste UN SEUL rapport, identique à LUXIS.** Si la période demandée chevauche un depooling :
  - les lignes **avant** le depooling viennent des anciens feeders et **gardent le numéro et le nom du feeder** ;
  - les lignes **après** viennent du pool, à partir du lot de transfert.

  On ne marque nulle part la séparation : pas de colonne en plus, pas de fichier séparé, le format LUXIS reste inchangé. Pas de double compte : les lignes du pool avant le lot de transfert sont exclues, car il consolide déjà ses feeders.
- Un rapport dont l'information porte uniquement sur le pool est produit **en continu** sur le pool.
- Un **ancien feeder demandé directement** après sa date de depooling est **refusé**, et le message donne le numéro du pool à demander.
- Pour les rapports « photo à une date » (par exemple certains rapports TA) : reproduis exactement le comportement LUXIS lu dans le code source, et applique le depooling de la façon qui garde la donnée cohérente. Documente ton choix.
- Reprends ce qui est déjà prouvé dans `frd-poc-general-ledger/docs/DEPOOLING.md`, et ses questions ouvertes (feeders avec des lots après le depooling sur CTLQ, mid-pools `FUND_TYPE` 5, depoolings anciens visibles seulement dans MFGA).

## 6. Sortir de LUXIS

Pour chaque table ou fonction LUXIS lue par un rapport :
1. **Trouve l'équivalent MFGA / MFGI** et prouve la concordance par une requête de comparaison (§ 3). Exemples : `TAB_FND_MAIN` → `AMS_PORTFOLIO` ; `DWT_GTA_REGISTER` / `CLIENT` → `MFGI.GTA.REGISTER` / `CLIENT` ; `POS_TA` → `MFGI.GTA.REG_POSITION` ; libellés → `MFGI.AMS.CODESMSG` ; première NAV avec parts → `AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL`.
2. Sinon, une **table figée** (`config/*.json`) n'est acceptable que si elle reste juste dans le temps. Une liste qui vieillit (fonds créés après le gel, nouveaux depoolings) ne l'est pas.
3. Sinon, **garde la table LUXIS**, documente pourquoi, et définis dans le data model (§ 7) la table de remplacement à créer hors de LUXIS.

Les fonctions LUXIS (`GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS`, `GET_BLOOMBERG_TICKER`, `Get_Date_Nav_Prev`, `get_Date_Last_Available_Day`, `get_Date_Last_Published_Day`, ...) sont réécrites en SQL. Toutes les règles viennent du code source : rien n'est codé en dur.

Particularités de Dremio déjà connues :
- pas de `ROWNUM` (utiliser `ROW_NUMBER()`) ;
- `TRIM(x) <> ''` est instable (utiliser `LENGTH`) ;
- les mots réservés utilisés comme noms de colonne (`COMMENT`, `SET`, `USE`, `LOAD`, `EXPORT`, ...) se mettent entre guillemets doubles ;
- refuser toute troncature silencieuse : comparer le total de lignes à la limite.

## 7. Le data model cible (bronze / silver / gold)

Les tables doivent pouvoir être recréées **ailleurs que dans LUXIS**. Livre une architecture médaillon classique :

- **Bronze** : le miroir de l'Infocentre (`MFGA_INFOCENTRE`, `MFGI`), tables brutes utilisées par les rapports, même grain, colonnes reprises.
- **Silver** : données nettoyées et conformes :
  - référentiel fonds (nom et devise, deux modes) ;
  - lots et fenêtres de NAV ;
  - **historique des structures de depooling**, construit depuis MFGA et historisé pour durer ;
  - titres et identifiants ;
  - registres et clients TA ;
  - taux de change ;
  - tables de remplacement des tables LUXIS sans équivalent.
- **Gold** : une table ou vue par rapport, au format exact de la sortie LUXIS.

À livrer :
- les scripts SQL de création `data_model/bronze|silver|gold/*.sql` (DDL et vues, dialecte Dremio par défaut ; indique les adaptations pour un autre moteur) ;
- **`data_model/data_model.html`**, un grand fichier HTML autonome. Il couvre chaque table et chaque colonne des trois couches, avec : type, description, **source exacte** (table et colonne d'origine, transformation), table LUXIS remplacée, rapports qui l'utilisent, preuve de concordance (référence de la requête et résultat), et ce qui reste dépendant de LUXIS, avec la raison. Ajoute un schéma du lignage (rapport → gold → silver → bronze → source) et un index.

## 8. Documentation par rapport

Un `README.md` en anglais par dossier :
- procédure LUXIS reproduite ;

- tables lues ;
- règles de fenêtre et de depooling ;

Pas de documentation au-delà : le README de chaque rapport, plus `data_model.html` et `audit/AUDIT.md`.

## 9. Audit du code existant (à faire en premier)

Avant d'écrire du nouveau code, lis tout l'existant et écris `audit/AUDIT.md`. Pour chaque projet (`luxrep_reports`, General Ledger, First NAV Page, conso) :
- ce qui marche ;
- les erreurs ;
- les fichiers manquants (par exemple `luxrep_reports/tx_change_nav/report.py`, `ta/registres.py` et `ta/sub_red.py` sont absents alors que des sorties existent) ;
- les dépendances LUXIS restantes ;
- les dépendances partagées à casser (`luxrep_reports/core/`) ;
- les écarts avec le code source LUXIS.

Puis, pour chaque rapport de `reports_list.txt` : la procédure LUXIS correspondante, les tables LUXIS lues, les équivalents candidats et les données manquantes. Ce plan alimente le tour de requêtes n° 1.

## 10. Exactitude : 100 %, aucune tolérance

- Le critère est **identique cellule par cellule** à la sortie LUXIS, sur les 3 références de chaque rapport : mêmes lignes, même ordre, mêmes valeurs, mêmes types et formats de cellule, même nom de fichier. Aucune tolérance d'arrondi, de nom ou d'ordre.
- Quand un écart vient de l'évolution des données depuis l'extraction LUXIS, prouve-le par une requête et documente-le. Ne l'absorbe jamais en ajoutant une tolérance.
- En plus de la comparaison, ajoute à chaque rapport des contrôles internes adaptés : équilibres, chaînages, totaux contre la source, absence de doublons, fenêtres de lots cohérentes autour du depooling.

## 11. Ordre de travail

0. **Étape 0 (§ 0)** : `exchange/round_00_files_needed.txt` + tour de requêtes n° 1 préparé → arrêt.
1. Réception des fichiers, puis lecture complète (code source LUXIS, specs, existant, `scratch/`) et `audit/AUDIT.md`.
2. Exploitation des résultats du tour n° 1. Si besoin, tour de requêtes n° 2 pour tous les rapports à la fois, avec les éventuels fichiers encore manquants → arrêt.
3. Mapping et premier jet du data model ; tour supplémentaire seulement si c'est indispensable, en ne posant que ce qui manque vraiment → arrêt.
4. Construction des rapports en parallèle (5 sous-agents au maximum, un rapport par sous-agent à la fois). Commence par reprendre `bcr_mouvements` et `bcr_coupons_dividendes` (validés) comme modèle de dossier autonome, puis General Ledger, First NAV Page et conso, puis le reste.
5. `tools/check_independence.py` passe pour tous les dossiers.
6. **Tour de tests** (3 références par rapport, depooling, cas limites) → arrêt ; corrections ; nouveau tour jusqu'à 100 % partout.
7. README par rapport, `data_model.html` et les scripts bronze / silver / gold finalisés.
8. Synthèse finale : un tableau des rapports avec statut (100 % / écart expliqué / bloqué), dépendances LUXIS restantes et questions ouvertes.

"""Read-only SQL client for the FPL Dremio (INTG, and CTLQ with --env ctlq), for the assistant and the user alike.

    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login            sign in (user name, hidden password); keeps the session token (DPAPI)
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login --token    or paste the session token of a signed-in browser
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py probe            server status, then an authenticated read
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py query -f q.sql -o out.csv [--max-rows N] [--timeout S]
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py query -o out.csv -          SQL from standard input

The user allowed SQL reads on Dremio on 1 Oct 2026, on one condition: nothing is modified, changed,
created or deleted. Two guards enforce it, and neither can be switched off:
  1. the statement: one statement, starting with SELECT or WITH, and no write, definition or passthrough
     keyword (EXTERNAL_QUERY and the like) anywhere outside string literals, quoted names and comments;
     a single scanner pass blinds those, an unbalanced quote or comment is refused, and `call` applies
     the check itself on the submit-a-query route (read_only_problem, _scan, _check_sql_body);
  2. the HTTP calls: one host, and only the status, catalog-read, submit-a-query, job-status,
     job-results and job-cancel routes (ALLOWED); a redirect is never followed (_NoRedirect), and
     `query -o` writes only under User Guides/dremio/ (out_path). Cancelling a job only stops our own query.
The token is the user's: Dremio's own permissions still apply on top. Personal access tokens are
switched off on this server (its public UI config says isPATEnabled false, 1 Oct 2026), so `login`
signs in with the user name and password through /apiv2/login and keeps only the session token that
Dremio returns, never the password; `login --token` keeps the session token of a signed-in browser instead
(in the browser console: copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')).token)). When the session expires
(HTTP 401), the user runs `login` or `login --token` again; the assistant stops and asks. The server is
the fpl-INTG one: whether its data are production or a copy is OQ-052, so every result is graded B.
DEC-032 and RB-04 ("Dremio") hold the decision and the procedure. `login` must run in a real terminal:
the hidden prompt does not work inside an agent's shell. Standard library only.

Two servers, one at a time (DEC-033): `intg` (the default) and `ctlq`, chosen by `--env` on each command
(`login --token --env ctlq`, `probe --env ctlq`, `query --env ctlq ...`) or by `Client(env="ctlq")`. Each
has its own host constant and its own token file; a client calls only the host of its own environment, and
both guards apply unchanged. No production server is listed, and none can be added without a decision.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import getpass
import json
import os

import ssl
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse

# The only servers this client may call (DEC-032, DEC-033). INTG stays the default everywhere.
ENVIRONMENTS = {
    "intg": "dremio.apps.fpl-intg.kube.pictet.com",
    "ctlq": "dremio.apps.fpl-ctlq.kube.pictet.com",
}
DEFAULT_ENV = "intg"
HOST = ENVIRONMENTS[DEFAULT_ENV]
BASE = f"https://{HOST}"
CRED_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", os.path.expanduser("~"))) / "BA-Assistant"
CRED_FILE = CRED_DIR / "dremio-intg.token"
PAGE = 500  # Dremio returns at most 500 rows per results call

ALLOWED = [
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/apiv2/server_status$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/catalog(/[A-Za-z0-9-]+)?$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/catalog/by-path/[^?#]+$")),
    ("POST", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/sql$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/results$")),
    ("POST", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/cancel$")),
]

WRITE_WORDS = {
    "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "MERGE", "UPSERT", "CREATE", "DROP", "ALTER", "TRUNCATE",
    "GRANT", "REVOKE", "REFRESH", "COPY", "OPTIMIZE", "VACUUM", "ROLLBACK", "COMMIT", "CALL", "EXECUTE",
    "SET", "RESET", "USE", "RENAME", "COMMENT", "ANALYZE", "LOAD", "UNLOAD", "EXPORT", "IMPORT", "INTO",
    "EXEC", "PREPARE", "ATTACH", "DETACH", "LOCK",
}  # REPLACE is left out: it is also a string function; CREATE OR REPLACE is caught by CREATE
# Functions that hand a string to the source to run natively (the LUXIS source is Oracle): the string is
# blinded by the scanner, so the word itself is refused. Other functions stay allowed (DEC-032, risk accepted).
PASSTHROUGH_WORDS = {
    "EXTERNAL_QUERY", "OPENQUERY", "OPENROWSET", "OPENDATASOURCE", "DBLINK", "DBLINK_EXEC", "NATIVE_QUERY",
    "PASSTHROUGH", "PASS_THROUGH", "REMOTE_QUERY", "EXECUTE_IMMEDIATE",
}
BANNED_WORDS = WRITE_WORDS | PASSTHROUGH_WORDS
WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*")
# A `--` comment ends at any of these, so the scanner never hides more text than a server could.
LINE_ENDS = "\n\r\x0b\x0c\x85\u2028\u2029"


class DremioError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def host_of(env: str) -> str:
    """The host of a known environment; any other name is refused."""
    if env not in ENVIRONMENTS:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: unknown Dremio environment {env!r} (known: {', '.join(ENVIRONMENTS)})")
    return ENVIRONMENTS[env]


def base_of(env: str) -> str:
    return f"https://{host_of(env)}"


def cred_file(env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> Path:
    """The token file of an environment: INTG keeps its historical name; read at call time so tests can redirect it."""
    host_of(env)
    return CRED_FILE if env == DEFAULT_ENV else CRED_DIR / f"dremio-{env}.token"


def _env_flag(env: str) -> str:
    return "" if env == DEFAULT_ENV else f" --env {env}"


def _scan(sql: str) -> str:
    """The statement with comments, string literals and quoted names blinded, in a single left to right
    pass: whichever token starts first wins, so a marker inside another token never opens a new one.
    Raises DremioError for an unbalanced quote or comment, or for a quoting style the scanner does not know."""
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(sql)
    while i < n:
        c = sql[i]
        if sql.startswith("--", i):
            while i < n and sql[i] not in LINE_ENDS:
                i += 1
            out.append(" ")
        elif sql.startswith("/*", i):
            end = sql.find("*/", i + 2)
            if end < 0:
                raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: unterminated /* comment")
            if "/*" in sql[i + 2:end]:
                raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: nested /* comment is ambiguous")
            i = end + 2
            out.append(" ")
        elif c in "'\"":
            j = i + 1
            while True:
                j = sql.find(c, j)
                if j < 0:
                    raise DremioError(f"refused, not a read-only query: unterminated {c} quote")
                if sql.startswith(c, j + 1):  # a doubled quote is an escaped quote
                    j += 2
                    continue
                break
            i = j + 1
            out.append(" " if c == "'" else " x ")
        elif c == "`":
            raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: backtick quoting is not supported by the guard")
        else:
            out.append(c)
            i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def read_only_problem(sql: str) -> str | None:
    """Why `sql` is refused, or None when it is a single read-only query."""
    try:
        bare = _scan(sql)
    except DremioError as exc:
        return str(exc).split(": ", 1)[1]
    body = bare.strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    if not body:
        return "the statement is empty"
    if ";" in body:
        return "one statement at a time: a semicolon may only end it"
    words = [w.upper() for w in WORD.findall(body)]
    if words[0] not in ("SELECT", "WITH"):
        return f"a read starts with SELECT or WITH, not {words[0]}"
    banned = sorted(set(words) & BANNED_WORDS)
    if banned:
        return "write or definition keyword outside a string: " + ", ".join(banned)
    return None


def _check_call(method: str, url: str, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> None:
    host = host_of(env)
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname != host:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: only https://{host} may be called")
    if not any(m == method and rx.fullmatch(parts.path) for m, rx in ALLOWED):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: {method} {parts.path} is not a read route of this client")
    if ".." in parts.path or re.search(r"%(2e|2f|5c)", parts.path, re.I):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: {parts.path} holds a dot segment or an encoded separator")


def _check_sql_body(body) -> None:
    """Guard 1 for the submit-a-query route, so that `call` cannot be used to skip it."""
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or not isinstance(body.get("sql"), str) or set(body) - {"sql", "context"}:
        raise DremioError("refused: POST /api/v3/sql takes only a body of the form {\"sql\": <statement>}")
    problem = read_only_problem(body["sql"])
    if problem:
        raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: " + problem)


class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    """A redirect would carry the Authorization header to a URL the allowlist never saw."""

    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: the server answered HTTP {code} with a redirect; the client follows none")


def _dpapi():
    """Windows DPAPI (CryptProtectData/CryptUnprotectData), current-user scope. Standard library only."""
    import ctypes
    import ctypes.wintypes as wintypes

    class DATA_BLOB(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("cbData", wintypes.DWORD), ("pbData", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char))]

    def _blob(data: bytes) -> DATA_BLOB:
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(data, len(data))
        return DATA_BLOB(len(data), ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char)))

    def _bytes(blob: DATA_BLOB) -> bytes:
        try:
            return ctypes.string_at(blob.pbData, blob.cbData)
        finally:
            ctypes.windll.kernel32.LocalFree(blob.pbData)

    def protect(data: bytes) -> bytes:
        inblob = _blob(data)
        outblob = DATA_BLOB()
        if not ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptProtectData(
            ctypes.byref(inblob), None, None, None, None, 0, ctypes.byref(outblob)
        ):
            raise ctypes.WinError()
        return _bytes(outblob)

    def unprotect(data: bytes) -> bytes:
        inblob = _blob(data)
        outblob = DATA_BLOB()
        if not ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptUnprotectData(
            ctypes.byref(inblob), None, None, None, None, 0, ctypes.byref(outblob)
        ):
            raise ctypes.WinError()
        return _bytes(outblob)

    return protect, unprotect


def save_token(token: str, scheme: str = "_dremio", env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> Path:
    protect, _ = _dpapi()
    target = cred_file(env)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(protect(json.dumps({"scheme": scheme, "token": token}).encode("utf-8")))
    return target


def load_token(env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> str:
    """The Authorization header value: `_dremio<token>` for a session, `Bearer <token>` for a PAT."""
    source = cred_file(env)
    if not source.is_file():
        raise DremioError(f"no Dremio {env.upper()} session stored: run `python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login"
                          f"{_env_flag(env)}` in a terminal")
    _, unprotect = _dpapi()
    raw = unprotect(source.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
    try:
        stored = json.loads(raw)
    except ValueError:
        stored = {"scheme": "Bearer", "token": raw}
    return ("Bearer " if stored["scheme"] == "Bearer" else "_dremio") + stored["token"]


LOGIN_PATH = "/apiv2/login"


def sign_in(user: str, password: str, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> str:
    """POST the credentials once, to the host of `env` only, and return the session token Dremio gives back."""
    host = host_of(env)
    url = base_of(env) + LOGIN_PATH
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname != host:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: only https://{host} may be called")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({"userName": user, "password": password}).encode("utf-8"),
                                 method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with Client(env=env).opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raise DremioError(f"sign-in refused (HTTP {exc.code}): check the user name and password") from None
    token = body.get("token")
    if not token:
        raise DremioError("sign-in answered without a token")
    return token


class Client:
    def __init__(self, auth: str | None = None, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV):
        self.env = env
        self.base = base_of(env)  # refuses an unknown environment before anything else
        self.auth = auth  # a full Authorization value; None reads the stored session of `env`
        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(
            urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),  # an internal host: never through the web proxy
            urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl.create_default_context()),
            _NoRedirect())

    def call(self, method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None, auth: bool = True):
        url = self.base + path
        _check_call(method, url.split("?", 1)[0], self.env)
        if method == "POST" and urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).path == "/api/v3/sql":
            _check_sql_body(body)
        data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8") if body is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if auth:
            req.add_header("Authorization", self.auth or load_token(self.env))
        try:
            with self.opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            text = exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:300]
            if exc.code == 401 and auth:
                raise DremioError(f"HTTP 401: the Dremio {self.env.upper()} session has expired or was refused; run "
                                  f"`python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login{_env_flag(self.env)}` or "
                                  f"`login --token{_env_flag(self.env)}` again in a terminal") from None
            raise DremioError(f"HTTP {exc.code} on {method} {path}: {text}") from None
        return json.loads(raw) if raw.strip().startswith(("{", "[")) else raw

    def query(self, sql: str, max_rows: int, timeout: int):
        problem = read_only_problem(sql)
        if problem:
            raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: " + problem)
        job = self.call("POST", "/api/v3/sql", {"sql": sql})["id"]
        start, state = time.time(), ""
        while True:
            status = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}")
            state = status.get("jobState", "")
            if state == "COMPLETED":
                break
            if state in ("FAILED", "CANCELED", "CANCELLED"):
                raise DremioError(f"job {job} {state}: {status.get('errorMessage', '')[:300]}")
            if time.time() - start > timeout:
                self.call("POST", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/cancel", {})
                raise DremioError(f"job {job} cancelled after {timeout} s")
            time.sleep(1.5)
        total = int(status.get("rowCount", 0))
        rows, columns = [], []
        offset = 0
        while offset < min(total, max_rows):
            limit = min(PAGE, max_rows - offset)
            page = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/results?offset={offset}&limit={limit}")
            columns = columns or [c["name"] for c in page.get("schema", [])]
            rows += page.get("rows", [])
            offset += limit
        if not columns and total == 0:
            page = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/results?offset=0&limit=1")
            columns = [c["name"] for c in page.get("schema", [])]
        return job, columns, rows, total


OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "User Guides" / "dremio"  # git-ignored: results stay local


def out_path(arg: str) -> Path:
    """The CSV path, refused unless it resolves to a place under User Guides, dremio (links included)."""
    path = Path(arg).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(OUT_DIR.resolve()):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: -o must name a file under {OUT_DIR}")
    return path


def write_csv(path: Path, columns: list[str], rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(columns)
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow(["" if r.get(c) is None else (json.dumps(r[c], ensure_ascii=False)
                        if isinstance(r.get(c), (dict, list)) else r.get(c)) for c in columns])


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only SQL on the FPL Dremio (INTG by default, or CTLQ).")
    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    common.add_argument("--env", choices=list(ENVIRONMENTS), default=DEFAULT_ENV,
                        help="Dremio server: intg (default) or ctlq; each keeps its own session token")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    lg = sub.add_parser("login", parents=[common], help="sign in with user name and password; keeps only the session token")
    lg.add_argument("--token", action="store_true",
                    help="paste the session token of a signed-in browser instead of signing in")
    sub.add_parser("probe", parents=[common], help="server status and an authenticated catalog read")
    q = sub.add_parser("query", parents=[common], help="run one SELECT or WITH query and write the result as CSV")
    q.add_argument("sql_file", nargs="?", help="'-' for standard input")
    q.add_argument("-f", "--file", help="file holding the query")
    q.add_argument("-o", "--out", required=True, help="CSV file to write")
    q.add_argument("--max-rows", type=int, default=10000)
    q.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300, help="seconds before the job is cancelled")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    if not sys.stdout.isatty():
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    try:
        if args.cmd == "login" and args.token:
            raw = getpass.getpass(f"Dremio {args.env.upper()} session token copied from the browser (hidden): ").strip().strip('"')
            if not raw:
                print("nothing stored")
                return 1
            scheme = "Bearer" if raw.startswith("eyJ") else "_dremio"
            token = raw[len("_dremio"):] if raw.startswith("_dremio") else raw
            header = ("Bearer " if scheme == "Bearer" else "_dremio") + token
            Client(header, env=args.env).call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"{args.env.upper()} token accepted; stored in {save_token(token, scheme, args.env)}")
        elif args.cmd == "login":
            user = input(f"Dremio {args.env.upper()} user name: ").strip()
            password = getpass.getpass("Dremio password (hidden, never stored): ")
            if not user or not password:
                print("nothing stored")
                return 1
            token = sign_in(user, password, args.env)
            del password
            Client("_dremio" + token, env=args.env).call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"signed in to {args.env.upper()}; session token stored in {save_token(token, env=args.env)} (the password is not kept)")
        elif args.cmd == "probe":
            c = Client(env=args.env)
            print(f"{args.env.upper()} server status:", c.call("GET", "/apiv2/server_status", auth=False))
            data = c.call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"authenticated: {len(data.get('data', []))} top-level catalog entries")
        else:
            src = args.file or args.sql_file
            if not src:
                p.error("give -f <file> or '-' for standard input")
            target = out_path(args.out)
            sql = sys.stdin.read() if src == "-" else Path(src).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            job, columns, rows, total = Client(env=args.env).query(sql, args.max_rows, args.timeout)
            write_csv(target, columns, rows)
            cut = f" (cut at {args.max_rows} of {total})" if total > len(rows) else ""
            print(f"job {job}: {len(rows)} rows, {len(columns)} columns written to {args.out}{cut}")
    except DremioError as exc:
        print(f"dremio_sql: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

FUNCTION get_Clearing_Account( p_RegisterNumber IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
v_ClearingAccount  REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT.G_ACC_NO1%TYPE;
CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT DISTINCT T.G_ACC_NO1 CLEARING_ACCOUNT
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT T
    WHERE T.C_ID     = TO_CHAR(p_RegisterNumber)
    AND T.C_ACC_TYPE = '0000' -- INCPB-821829
    ;
Err Exception;
BEGIN
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP
    v_ClearingAccount := X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT;
    EXIT;
END LOOP;
RETURN v_ClearingAccount;
END get_Clearing_Account;
PROCEDURE get_Date_Last_Available_Day( p_in_Type        IN NUMBER, -- 1= Une date / 2=une pÃ©ride
                                       p_in_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_in_Date        IN DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_From  OUT DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_To    OUT DATE) IS
v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
v_Date_From             DATE;
v_Date_To               DATE;
CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV IS
   SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
   FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
   WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO   = p_in_Fund_Number
     AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date
     AND T.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y'
   UNION
   SELECT C.DATE_NAV
   FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
   WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
     AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date --'31-dec-18'
   ORDER BY 1 DESC   ;
CURSOR CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV(p_Date_From IN DATE) IS
   SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
   FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
   WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_in_Fund_Number
     AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV < p_Date_From
     AND T.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y'
   UNION
   SELECT C.DATE_NAV
   FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
   WHERE C.FA_NUM   = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
     AND C.DATE_NAV < p_Date_From --'31-dec-18'
   ORDER BY 1 DESC ;
Err Exception;
BEGIN
IF p_in_Type = 1 THEN
   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
       v_Date_From := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;
   ELSE
   -- RÃ©cup date To
   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
       v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;
   -- RÃ©cup date From
   FOR VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV IN CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV (v_Date_To) LOOP
       v_Date_From   := NVL(VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;
END IF;
    p_out_Date_From := v_Date_From;
    p_out_Date_To   := v_Date_To;
Exception
    When Err Then
         null;
    when others then
         null;
END get_Date_Last_Available_Day;

PROCEDURE get_Date_Published_Period ( p_in_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_in_Date_From   IN DATE,
                                       p_in_Date_To     IN DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_From  OUT DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_To    OUT DATE) IS
    v_status                NUMBER :=1;
    v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
    v_Date_From             DATE;
    v_Date_To               DATE;
    CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO   = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date_To
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
        UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date_To
       ORDER BY 1 DESC;
    CURSOR CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV(p_Date_From IN DATE,p_Date_To IN DATE) IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV >= LEAST(p_Date_From,p_Date_To) --p_Date_From
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
       UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND C.DATE_NAV >= LEAST(p_Date_From,p_Date_To) --p_Date_From
       ORDER BY 1;
    Err Exception;
    BEGIN
     -- RÃ©cup date To
     FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
         v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
         EXIT;
     END LOOP;
     -- RÃ©cup date From
     FOR VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV IN CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV (p_in_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP
         v_Date_From   := NVL(VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
         EXIT;
     END LOOP;
        p_out_Date_From := v_Date_From;
        p_out_Date_To   := v_Date_To;
    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;
END get_Date_Published_Period;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS
    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,

    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES  T
    INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
            ON b.fund_no = t.c_fund
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1)

      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1));                     -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial) 
Err Exception;
